```text
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   BOE 6:1 Dip 25C    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Cascade Overflow   │
│        Rinse         │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  N2 Dry & Metrology  │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Safety Precautions
> [!CAUTION]
> **Hydrofluoric Acid Hazard**: HF penetrates dermis and binds tissue calcium. A dedicated HF safety kit with unexpired **calcium gluconate gel** must be positioned within arm's reach of the wet bench. Operators must wear full acid-resistant PPE (neoprene apron, face shield, and chemical-resistant gauntlet gloves).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Treatment & Dehydration**:
   - Transfer wafers to dehydration oven; bake at **150°C to 200°C for 30 minutes** to desorb physisorbed water.
   - Perform vapor-phase HMDS priming at **120°C** to silylate hydrophilic silanol ($-Si-OH$) groups into hydrophobic methyl-siloxane ($-Si-O-Si(CH_3)_3$), ensuring resist adhesion and preventing lift-off during chemical etching.

2. **Lithography Masking**:
   - Dispense **2–3 mL Shipley 1813** photoresist onto the wafer at **500 RPM for 5 seconds** (spread cycle).
   - Accelerate at **10,000 RPM/s** up to **4,000 RPM for 30 seconds** (spin cycle) to target a film thickness of **$1.30\ \mu\text{m} \pm 15\ \text{nm}$**.
   - Perform automated edge bead removal (EBR) via PGMEA solvent jet to eliminate clamp contamination, followed by soft-bake, exposure, and develop steps.

3. **Bath Conditioning & Surfactant Spike**:
   - Fill the primary PTFE immersion vessel with **BOE 6:1** (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ to 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$).
   - Spike bath with **0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad** wetting agent to suppress micro-trench bubble entrapment and enhance capillary wetting.
   - Verify closed-loop recirculating chiller/heater maintains bath temperature strictly at **$25^\circ\text{C}$**.

4. **Timed Immersion Etch**:
   - Calculate immersion duration based on thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate nominal target of **$100\ \text{nm/min}$** ($1000\ \text{\AA/min}$).
   - Load wafer carrier into dip fixture and submerge with gentle vertical agitation. Execute timed etch for target oxide cut depth.

5. **Multi-Stage Cascade Overflow Rinse & Drying**:
   - Rapidly transfer carrier into Stage 1 of the cascade overflow deionized (DI) water tank within $< 3\ \text{seconds}$ to quench HF etching.
   - Advance through multi-stage cascade counter-flow rinse until DI water resistivity exceeds benchmark specification.
   - Transfer to spin-rinse-dryer (SRD) or blow dry with filtered, high-purity $\text{N}_2$ gun.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Etch Bath Temperature** | `25.0` | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ PTFE-sheathed thermocouple / RTD sensor |
| **Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | `100` (`1000`) | $\pm 5.0$ ($\pm 50$) | $\text{nm/min}$ ($\text{\AA/min}$) | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / film thickness delta |
| **Photoresist Film Thickness** | `1.30` | $\pm 0.015$ ($\pm 15\ \text{nm}$) | $\mu\text{m}$ | Spectral reflectometry (post-spin across 100mm wafer) |
| **HMDS Priming Temperature** | `120` | $\pm 2.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated vapor prime vacuum chamber pyrometer |

---

### 5. Literature Citations & Context Tracing

- **Buffered Oxide Etch Chemistry & Safety**:  
  *Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*  
  - Formulation: 6 parts $40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part $49\%\ \text{HF}$.
  - Etch Rate: Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etched at $\sim 100\ \text{nm/min}$ ($1000\ \text{\AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Additives & Safety: $0.1\%$ Triton X-100 / Fluorad surfactant wetting agent; mandatory presence of calcium gluconate gel for HF safety.
- **Surface Prep & Photoresist Parameters**:  
  *Source: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming*  
  - Wafer dehydration at $150^\circ\text{C} - 200^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes.
  - HMDS vapor priming at $120^\circ\text{C}$ for silanol silylation.
  - Dispense 2–3 mL Shipley 1813 at 500 RPM for 5 s, ramp at 10,000 RPM/s to 4,000 RPM for 30 s, yielding $1.30\ \mu\text{m} \pm 15\ \text{nm}$ film.
- **Device Node Integration Context**:  
  *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - Target: 180nm open-source memory unit cells ($L=180\ \text{nm}$, $W=220\ \text{nm}$) utilizing stacked capacitor / bitline architecture.

**Title:** Surfactant-Spiked BOE 6:1 Bath Conditioning and Thermal Stabilization  
**Discipline:** Wet Chemistry / Lithography Pattern Transfer

**Safety Protocol:** Mandatory HF safety PPE (chemical apron, face shield, heavy-duty neoprene/nitrile gloves). Unexpired calcium gluconate gel must be present and verified at the wet bench.

### Process Workflow

```text

             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Recirculation &     │
│  Thermal Soak at 25°C  │

│      Thermal SiO2      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Safety & Tank Inspection**
   - Confirm safety eyewash, drench shower, and calcium gluconate gel availability within arms reach.
   - Inspect the dedicated fluoropolymer (PVDF/PTFE) wet bath tank, inline filters, and recirculation loop for particulate residues or chemical contamination.

2. **Chemical Ratio Formulation (BOE 6:1)**
   - Fill the bath vessel with premixed or metered volumetric constituent charges:
     - **6 parts** 40% Ammonium Fluoride ($\text{NH}_4\text{F}$)
     - **1 part** 49% Hydrofluoric Acid ($\text{HF}$)
   - Verify bath buffering buffer activity settles at nominal **$\text{pH} \approx 4.5$**.

3. **Surfactant Wetting Agent Spiking**
   - Meter and add **0.1% vol/vol** of wetting agent (**Triton X-100** or **Fluorad**) into the bath charge to lower liquid surface tension and eliminate bubble entrapment in high-aspect-ratio micro-trenches.

4. **Recirculation and Thermal Stabilization**
   - Engage fluoropolymer immersion circulating pump and recirculating heat exchanger.
   - Stabilize the bath closed-loop temperature setpoint at exactly **25.0°C**. Allow continuous circulation for thermal and surfactant equilibrium across the entire fluid volume.

5. **Blanket Monitor Etch Rate Qualification**
   - Immerse a pre-measured blanket thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ monitor wafer for a 60-second timed qualification dip.
   - Immediately transfer to an adjacent cascade overflow dump rinse (18.2 $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW), spin-dry, and measure residual oxide thickness via spectroscopic ellipsometry to confirm baseline etch rate.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Operating Temperature** | $25.0\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 0.5\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$ | Calibrated inline PTFE RTD sensor |
| **Bath Buffer Acidity (pH)** | $4.5$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ pH}$ | Inline HF-resistant pH probe |
| **Surfactant Concentration** | $0.10\%$ | $\pm 0.02\%\text{ vol/vol}$ | Gravimetric/volumetric metering |
| **Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | $100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) | $80\text{ to }100\text{ nm/min}$ ($800\text{ to }1000\text{ \AA/min}$) | Pre/post dip spectroscopic ellipsometer |

---

### Literature Citations & Context Sources

1. **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):**
   - Formulation: 6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$.
   - Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate at 25°C: $\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$).
   - Wetting agent requirement: 0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad to eliminate bubble entrapment in micro-trenches.
   - Safety mandate: Calcium gluconate gel presence for HF exposure.
2. **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates:**
   - Buffering mechanism: $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ buffer maintaining constant fluoride activity and steady $\text{pH} \sim 4.5$.
   - Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ baseline etch rate range: $80\text{ to }100\text{ nm/min}$ ($800\text{ to }1000\text{ \AA/min}$) at 25°C.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety Protocol & PPE Verification**:
   - Don HF-rated PPE (heavy neoprene/nitrile apron, sleeve guards, double heavy-gauge nitrile/butyl gloves, full-face shield).
   - Verify unexpired **Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%)** is positioned inside the immediate wet bench reach zone before opening any chemical container.
2. **Fluorpolymer Vessel Setup**:
   - Ensure a dedicated, clean PFA/PTFE formulation container is positioned on an exhaust-monitored wet bench. *(Never use borosilicate/glass).*
3. **Buffer Charging (Ammonium Fluoride)**:
   - Accurately measure **6 parts by volume** of semiconductor-grade **40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ (Ammonium Fluoride)** solution.
   - Decant into the PTFE mixing tank first to provide a stable, buffered medium and control exothermic dissociation.
4. **Acid Introduction (Hydrofluoric Acid)**:
   - Slowly meter in **1 part by volume** of semiconductor-grade **49% $\text{HF}$ (Hydrofluoric Acid)** under constant low-shear PTFE impeller agitation to maintain uniform buffering and constant pH.
5. **Non-Ionic Surfactant Doping**:
   - Micropipette non-ionic wetting agent (**Triton X-100** or **Fluorad**) into the mixture to reach a target concentration of **0.1% by volume**.
   - Agitate for 10 minutes to guarantee complete dissolution and eliminate micro-trench bubble entrapment during contact opening.
6. **Thermal Bath Stabilization**:
   - Recirculate through a fluoropolymer heat exchanger until the chemical bath stabilizes at **25°C**.
7. **Pre-Production Etch Qualification**:
   - Perform a timed dip-etch on a bare thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ monitor wafer and an $\text{LPCVD }\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ monitor wafer to verify selectivity and baseline rate calibration prior to releasing the lot.

```text
│  PID Chiller / Heater  │

└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│        Thermal         │
│    Stabilization &     │
│  Verification: 25.0°C  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety Clearance & Pre-Operational Setup**
   - Don full wet-bench acid gear (chemically resistant apron, fluoropolymer sleeve guards, face shield, and heavy-duty neoprene/nitrile over-gloves).
   - Verify unexpired **calcium gluconate gel** is mounted at the immersion bench station. Ensure emergency eyewash and safety shower paths are unobstructed.
2. **Bath Chemistry Fill & Surfactant Doping**
   - Charge the high-purity PVDF/PFA immersion tank with pre-mixed **BOE 6:1** chemistry (ratio: 6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ to 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$).
   - Spike the bath with **0.1%** wetting agent (Triton X-100 or Fluorad) to ensure complete elimination of micro-bubble entrapment across dense 180nm micro-trench geometries.
3. **Recirculation Loop Initiation & De-aeration**
   - Engage the chemically inert magnetic drive bellows pump on the recirculation loop.
   - Crack the PTFE circulation filter vent valve to bleed trapped air bubbles until continuous, laminar, non-pulsing liquid overflow returns across the tank weir.
4. **PID Thermal Stabilization Engagement**
   - Power on the immersion heat-exchanger PID temperature controller and setpoint to **25.0°C**.
   - Allow continuous recirculation through the thermal jacket/heat exchanger to eliminate thermal stratification and local hotspot/coldspot gradients.
5. **Thermal In-Line Verification**
   - Monitor the internal in-line platinum RTD / encased thermowell probe.
   - Confirm thermal equilibrium within the tolerance window ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$) sustained continuously for $\ge 15$ minutes before lot introduction.
6. **Calibration Etch Rate Confirmation Coupon Run**
   - Submerge a bare thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ monitor pilot wafer for exactly 60 seconds into the conditioned 25°C bath, followed immediately by multi-stage cascade overflow rinse.
   - Confirm expected baseline oxide removal of $\approx 100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) via pre/post ellipsometry.

---

### Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                     Key Process Calibration Parameters 
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
   Baseline Etch Rate┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Temp Stability Window┤▒                                │
                     │▒                                │
          Temp Target┤█████████                        │
                     │█████████                        │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      25      50      75     100 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equilibrium Bath Temperature** | `25.0` | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ calibrated probe / thermowell |
| **Surfactant Concentration** | `0.1` | Nominal Spike | $\%$ vol/vol | Volumetric metering (Triton X-100 / Fluorad) |
| **Thermally Grown $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | `100` (`1000`) | Nominal ($\pm 5\%$) | $\text{nm/minute}$ ($\text{\AA/minute}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (60s monitor dip) |
| **Silicon Nitride Mask Etch Rate** | $< 0.5$ | Upper limit ceiling | $\text{nm/minute}$ | Pilot test verification (LPCVD $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$) |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - *Etch Rate & Temperature*: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 25°C is approximately $100\text{ nm/minute}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/minute}$).
  - *Chemistry*: 6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ to 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$ (BOE 6:1); wetting agent concentration of 0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad.
  - *Safety*: HF skin penetration / calcium binding protocol; requirement for immediate calcium gluconate gel availability.
- **Source: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  - *Thermal Control & Uniformity*: PID digital regulation loop, maintaining tight $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ thermal uniformity stability across the active process zone.
- **Source: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:
  - *Mask Selectivity*: $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard mask etch rate in BOE is $< 0.5\text{ nm/minute}$, confirming high wet-etch selectivity during oxide patterning.
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation (Levinson - Principles of Lithography & Thermal Processing)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-MET-180-042`  
**Title:** Pilot Thermal Oxide Etch Rate Verification and Bath Life Metrology  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Architecture & Integration > BOE 6:1 SiO₂ Patterning > Wet Chemistry > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Node) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the rigorous protocol for validating the etch rate of thermally grown Silicon Dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) and qualifying bath life stability in a surfactant-spiked Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1: 6 parts $40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F}$ to 1 part $49\%\ \text{HF}$) bath. This qualification ensures uniform, reproducible wet dip-etching across DRAM isolation, patterning, and gate/capacitor dielectric boundary steps prior to processing production wafers.

---

## 2. Safety & PPE Requirements
> [!CAUTION]
> **Hydrofluoric Acid Hazard**: HF penetrates dermis and subcutaneous tissues, causing severe bone decalcification and systemic toxicity.
> - Work exclusively inside certified chemical wet benches with continuous laminar exhaust.
> - Wear chemical-resistant PTFE/Neoprene apron, heavy-duty Viton/Neoprene gauntlet gloves, and full-face splash shield.
> - **Mandatory Emergency Antidote**: Calcium gluconate gel ($2.5\%$) and a functioning eyewash/safety shower must be present and verified operational before accessing the wet bench.

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                  PILOT OXIDE ETCH RATE & BATH LIFE FLOW                 |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
                 +---------------------------------------+
                 |  1. Bath Inspection & Temperature     |
                 |     Stabilization Check (25°C ± 0.5°C)|
                 +---------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
                 +---------------------------------------+
                 |  2. Pre-Etch Pilot Wafer Metrology    |
                 |     (Ellipsometry / 9-pt Map)         |
                 +---------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
                 +---------------------------------------+
                 |  3. Surfactant-Spiked BOE 6:1 Dip     |
                 |     Etch Execution (Timed 60s Dip)    |
                 +---------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
                 +---------------------------------------+
                 |  4. Multi-Stage Cascade Rinse         |
                 |     & Spin-Rinse Dry (SRD)            |
                 +---------------------------------------+
                                     |
                                     v
                 +---------------------------------------+
                 |  5. Post-Etch Metrology & Rate Calc   |
                 |     (Target: 100 nm/min ± 5 nm/min)   |
                 +---------------------------------------+
```

### Step 1: Bath Inspection & Thermal Stabilization Verification
1. Verify the recirculation and chemical filtration loop of the fluoropolymer (PVDF/PFA) dip tank.
2. Confirm the chemical composition ratio is strictly **BOE 6:1** (6 parts $40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part $49\%\ \text{HF}$) with $0.1\%$ wetting agent (Triton X-100 or Fluorad) added to eliminate micro-trench bubble entrapment.
3. Verify that the bath temperature controller reads and maintains **$25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$**.

### Step 2: Pre-Etch Pilot Wafer Selection and Initial Metrology
1. Obtain a clean pilot monitor silicon wafer bearing a thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ film (calibrated target nominal thickness: $100\text{ nm}$ to $200\text{ nm}$ grown via dry/wet thermal oxidation).
2. Measure the initial oxide thickness ($T_{\text{pre}}$) across a standard 9-point radial ellipsometry map ($\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$).
3. Record the mean thickness $T_{\text{pre, avg}}$ and 9-point 1-sigma across-wafer thickness variation.

### Step 3: Timed Dip-Etch Recipe Execution
1. Transfer the pilot wafer onto a dedicated acid-compatible PTFE carrier.
2. Fully submerge the carrier into the stabilized surfactant-spiked BOE 6:1 bath for precisely **$60.0 \pm 0.5\text{ seconds}$** with gentle mechanical agitation.
3. Ensure no bubbles adhere to the wafer active surface during the chemical dwell.

### Step 4: Cascade Overflow Rinse & Spin-Rinse Drying (SRD)
1. Upon elapsed time, immediately withdraw the wafer carrier and transfer into the first stage of the cascade overflow DI water rinse tank within $< 3\text{ seconds}$ transit time.
2. Cascade rinse with continuous deionized (DI) water overflow until effluent resistivity measures $> 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
3. Transfer the wafer carrier to the spin-rinse dryer (SRD) and cycle with hot semiconductor-grade $\text{N}_2$ until completely dry.

### Step 5: Post-Etch Metrology & Rate Calculation
1. Re-measure the oxide thickness ($T_{\text{post}}$) at the identical 9 measurement coordinate points using the spectroscopic ellipsometer.
2. Calculate the oxide removal rate:
   $$\text{Etch Rate} = \frac{T_{\text{pre, avg}} - T_{\text{post, avg}}}{t_{\text{etch}}} \quad [\text{nm/min}]$$
3. Compute Across-Wafer Non-Uniformity (NU):
   $$\text{NU}\ (\%) = \frac{\text{Max Etch Rate} - \text{Min Etch Rate}}{2 \times \text{Mean Etch Rate}} \times 100$$
4. Record cumulative bath throughput count. If etch rate deviates beyond control limits or bath cumulative hours exceed replacement thresholds, flag bath for replacement.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Measurement Instrument | Target Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **BOE 6:1 Etch Bath Temperature** | In-tank calibrated PT100 RTD sensor | $25.0 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (mean 9-point) | $100 \pm 5$ ($1000 \pm 50$) | $\text{nm/min}$ ($\text{Å/min}$) |
| **Etch Rate Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (NU)** | Ellipsometric thickness delta distribution | $\le 3.0$ | $\%$ |
| **Final Cascade Rinse DI Water Resistivity** | In-line conductance/resistivity probe | $\ge 18.0$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |

---

## 5. Literature Citations & Physical Constraints
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - Etchant mixture: 6 parts $40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part $49\%\ \text{HF}$.
  - Calibrated etch rate: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ is nominally $100\text{ nm/minute}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$).
  - Surfactant role: $0.1\%$ Triton X-100 or Fluorad added to eliminate micro-trench bubble entrapment.
  - HF Safety Protocol: Immediate availability of calcium gluconate gel at all times due to HF tissue penetration and calcium-binding hazards.
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Oxidation kinetics follow the linear-parabolic model ($x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$). Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ test substrates produced via controlled furnace oxidation provide the physical baseline standard for etch calibration.
- **Source: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:
  - Confirms $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard masks exhibit extreme resistance to BOE ($< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$), validating BOE's high etch selectivity against silicon nitride layers during 180nm pattern boundary etching.
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-WET-BOE-006`
**Title:** Precision Timed Dip-Etch Execution with Dynamic Agitation  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Node  
**Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning > HMDS Vapor Prime, Resist Patterning & Wet Oxide Dip-Etch Recipe Execution > Surfactant-Spike BOE 6:1 Dip-Etch Recipe Execution & Cascade Rinse > Timed Oxide Dip-Etch Recipe Execution with Multi-Stage Cascade Overflow Rinse > Precision Timed Dip-Etch Execution with Dynamic Agitation  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Equipment & Chemical Specifications

| Item | Specification / Parameter | Source Citation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Etchant Solution** | BOE 6:1 ($6\text{ parts } 40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F} : 1\text{ part } 49\%\ \text{HF}$) | *Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates* |
| **Surfactant / Wetting Agent** | 0.1% Triton X-100 (or Fluorad) surfactant-spiked | *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* |
| **Bath Operating Temperature** | $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (controlled bath) | *Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates* |
| **Nominal Etch Rate ($\text{SiO}_2$)**| Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$: $80\text{ to } 100\text{ nm/min}$ ($800\text{ to } 1000\text{ \AA/min}$) | *Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates* |
| **Selectivity Ratios** | $\text{SiO}_2 : \text{Si} > 100:1$; $\text{SiO}_2 : \text{Si}_3\text{N}_4 > 20:1$ | *Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates* |
| **Rinse Water** | Ultra-Pure Water (UPW), resistivity target $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ supply) | *RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering* |
| **Safety First Aid** | Topical Calcium Gluconate Gel available in wet-bench zone | *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* |

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 1: Pre-Check & Bath Conditioning                      |
  |  - Verify BOE 6:1 at 25°C, 0.1% surfactant mixed           |
  |  - Calcium gluconate gel inspected at point-of-use          |
  +------------------------------+------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 2: Cassette Loading & Pre-Immersion Alignment          |
  |  - Load HMDS/PR-patterned wafers vertically into PTFE boat   |
  |  - Position overhead dynamic agitation arm                  |
  +------------------------------+------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 3: Timed Dip-Etch & Dynamic Agitation                  |
  |  - Immerse into BOE 6:1 bath; trigger precision timer        |
  |  - Continuous vertical dynamic reciprocating agitation       |
  |  - Prevent bubble entrapment via surfactant + flow action   |
  +------------------------------+------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 4: Rapid Transfer & Cascade Overflow Rinse             |
  |  - Transfer within <= 3 sec into Quick Dump / Overflow bath |
  |  - Rinse until UPW effluent resistivity > 16 MOhm-cm        |
  +------------------------------+------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 5: Surface Dewetting & Spin-Rinse Dry                  |
  |  - Validate unmasked oxide clear (hydrophobic Si boundary)   |
  |  - Execute N2 spin-rinse dry                                |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Bath Conditioning & Safety Verification:**
   - Confirm bath is stabilized at **$25.0^\circ\text{C}$**. Verify solution chemistry is standard **BOE 6:1** ($6:1$ ratio of $40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F} : 49\%\ \text{HF}$) pre-blended with **$0.1\%$ Triton X-100** wetting agent to eliminate micro-trench bubble entrapment.
   - Verify unexpired **calcium gluconate gel** is deployed directly at the wet-bench safety station.

2. **Substrate Preparation & Loading:**
   - Verify incoming wafers have completed **HMDS vapor priming at $120^\circ\text{C}$** and photolithography resist development without resist lifting.
   - Mount wafers vertically into a fluoropolymer (PTFE/PFA) carrier cassette with uniform slot clearance.

3. **Precision Timed Immersion with Dynamic Agitation:**
   - Program dip-etch duration calculated against target oxide thickness using the baseline thermal oxide rate of **$80\text{--}100\text{ nm/min}$** (or $150\text{--}220\text{ nm/min}$ if TEOS/CVD $\text{SiO}_2$ is patterned).
   - Submerge cassette smoothly into the BOE 6:1 bath and initiate the digital timer simultaneously.
   - Engage dynamic agitation (reciprocating vertical agitation stroke $\pm 5\text{ mm}$ at $0.5\text{--}1.0\text{ Hz}$) to constantly replenish HF reactants at the boundary layer and displace any micro-bubbles.

4. **Quench & Cascade Dump Rinse:**
   - At $T - 3\text{ seconds}$, initiate cassette lift. Transfer cassette out of BOE bath into the primary UPW cascade overflow/dump rinse tank within $\le 3\text{ seconds}$ to prevent over-etch.
   - Conduct dump-rinse / multi-stage overflow cycles with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW until effluent resistivity reaches **$> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.

5. **Drying & Post-Etch Inspection:**
   - Transfer cassette to the spin-rinse dryer (SRD) with hot $\text{N}_2$ dry cycle.
   - Confirm complete clearing across unmasked openings via optical ellipsometry/reflectometry.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Acceptance Metric | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Etch Rate Stability** | $100\text{ nm/min}$ (thermal $\text{SiO}_2$) | $80\text{ to } 100\text{ nm/min}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ / Pre-run pilot Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Process Bath Temperature** | $25.0^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ | Inline calibrated PTFE thermocouple sensor |
| **Selectivity to Underlayer** | $> 100:1$ ($\text{SiO}_2 : \text{Si}$) | Minimum $100:1$ ratio | Post-etch film thickness step-height profilometry |
| **Rinse Bath Resistivity** | $> 16.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Minimum threshold $\ge 16.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Inline UPW conductivity/resistivity probe |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References
- **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates:** Chemistry ratio ($6:1\ \text{NH}_4\text{F}:\text{HF}$), pH $\sim 4.5$, thermal oxide etch rates ($80\text{--}100\text{ nm/min}$), CVD oxide rates ($150\text{--}220\text{ nm/min}$), selectivity over Si ($> 100:1$).
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):** Requirement for $0.1\%$ Triton X-100 wetting agent to prevent bubble entrapment; HMDS vapor prime requirement at $120^\circ\text{C}$; calcium gluconate safety protocol.
- **RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering:** UPW resistivity rinse endpoint criterion ($> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water).
citations: Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates (Williams, K. - Journal of Microelectromechanical Systems (JMEMS))
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-BOE-002`  
**Title:** Surfactant-Spiked BOE 6:1 Bath Conditioning & Megasonic Agitation Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Wet Chemistry Patterning  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Safety & PPE Protocols
> [!CAUTION]
> **Hydrofluoric Acid Hazard**: BOE contains 49% HF, which penetrates dermal tissue and binds systemic calcium ($Ca^{2+}$).
> - Chemical apron, heavy-duty neoprene gloves, face shield, and chemical fume hood exhaust must be operational.
> - **Calcium gluconate gel (2.5%)** must be inspected and present at the wet bench before any chemical handling.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                         SOP WORKFLOW OVERVIEW                            |
|                                                                          |
|  [ 1. Bath Make-Up ]      6:1 NH4F (40%) : HF (49%) Volumetric Blend     |
|          |                                                               |
|          v                                                               |
|  [ 2. Surfactant Spike ]  0.1% Triton X-100 / Fluorad Addition           |
|          |                                                               |
|          v                                                               |
|  [ 3. Thermal Equilib. ]  Circulate & Stabilize Bath at 25°C             |
|          |                                                               |
|          v                                                               |
|  [ 4. Megasonic Calib. ]  De-gas & Verify Acoustic Power Field           |
|          |                                                               |
|          v                                                               |
|  [ 5. Dummy Etch Run ]    Thermal SiO2 Coupon Qualification              |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Bath Preparation & Chemical Charging**:
   - Ensure the PVDF/PFA bath tank is cleaned and rinsed to $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water background.
   - Charge the bath with standard Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) formulation: 6 parts ammonium fluoride ($40\%\text{ NH}_4\text{F}$) to 1 part hydrofluoric acid ($49\%\text{ HF}$).
2. **Surfactant Dosing (Wetting Agent)**:
   - Spike the bath with **0.1% volume fraction** of wetting agent (Triton X-100 or Fluorad) into the BOE solution to lower surface tension and prevent bubble entrapment inside micro-trenches.
3. **Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Engage recirculation heat exchanger to stabilize the chemical bath precisely at **25°C**.
   - Monitor temperature stability across the tank for 10 minutes prior to wafer immersion.
4. **Megasonic Agitation Calibration & Degassing**:
   - Initiate megasonic transducer array in recirculation/agitation mode to de-gas the solution and establish an even acoustic streaming field.
   - Verify boundary layer replenishment across carrier slots to prevent local HF depletion.
5. **Pilot Qualification Etch**:
   - Immerse a thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ monitor coupon (prepared with prior dehydration bake at 150°C–200°C for 30 min and HMDS vapor prime at 120°C if resist-masked) into the conditioned bath.
   - Execute a timed dip-etch, perform quick dump rinse (QDR) with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water, blow-dry with high-purity $\text{N}_2$, and measure residual oxide thickness via reflectometry/ellipsometry.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Units | Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Chemical Temperature** | `25.0` | `± 0.5` | °C | In-line PFA Immersion RTD |
| **Surfactant Concentration** | `0.10` | `± 0.01` | % (v/v) | Precision Volumetric Dispenser |
| **Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | `100` (~1000 Å/min) | `± 5` | nm/min | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Deionized Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | `Min 18.0` | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line Resistivity Cell |

---

### 4. Source Context Citations
- **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) Chemical Composition & Etch Rate**: 6 parts $40\%\text{ NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part $49\%\text{ HF}$; baseline etch rate of thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ is $100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$ (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
- **Micro-Trench Wetting Agent**: Addition of $0.1\%\text{ Triton X-100}$ or Fluorad to prevent bubble entrapment (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
- **Safety Protocol**: Mandatory on-site calcium gluconate gel for dermal HF exposure (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
- **Surface Preparation & Rinse Standards**: High-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry and $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water rinse standard (*Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*); HMDS vapor priming at $120^\circ\text{C}$ and dehydration bake at $150^\circ\text{C}\text{--}200^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes (*Source: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming*).
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming (Madou - Fundamentals of Microfabrication)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Precision Timed Immersion Dip-Etch Execution with Controlled Reciprocal Agitation

**Task Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm) — Wet Oxide Dip-Etch Patterning  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Safety Notice:** HF is highly toxic, penetrates skin, and binds systemic calcium. An unexpired **calcium gluconate gel** tube must be physically inspected at the wet bench before wet operations begin.

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│   1. Bath Prep & Verification (BOE 6:1)      │
│   - Temp: 25.0 °C                            │
│   - Wetting Agent: 0.1% Triton X-100/Fluorad │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│   2. Immersion with Reciprocal Agitation     │
│   - Precision Timed Immersion                │
│   - Controlled boundary layer fluid dynamics │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│   3. Quench & Multi-Stage Cascade Rinse      │
│   - Immediate DI water transfer              │
│   - Resist integrity check                   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Bench Clearance Verification**
   - Ensure PPE (acid apron, face shield, heavy neoprene/PVDF acid gloves) is donned.
   - Verify that calcium gluconate antidote gel is present at the wet bench station.

2. **Chemistry & Bath Parameter Setup**
   - Confirm bath composition is **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1)**: 6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ to 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$.
   - Add **0.1% wetting agent** (Triton X-100 or Fluorad) to the bath to eliminate bubble entrapment and pinning across high-aspect-ratio micro-trenches.
   - Stabilize recirculating bath temperature at **25.0°C**.

3. **Pre-Etch Wafer Carrier Loading**
   - Verify patterned wafer has received prior **HMDS vapor priming at 120°C** and resist patterning to guarantee adhesion during acid contact.
   - Mount 100mm wafers into the PTFE/fluoropolymer dip cassette.

4. **Precision Timed Immersion Dip-Etch & Agitation**
   - Submerge wafer cassette into the BOE 6:1 bath while simultaneously starting precision process timer based on target film thickness (calibrated nominal thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate: **100 nm/min** / $1000\ \text{Å/min}$; $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard mask etch rate: **$< 0.5\ \text{nm/min}$**).
   - Engage controlled reciprocal agitation to continuously refresh the boundary layer and eliminate diffusion gradients across the wafer surface.

5. **Transfer, Quench & Cascade Rinse**
   - Upon timer expiry, promptly lift cassette out of BOE bath and transfer within $< 3$ seconds into the first stage of the multi-stage cascade overflow rinse bath to arrest chemical reaction.
   - Cascade rinse with deionized water until effluent resistivity reaches operational specification.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **BOE Bath Temperature** | $25.0 \pm 0.5$ | °C | In-tank calibrated PT100 / RTD sensor |
| **Wetting Agent Concentration** | $0.10 \pm 0.01$ | wt% / vol% | Precision volumetric dispensing record |
| **Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | $100 \pm 5$ | nm/min ($1000 \pm 50\ \text{Å/min}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Film Thickness Metrology |
| **$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ Mask Etch Rate** | $< 0.5$ | nm/min | Pre/post dip spectroscopic reflectometry |

---

### Context Citations

- **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) Formulation, Wetting Agent, & Safety:** Formulated with 6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ and 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$. Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate is $\sim 100\ \text{nm/min}$ ($1000\ \text{Å/min}$) at 25°C. Requires 0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad wetting agent to eliminate micro-trench bubble entrapment. Calcium gluconate gel must be present (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
- **Surface Adhesion Preparation:** HMDS vapor prime performed at 120°C prior to resist coating to silylate silanol groups and prevent resist peel-off during acid immersion (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* and *Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming*).
- **Silicon Nitride Mask Selectivity:** $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ serves as hard mask with etch resistance in BOE $< 0.5\ \text{nm/min}$ (*Source: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks*).
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming (Madou - Fundamentals of Microfabrication)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

#### **Title:** Post-Etch Rapid Cascade Quench, Spin-Rinse Dry (SRD) & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Inspection
**Process Step:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy / Execution

---

### Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Etch Bath Exit (BOE 6:1 Dip at 25°C)        │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │ Rapid Transfer (< 5 s)
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Multi-Stage Cascade Overflow DI Water Rinse │
│  (Resistivity Recovery to 18 MΩ·cm)          │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │ Nitrogen Purge & Transfer
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Spin-Rinse Dry (SRD)                        │
│  (4,000 RPM Spin Cycle, N2 Blanket Dry)      │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │ Dry Transfer
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Metrology        │
│  (Film Thickness & Refractive Index n)       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Emergency Safety & Rapid Transfer Setup**:
   - Verify that Calcium Gluconate antidote gel is physically stocked and accessible at the wet bench before wafer extraction.
   - Maintain the upstream BOE (6:1) bath temperature at $25^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Rapid Cascade Overflow Quench**:
   - Immediately extract the wafer cassette from the BOE 6:1 solution upon completion of the timed etch step.
   - Transfer and plunge the cassette into Stage 1 of the deionized (DI) water cascade overflow rinse bath within $\le 5\text{ seconds}$ to arrest chemical etching.
   - Submerge sequentially across cascade stages under continuous bottom-up overflow until DI water effluent resistivity recovers to baseline ($\ge 18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$), flushing all residual fluorides, $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$, and wetting agent surfactant.

3. **Spin-Rinse Dry (SRD) Execution**:
   - Transfer rinsed wafers into the automated Spin-Rinse Dryer chamber under filtered nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) purge.
   - Execute the spin-dry recipe: ramp to $4,000\text{ RPM}$ for $30\text{ seconds}$ with simultaneous high-purity heated $\text{N}_2$ purge to eliminate surface water droplets, micro-trench entrapment, and edge-bead dry spots without mechanical water spotting.

4. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Inspection**:
   - Transfer dry wafers to the automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer loading stage.
   - Configure measurement recipe for multi-layer dielectric modeling on Si substrate across the visible wavelength range (centered at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$).
   - Measure 5-point/9-point across-wafer test sites targeting remaining dielectric/hard mask thickness and refractive index.
   - Verify that the hard mask or remaining oxide target thickness conforms strictly within tolerance before releasing the lot to downstream resist strip or metallization.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cascade Quench Transfer Latency** | $\le 5.0$ | $\text{s}$ | Automated wet bench robotic arm / PLC timer |
| **SRD Spin Drying Speed & Duration** | $4,000 \pm 10$ at $30 \pm 1$ | $\text{RPM}$ / $\text{s}$ | SRD Optical Tachometer & Controller Log |
| **Silicon Nitride Film Refractive Index ($n$)** | $2.00 \pm 0.02$ (at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$) | Dimensionless | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer |
| **Oxide Etch Step Rate Uniformity Reference** | $100 \pm 5$ ($1000 \pm 50\text{ \AA/min}$) | $\text{nm/min}$ | Pre/Post Ellipsometric Step-Height Delta at $25^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 3. Literature Context Citations

- **[Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)]**:
  - Etch rate of thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ is approximately $100\text{ nm/minute}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$).
  - BOE consists of 6 parts $40\%\text{ NH}_4\text{F}$ and 1 part $49\%\text{ HF}$ with wetting agent ($0.1\%$ Triton X-100 or Fluorad); Calcium Gluconate gel mandate for HF exposure safety.
- **[Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming]**:
  - Mechanical rotation dynamics and standard recipe execution: spin cycle at $4,000\text{ RPM}$ for $30\text{ seconds}$ with ramp rate up to $10,000\text{ RPM/s}$.
- **[Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks]**:
  - Silicon Nitride hard mask film characteristics: refractive index $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$; high resistance to BOE ($< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$ etch rate).
citations: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming (Madou - Fundamentals of Microfabrication)
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-BOE-001
**Title:** Multi-Stage Cascade Overflow Rinse and Resist Adhesion Metrology  
**Context:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 1)  
**Process Stage:** Wet Chemistry / Metrology post-BOE 6:1 SiO₂ Patterning  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the post-etch multi-stage cascade overflow rinse protocol to quench Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) reactions, remove ionic fluoride/ammonium residues, prevent photoresist lifting, and measure post-rinse resist adhesion and clean endpoint integrity.

---

### 2. Safety, PPE & Equipment Pre-checks
> [!CAUTION]
> **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) Hazard:** HF penetrates skin deeply and dissociated fluoride ions bind serum calcium. **Calcium gluconate gel** must be present at the wet bench workstation at all times.

- **PPE:** Full acid apron, face shield over safety glasses, heavy PVDF/Neoprene acid gloves over nitrile inner gloves.
- **Rinse Tank:** Multi-stage cascade overflow bath constructed from PVDF/PTFE supplied with continuous 18.2 MΩ·cm Ultra-Pure Water (UPW).
- **Drainage:** Dedicated acid waste neutralization line (AWN).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-----------------------+     +-----------------------+     +------------------------+
| Stage 1: Quick Quench | --> | Stage 2: Intermediate | --> | Stage 3: High Purity   |
| Primary Dump Rinse    |     | Cascade Rinse Tank    |     | Overflow Rinse Tank    |
| (5 dump cycles)       |     | (Resistivity monitor) |     | (>16-18.2 MOhm-cm UPW) |
+-----------------------+     +-----------------------+     +------------------------+
                                                                         |
                                                                         v
                                                            +------------------------+
                                                            | Surface Dewet Check &  |
                                                            | CD-SEM Resist Adhesion |
                                                            +------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Initial Quench & Primary Cascade Dump Rinse
1. Immediately transfer the wafer carrier from the BOE 6:1 bath into the primary quick-dump rinse (QDR) stage within **< 3 seconds** to halt SiO₂ etching (~80–100 nm/min thermal oxide rate).
2. Execute **5 cycles** of fill-and-dump with 18.2 MΩ·cm UPW at ambient temperature (22°C–25°C).

#### Step 2: Multi-Stage Cascade Overflow Immersion
1. Submerge the wafer cassette into Stage 2 cascade overflow rinse tank (counter-current UPW flow).
2. Monitor in-line effluent conductivity/resistivity sensor. Rinse continuously until resistivity recovers to **> 16.0 MΩ·cm**.
3. Move carrier to Stage 3 final overflow tank for **60 seconds** under constant UPW laminar overflow to flush residual surfactant (Triton X-100 / Fluorad) and ammonium ions (NH₄⁺).

#### Step 3: Spin-Rinse-Dry (SRD)
1. Transfer wafer boat to automated Spin-Rinse-Dry (SRD) tool.
2. Run baseline dry recipe: low-speed rinse, followed by high-speed spin drying under hot, filtered dry nitrogen ($N_2$) blanket.

#### Step 4: Photoresist Adhesion & Etch Profile Metrology
1. **Dewetting / Clearing Check:** Inspect etched open oxide patterns for complete clearing (hydrophobic transition check on open silicon areas).
2. **Optical Inspection (Macro/Micro):** Inspect wafer under brightfield/darkfield illumination at 50×–1000× magnification across 5 points (Center, North, South, East, West) for resist peeling, blistering, or undercut lifting caused by chemical intrusion or HMDS prime failure.
3. **CD-SEM Adhesion & Profile Verification:** Measure critical dimension (CD) and photoresist footing/undercut in dense feature arrays (180nm pitch).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Final Rinse Water Resistivity** | $\ge 16.0$ | In-line resistivity probe (Stage 3 overflow bath) | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **Cascade Dump Rinse Cycles** | $5$ | Automated cycle counter / QDR controller | $\text{cycles}$ |
| **Photoresist Peeling / Lifting Defect Density** | $0$ (Zero delamination at trench/contact edges) | High-resolution Optical / Darkfield Inspection | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ |
| **SiO₂ Etch Endpoint Uniformity (Thermal Oxide)** | $80 - 100$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (remaining oxide thickness vs. time) | $\text{nm/min}$ |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **Formulation, Safety & Surfactants:** *Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — BOE 6:1 (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$), 100 nm/min thermal oxide etch rate at 25°C, 0.1% surfactant additive, HMDS vapor prime at 120°C for resist adhesion, and mandatory calcium gluconate safety requirements.
- **Rinse Protocol & Resistivity Endpoint:** *Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering* — Cascade dump rinse baseline using 5 cycles with 18.2 MΩ·cm UPW until bath resistivity exceeds 16 MΩ·cm; hydrophobic dewetting verification.
- **Selectivity & Etch Mechanics:** *Source: Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates* — Thermal oxide etch rate envelope of 80–100 nm/min at 25°C, $\text{SiO}_2$ to Si selectivity > 100:1, and deep dermal HF penetration hazards.
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)
Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates (Williams, K. - Journal of Microelectromechanical Systems (JMEMS))

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Multi-Stage Cascade Overflow Rinse Recipe Execution & DI Water Effluent Resistivity Monitoring

- **Node ID**: `node-wet-rinse-cascade-boe-gen2`
- **Level**: Leaf SOP (Gen 2: $\mu\text{m}$ / 180nm Node Pre-Capacitor & Active Dielectric Clean)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Discipline**: Wet Chemistry / Surface Preparation & Contamination Metrology

---

### 1. Process Architecture & Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  BOE 6:1 Chemical Dip  │
│          Tank          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │Carrier Transfer <= 5s
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Stage 1: Quench &    │
│     Rough Cascade      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │Counter-Current Overflow
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Stage 2:        │
│  Intermediate Cascade  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │Upstream Fresh UPW
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Stage 3: Final     │
│    Resistivity Cell    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │Effluent Probe >= 18.0 MOhm.cm
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Nitrogen        │
│   Marangoni/SRD Dry    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Operational Baseline Verification & Safety Check**:
   - Confirm safety emergency station: [calcium gluconate gel](docs/context.yaml) must be unexpired and present within direct reach of the bench due to hydrofluoric acid ($HF$) toxicity.
   - Verify that incoming Ultra-Pure Deionized Water (UPDI) into Stage 3 shows an inlet resistivity of $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $25.0^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Ensure constant counter-current weir overflow cascade from Stage 3 $\rightarrow$ Stage 2 $\rightarrow$ Stage 1 with bottom UPW injection at a flow rate of $12.0 \pm 1.0\text{ L/min}$.

2. **Cassette Unload & Transfer-to-Quench**:
   - Immediately upon completion of the timed Buffered Oxide Etch ($6:1\text{ NH}_4\text{F}:\text{HF}$ with $0.1\%$ wetting agent at $25^\circ\text{C}$, nominal etch rate $\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$ on thermal $\text{SiO}_2$), lift the Teflon wafer boat from the etch vessel.
   - Transfer wafer carrier into **Stage 1 (Rough Quench Tank)** within $\le 5.0\text{ seconds}$ to prevent uncontrolled airborne micro-etching and resist peeling.

3. **Multi-Stage Cascade Overflow Progression**:
   - **Stage 1 (Rapid Quench & Heavy Ionic Displacement)**: Submerge and oscillate vertically for $45\text{ s}$ to strip bulk viscous fluoride salts ($[\text{NH}_4]^+$, $[\text{HF}_2]^-$) and surfactant residues.
   - **Stage 2 (Intermediate Cascade Dilution)**: Advance carrier to Stage 2 with laminar overflow for $60\text{ s}$. Counter-current effluent washes away trapped micro-droplets from patterned micro-trenches.
   - **Stage 3 (Precision Final Clean & In-Situ Effluent Monitoring)**: Seat carrier into Stage 3 directly upstream of the fresh UPW supply nozzles. Run overflow rinsing while continuous resistivity data logging is active.

4. **In-Line Resistivity Endpoint & Unload**:
   - Monitor the in-line effluent coaxial conductivity/resistivity sensor downstream of Stage 3.
   - Continue overflow until the cell effluent recovers from ionic dip back to $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (normalized to $25^\circ\text{C}$) and maintains stability for $\ge 30\text{ consecutive seconds}$.
   - Actuate pneumatic lift to extract the boat slowly under an ultra-pure filtered $N_2$ curtain into the Spin-Rinse Dryer (SRD) or Marangoni drying module.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Gate Limit | Measurement Method / Sensor |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Effluent Rinse Endpoint Resistivity** | $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (stabilized $\ge 30\text{ s}$) | In-line temperature-compensated Pt/Toroidal cell probe at Stage 3 overflow drain |
| **Bath Operating Temperature** | $25.0^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ | Dual-redundant calibrated PT100 RTD in cascade tank manifold |
| **Wet Transfer Delay (Etch $\rightarrow$ Quench)** | $3.0\text{ s}$ | $\le 5.0\text{ s}$ maximum | Automated wet-bench robotic arm transfer timer |
| **Counter-Current UPW Volumetric Flow** | $12.0\text{ L/min}$ | $11.0 - 13.0\text{ L/min}$ | PFA ultrasonic transit-time liquid flowmeter |

---

### 4. Context Literature & Citations

1. **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
   - Chemical composition: $6\text{ parts } 40\%\text{ NH}_4\text{F}$ and $1\text{ part } 49\%\text{ HF}$.
   - Physical rates: Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate at $25^\circ\text{C} \approx 100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$).
   - Boundary controls: Constant pH maintenance, $0.1\%$ wetting agent (Triton X-100 or Fluorad) micro-trench displacement, and strict presence of calcium gluconate antidote gel.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Geometrical context: Transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, bitline contact interface, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB). Contaminant-free surfaces required to preserve dielectric integrity and retain cell leakage targets $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:
   - Mask selectivity: Stoichiometric $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard masks exhibit etch rates $< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$ in BOE, serving as chemical barriers during patterned dielectric oxide clearing.
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Oxide Step-Height & Etch Uniformity Verification

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure specifies the metrological inspection protocol for verifying thermal silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) step-height, residual film thickness, and etch uniformity following Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) immersion on 180nm generation DRAM wafers using Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE).

---

### 2. Metrology Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Wafer Load &      │
│       Alignment       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Spectroscopic     │
│     Ellipsometry      │
│      Calibration      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Post-BOE Oxide     │
│      Thickness &      │
│  Step-Height Mapping  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Uniformity &      │
│      Selectivity      │
│      Calculation      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────◇───────────┐
│   Pass Acceptance     │
│       Criteria?       │
│                       │
└───────────◇───────────┘
            │
            ├────────────────────────────╮
         Yes│                            │No
            ▼                            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐    ┌───────────────────────┐
│  Lot Release to Gate  │    │  Trigger OOC Hold &   │
│     Stack / LOCOS     │    │  Etch Recalibration   │
└───────────────────────┘    └───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Tool Initialization & Reference Calibration**:
   - Power on the spectroscopic ellipsometer light source (Xe arc lamp / broadband source, wavelength range: $250\text{ nm} - 850\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform system baseline calibration using an industry-certified calibration standard (native oxide on Si wafer). Verify baseline refractive index of the Si reference standard.
2. **Wafer Loading & Pattern Alignment**:
   - Transfer the post-BOE etched, cascade-overflow-rinsed, and spin-dried 180nm DRAM wafer onto the automated vacuum chuck.
   - Execute optical pattern recognition (PR) alignment targeting the 180nm DRAM cell array scribe-line metrology test pads (adjacent to the 180nm gate access channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ active areas).
3. **Multi-Point Ellipsometric Acquisition**:
   - Collect ellipsometric parameters $(\Psi, \Delta)$ across standard multi-point inspection patterns (minimum 49-point wafer map with 3 mm edge exclusion) at angles of incidence $\theta = 65^\circ, 70^\circ, 75^\circ$.
   - Acquire spectra on both etched $\text{SiO}_2$ recess regions and adjacent $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard mask reference features.
4. **Dispersion Modeling & Step-Height Extraction**:
   - Apply a robust optical dispersion model:
     - **$\text{SiO}_2$ Layer**: Cauchy model or Sellmeier dispersion with nominal refractive index target $n \approx 1.46$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$.
     - **$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ Hard Mask**: Amorphous dielectric model target $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$.
   - Fit experimental $(\Psi, \Delta)$ curves to extract remaining oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$ and calculate step-height differential $\Delta h = t_{\text{ox, pre}} - t_{\text{ox, post}}$.
5. **Etch Rate & Within-Wafer (WIW) Uniformity Determination**:
   - Compute the experimental etch rate:
     $$\text{Etch Rate} = \frac{\Delta h}{t_{\text{etch}}} \quad [\text{nm/min}]$$
   - Calculate Within-Wafer (WIW) etch non-uniformity:
     $$\text{Non-Uniformity (\%)} = \frac{t_{\text{max}} - t_{\text{min}}}{2 \times t_{\text{mean}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Calculate hard mask selectivity ratio $S = \text{Etch Rate}_{\text{SiO}_2} / \text{Etch Rate}_{\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4}$.
6. **Pass/Fail Disposition**:
   - If all criteria meet specifications, release the lot to downstream processing (stacked capacitor / gate stack dielectric formation).
   - If parameters violate acceptance limits, flag an Out-of-Control (OOC) hold, inspect for micro-trench bubble entrapment or bath depletion, and alert chemical processing engineers.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                            ┌──────────────────────────┐
                            │░░                        │
```

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
* **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - Formulated as $6:1$ ratio of $40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F}$ to $49\%\ \text{HF}$.
  - Established thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate baseline of $\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$. Constant pH maintenance ensures uniform dissolution.
* **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:
  - Dense amorphous hard mask film characterized by refractive index $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirmed etch resistance to BOE with hard mask removal rate $< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$, ensuring high etch selectivity ($> 200:1$) over $\text{SiO}_2$.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Contextual integration for 180nm unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ access transistor channels) where precise oxide recess step-heights govern dielectric barrier formation and bitline contact plug clearance.

# SOP: Post-BOE Photoresist Undercut & Adhesion Interface Metrology via CD-SEM

**Hierarchy Level:** Gen 2 (µm) | Metrology  
**Module Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) SiO2 Patterning > Surfactant-Spike BOE 6:1 Dip-Etch Recipe Execution & Cascade Rinse > Multi-Stage Cascade Overflow Rinse and Resist Adhesion Metrology  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Vacuum Mount &  │
│       Load Lock        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Low-kV Beam Setup &   │
│   Focus Calibration    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Resist Profile &    │
│     Pitch Top-Down     │
│       Inspection       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Tilted Stage      │
│       Undercut &       │
│      Delamination      │
│       Metrology        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Acceptance Gate &    │
│   Recipe Disposition   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Chamber Loading:**
   - Retrieve the processed wafer immediately following the cascade DI overflow rinse and complete drying cycle.
   - Verify that the dehydration and HMDS silylation steps were executed prior to coating to ensure resist adhesion integrity.
   - Transfer the 100mm wafer onto the CD-SEM load-lock stage using cleanroom vacuum wands; pump down the chamber to standard vacuum operating pressure ($< 1 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$).

2. **Beam Setup & Anti-Charging Calibration:**
   - Configure electron gun parameters for non-destructive organic photoresist inspection:
     - Accelerating voltage: $0.8\text{ kV} - 1.2\text{ kV}$ (low landing energy to prevent Shipley 1813 film shrinkage or burning).
     - Probe current: $\le 10\text{ pA}$.
   - Auto-calibrate astigmatism and focus on a non-critical peripheral alignment mark.

3. **Top-Down Critical Dimension (CD) & Alignment Inspection:**
   - Translate stage to the target Gen 2 test array and alignment fiducials across 5-point inspection sites (Center, North, South, East, West).
   - Capture top-down secondary electron (SE) images to verify feature pitch and lateral overlay alignment against pre-etch reticle layout.
   - Measure residual photoresist mask width and inspect for gross film peel-off or lifting at line-ends.

4. **Tilted Stage Interface & Undercut Measurement:**
   - Tilt the eucentric SEM stage to $30^\circ - 45^\circ$ along the cleaved cross-section or line edge trench to expose the $\text{SiO}_2$/photoresist boundary.
   - Measure the lateral undercut profile beneath the Shipley 1813 resist footing generated by isotropic BOE etching ($100\text{ nm/min}$ nominal oxide etch rate).
   - Evaluate the methyl-siloxane adhesion footprint to confirm absence of acid penetration/trenching or resist delamination notches.

5. **Data Logging & Wafer Unload:**
   - Record measured CD line width, lateral undercut ratio, and remaining resist thickness across all test sites.
   - Vent the load-lock chamber with dry $\text{N}_2$ and transfer the wafer to the next photoresist strip or oxide inspection station.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Target Metric | Acceptance Criteria Target Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Constraint |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Resist Film Thickness** | `1.30` | $\mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 15\text{ nm}$ across 100mm wafer |
| **Gen 2 Alignment Overlay** | $\le 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Upper specification limit ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$) |
| **Lateral Oxide Undercut Rate** | `100` | $\text{nm/minute}$ | $\pm 10\text{ nm/minute}$ (referenced to $1000\text{ \AA/min}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Resist Interfacial Delamination** | `0` (Zero peel-off / no footing lift) | $\mu\text{m}$ | Continuous methyl-siloxane bonded boundary |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):**
  - *Etch Kinetics & Formulation:* BOE (6:1) consists of 6 parts $40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F}$ and 1 part $49\%\ \text{HF}$, exhibiting a thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate of approximately $100\text{ nm/minute}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$. Constant pH and uniform etch rates are maintained via buffer equilibrium.
  - *Wetting & Interface Protection:* Wetting agent ($0.1\%$ Triton X-100 or Fluorad) eliminates micro-trench bubble entrapment; HMDS vapor priming is required at $120^\circ\text{C}$ to prevent resist adhesion failure and peel-off during acid exposure.
- **Source: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming:**
  - *Film Uniformity & Profile:* Shipley 1813 spin-coated at $4000\text{ RPM}$ delivers $1.30\ \mu\text{m} \pm 15\text{ nm}$ uniform film across 100mm wafers.
  - *Surface Chemistry:* Reactively silylates hydrophilic silanol ($-\text{Si-OH}$) into hydrophobic methyl-siloxane ($-\text{Si-O-Si(CH}_3)_3$) bonds, ensuring resistance against isotropic under-etch lifting.
- **Source: Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
  - *Process Alignment & Film Geometry:* Gen 2 lithography alignment tolerance targets $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ with Shipley 1813 resist (~$1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ nominal thickness).
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)
Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming (Madou - Fundamentals of Microfabrication)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-GEN2-001`
**Title:** Post-Etch Micro-Trench Inspection, Oxide Step-Height Profilometry & Ellipsometric Metrology  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning > HMDS Vapor Prime, Resist Patterning & Wet Oxide Dip-Etch Recipe Execution > Surfactant-Spike BOE 6:1 Dip-Etch Recipe Execution & Cascade Rinse > Post-Etch Micro-Trench Inspection, Oxide Step-Height Profilometry & Ellipsometric Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Buy / Tool Qualification & Metrology  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the metrology protocol for characterizing post-etch $\text{SiO}_2$ micro-trenches following surfactant-spiked Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) immersion. It establishes procedures for optical bubble-entrapment/clearing inspection, mechanical stylus step-height profilometry, and spectroscopic ellipsometry to verify target etch depth, oxide removal completion, and dimensional tolerances.

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Consumables
- **Optical Inspection:** Brightfield/darkfield metallurgical microscope equipped with $10\times$ Plan Achromat objective ($\text{NA} = 0.25$) and high-resolution digital camera.
- **Profilometer:** Contact stylus profilometer with micron-scale stage translation.
- **Ellipsometer:** Spectroscopic ellipsometer (spectral range calibrated for thin-film dielectric stacks).
- **Safety Equipment:** Calcium gluconate gel (2.5%) stationed at metrology area for residual HF contamination hazards, acid-resistant nitrile gloves, chemical splash goggles.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                           METROLOGY SEQUENCE FLOW                                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1] Wafer Handling & Pre-Metrology Safety Inspection                        |
|           - Verify DI cascade rinse completion & dry surface                      |
|           - Confirm calcium gluconate gel presence in inspection bay              |
|                                     |                                             |
|                                     v                                             |
|  [Step 2] Optical Micro-Trench Inspection (Microscope)                            |
|           - Focus via 10x Plan Achromat (NA 0.25) objective                       |
|           - Screen array corners for trapped micro-bubbles / pinholes             |
|           - Measure Gen 2 pattern registration relative to target (±5 µm)         |
|                                     |                                             |
|                                     v                                             |
|  [Step 3] Stylus Step-Height Profilometry                                         |
|           - Position stylus across resist-to-oxide etch trench step               |
|           - Measure step height corresponding to thermal SiO2 etch depth          |
|             (Nominal etch rate target: ~100 nm/min [1000 Å/min] at 25°C)          |
|                                     |                                             |
|                                     v                                             |
|  [Step 4] Spectroscopic Ellipsometric Metrology                                   |
|           - Measure residual oxide thickness in cleared trench bottom             |
|           - Confirm complete dielectric clearing / stop at silicon substrate      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Pre-Metrology Safety & Dryness Check
1. Verify the wafer has completed the cascade DI water rinse and spin/nitrogen blow-dry.
2. Confirm emergency **calcium gluconate gel** is present and within expiration at the inspection station prior to handling any wafer processed through BOE 6:1.

#### Step 2: Optical Micro-Trench & Defect Inspection
1. Mount the wafer onto the macroscopic microscope inspection stage.
2. Inspect the array layout using a **$10\times$ Plan Achromat objective ($\text{NA} = 0.25$)**.
3. Scan micro-trench floors and sidewalls to ensure surfactant action (0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad) prevented micro-bubble entrapment and unetched oxide islands.
4. Verify pattern alignment across Gen 2 fiducials to ensure overlay is within **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.

#### Step 3: Mechanical Step-Height Profilometry
1. Move the wafer to the stylus profilometer stage.
2. Align the stylus traverse direction perpendicular to the patterned oxide micro-trench edge.
3. Perform a 500 $\mu\text{m}$ line scan across the etched step boundary.
4. Calculate the etched step height and verify consistency against the expected thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate of **$\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$)** at $25^\circ\text{C}$ for the executed immersion duration.

#### Step 4: Ellipsometric Film Metrology
1. Transfer the substrate to the ellipsometer sample chuck.
2. Align the measurement beam onto unmasked, etched open-field reference pads and unetched field oxide control sites.
3. Acquire $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ spectra to determine residual dielectric thickness. Confirm full clearing of thermal oxide down to the silicon substrate in etched areas.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermally Grown $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | $\approx 100$ ($1000$) | $\text{nm/min}$ ($\text{\AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$ | Stylus Profilometry / Ellipsometry |
| **Gen 2 Alignment / Feature Tolerance** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Inspection ($10\times$ Plan Achromat, $\text{NA} = 0.25$) |
| **Bubble Entrapment Defect Count** | $0$ (zero trapped micro-bubbles / unetched islands) | Count / field | Brightfield Microscopy ($10\times$ Plan Achromat) |
| **Safety Compliance** | $100\%$ availability (calcium gluconate gel present) | Pass / Fail | Visual Pre-Check Checklist |

---

### 5. Literature Citations & Context Alignment
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):**
  - Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate at $25^\circ\text{C}$ is approximately $100\text{ nm/minute}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) in BOE 6:1 ($6\text{ parts } 40\%\text{ NH}_4\text{F} : 1\text{ part } 49\%\text{ HF}$).
  - Surfactant wetting agent (0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad) requirement to eliminate bubble entrapment in micro-trenches.
  - Mandatory presence of calcium gluconate gel for HF safety.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
  - Microscope optical configuration: $10\times$ Plan Achromat objective ($\text{NA} = 0.25$).
  - Alignment tolerance progression: Gen 2 tolerance specified at $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (improving from Gen 1 $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology (DRAM Foundation VN):**
  - Integration baseline for 180nm bitline/stacked capacitor integration requiring clean post-etch profile control.
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)
