# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-BOE-002`  
**Title:** Post-BOE Etch Trench Step-Height Profilometry Recipe Setup and Scan Execution  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Classification:** Metrology / Physical Verification  

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    1. Wafer Loading    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  2. Recipe Parameter   │
│         Setup          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3. Optical Alignment  │
│    to BOE Metrology    │
│          Site          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     4. Stylus Scan     │
│       Execution        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  5. Baseline Leveling  │
│       and Metric       │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Loading & Safety Verification:**
   - Confirm post-BOE 6:1 wafer has undergone full cascade dump-rinse and spin-rinse-dry (SRD). Ensure chemical fume neutralization is verified.
   - Load wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the stylus profilometer, orienting the wafer notch/flat to the primary home index. Engage vacuum hold-down pressure.

2. **Recipe Parameter Configuration:**
   - Set scan profile length across the trench test structures to span beyond the access transistor region (minimum travel across access active dimensions $W = 220\text{ nm}$ and surrounding scribe line test pads).
   - Set stylus scan speed to $\le 10\ \mu\text{m/s}$ with a low contact stylus tracking force ($1\text{ mg}$ to $5\text{ mg}$) to prevent scratching patterned resist (nominal thickness $\approx 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Set measurement sampling rate and vertical resolution to capture sub-nanometer step profiles.

3. **Optics Alignment to Metrology Sites:**
   - Under motorized high-magnification optical camera inspection, align the crosshairs perpendicular to the BOE-etched $\text{SiO}_2$ trench test structures adjacent to the cell array.
   - Define metrology scan points using an automated 9-point or 49-point wafer map layout to quantify radial non-uniformity across the wafer.

4. **Stylus Profilometer Scan Execution:**
   - Lower the diamond stylus tip gently until the baseline contact trigger confirms surface landing.
   - Execute the linear scan profile across the step transition from the unetched oxide/resist surface down into the BOE-cleared $\text{SiO}_2$ trench bottom.

5. **Data Extraction, Baseline Leveling & Verification:**
   - Apply two-point linear leveling to reference the unetched top surface as $Z = 0$.
   - Extract mean step height ($H_{\text{step}}$) across the trench floor. Calculate nominal etch rate $R_{\text{etch}} = H_{\text{step}} / t_{\text{etch}}$ and correlate against optical baseline ellipsometry indices.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Engineering Tolerance / Range | Measurement Mode / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **BOE 6:1 $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | `100` | $\text{nm/min}$ (`1000 Å/min`) | $\pm 5\ \text{nm/min}$ ($\pm 5\%$) | Stylus Profilometry step height / etch time at $25^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Wafer Mapping Radial Uniformity** | `9` or `49` | points | Full radial coverage tracking | Automated multi-point profilometer mapping |
| **Photoresist Integrity Step Offset** | `1.3` | $\mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 2\ \text{nm}$ baseline verification | Two-point leveled profile step height |
| **Active Transistor Layout Dimension**| `220` | $\text{nm}$ (Width $W$) | Nominal layout alignment feature | Optical crosshair alignment & trench line pitch |

---

## 4. Cited Literature Sources

- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):**
  - Chemical composition: BOE 6:1 (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$).
  - Etch rate: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ is approximately $100\text{ nm/minute}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$).
  - Wetting agent: $0.1\%$ Triton X-100 or Fluorad added to eliminate micro-trench bubble entrapment; photoresist primed with HMDS at $120^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
  - Photoresist film target reference: $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ verified within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
  - Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Tool Setup & Stage   │
│        Leveling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Stylus Calibration   │
│   on Certified Step    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Parameterize Force &  │
│       Scan Speed       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Multi-Site Wafer    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
Establish a reproducible calibration and scan recipe for contact stylus profilometry on patterned oxide trenches (post-Buffered Oxide Etch, BOE 6:1) and interconnect steps. Ensure stylus tracking fidelity without plowing soft films (such as Shipley 1813 photoresist) or chipping brittle dielectric/metal edges.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Check and Environmental Isolation:**
   - Verify acoustic enclosure doors are sealed and pneumatic anti-vibration table pressure is normalized.
   - Clean the vacuum stage using high-purity filtered N2 and cleanroom wiper.

2. **Stage Alignment & Baseline Calibration:**
   - Mount a certified step-height calibration standard onto the stage.
   - Engage optical alignment camera; align standard alignment marks with the stage translation axis within the Gen 2 macroscopic alignment tolerance of **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.
   - Perform a reference scan across the certified step to verify Z-sensor linearity and calibrate the vertical piezo/LVDT gain.

3. **Stylus Force Recipe Parameterization:**
   - Select diamond stylus tip radius ($2.0\ \mu\text{m}$ or $5.0\ \mu\text{m}$, 60° cone).
   - Set contact stylus force appropriately low ($1\ \text{mg}$ to $5\ \text{mg}$ / $\sim 10\ \mu\text{N}$ to $50\ \mu\text{N}$) to avoid plastic deformation or surface scratching on soft Shipley 1813 photoresist layers ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ nominal thickness).
   - Inspect test scan path under high-magnification optical camera to confirm zero visible tip-drag furrows or resist deformation.

4. **Scan Speed and Spatial Sampling Configuration:**
   - Set scan profile length across the target trench/feature (e.g., $100\ \mu\text{m}$ to $500\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Set scan speed between $10\ \mu\text{m/s}$ and $20\ \mu\text{m/s}$ to ensure the tip maintains contact without bouncing or ringing over high-aspect vertical sidewalls.
   - Configure data sampling frequency $\ge 100\ \text{Hz}$ to achieve horizontal point density $< 0.2\ \mu\text{m/point}$.

5. **Multi-Site Post-BOE Trench Run Execution:**
   - Load the post-BOE 6:1 patterned wafer onto the chuck and engage vacuum hold-down.
   - Align wafer die coordinate system within the **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$** Gen 2 tolerance.
   - Execute the 5-point multi-site wafer recipe (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right).
   - Apply automated two-point leveling / baseline tilt subtraction to extract step heights across the oxide trenches and verify uniformity against metal-1 nominal step heights ($350\ \text{nm} \pm 5\%$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance | Detection / Metrology Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage & Pattern Alignment** | $\le 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ | Optical cross-hair coordinate alignment (Gen 2 alignment budget) |
| **Photoresist Film Integrity (No Plowing)** | $1.3$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 0.05\ \mu\text{m}$ | Post-scan profile baseline check & optical inspection for zero gouging |
| **Step-Height Measurement Repeatability** | $350$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 5\%$ ($\pm 17.5\ \text{nm}$) | 5-run repeated scan on nominal M1/step features |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References

1. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
   - *Gen 2 Alignment Budget:* Alignment tolerance baseline of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ for Gen 2 photolithography and metrology registration.
   - *Photoresist Specification:* Shipley 1813 spin-coated at 4000 RPM yields $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thickness with soft bake at 115°C for 60 seconds; guides stylus force limits to prevent scratch indentation.
2. **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects:**
   - *Film Thickness & Step Reference:* Metal-1 interconnect thickness target of $350\ \text{nm} \pm 5\%$ used to benchmark profilometer step-height vertical scale accuracy.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - Transistor channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, bitline contact shared geometry, establishing lateral dimension scaling constraints for sub-micron/micron metrology.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Info
- **Title**: Multi-Site 9-Point Radial Wafer Coordinate Mapping and Automated Scan Run
- **Context Path**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning [Chemical Processing] > Post-Etch Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Profilometry Metrology Inspection [Metrology] > Stylus Profilometry Step-Height & Etch Trench Uniformity Characterization [Metrology] > Post-BOE Etch Trench Step-Height Profilometry Recipe Setup and Scan Execution [Metrology] > Post-BOE Trench Stylus Profilometry Scan Recipe Configuration and Multi-Site Wafer Run [Metrology] > Multi-Site 9-Point Radial Wafer Coordinate Mapping and Automated Scan Run [Metrology]
- **Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Action Type**: Make

---

## 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the wafer coordinate mapping and automated multi-site scanning protocol for post-Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ pattern characterization. It establishes an automated 9-point radial inspection routine across the wafer to evaluate step heights, trench profiles, and radial film thickness/etch non-uniformity across the DRAM cell integration topology.

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Substrate Loading & Vacuum Chucking
1. Retrieve the post-BOE 180nm DRAM wafer from the cleanroom transport pod using Teflon-coated vacuum wands.
2. Center the wafer on the automated stage chuck with primary wafer notch/flat aligned to standard orientation ($0^\circ$).
3. Engage the chuck vacuum and verify solid chuck vacuum hold prior to scan head motion.

### Step 2: Global Coordinate Alignment & Deskew
1. Initiate the optical vision system to detect the wafer center $(X=0, Y=0)$ and notch/fiducial markers.
2. Perform automated two-point or three-point rotational deskew across pattern alignment fiducials to eliminate angular misalignment ($\theta$).
3. Establish global origin reference $(0, 0)$ aligned to the center die.

### Step 3: 9-Point Radial Coordinate Grid Programming
1. Program the automated coordinate recipe to execute a standard 9-point mapping pattern:
   - **Site 1**: Center die $(0, 0)$.
   - **Sites 2–5 (Inner Ring / Mid-Radius)**: 4 orthogonal points at radius $R_1$ (e.g., $(0, +R_1)$, $(+R_1, 0)$, $(0, -R_1)$, $(-R_1, 0)$).
   - **Sites 6–9 (Outer Ring / Edge)**: 4 orthogonal or interleaved points at radius $R_2$ positioned within the edge exclusion boundary.
2. Define the local scan track at each site, aligning the measurement vector perpendicular to the BOE-patterned $\text{SiO}_2$ trench edge.

### Step 4: Automated Scan Execution & Surface Profiling
1. Initiate the automated batch sequence for the 9 mapped sites.
2. At each site:
   - Perform automated autofocus and local pattern recognition to locate the target step-height feature.
   - Gently lower the stylus/optical probe into measurement position and execute the traverse scan across the patterned trench.
   - Record vertical displacement/film profile data.
3. Automatically retract the probe to safe transit clearance height before traversing to the subsequent programmed coordinate.

### Step 5: Data Extraction, Non-Uniformity Mapping & Unloading
1. Calculate step heights, remaining oxide thickness, and etch depths across all 9 measured locations.
2. Compile radial non-uniformity profiles and evaluate measurement dispersion.
3. Move stage to the load/unload position, disengage vacuum chuck, and return the wafer to the carrier lot.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Gauge Repeatability (CV)** | $\text{CV} < 1.0\%$ across 9-point mapping | $\%$ (Coefficient of Variation) |
| **Dielectric Gate Oxide Baseline Precision** | Sub-Angstrom precision within $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Photoresist Mask Baseline Measurement Tolerance** | Within $\pm 2$ (nominal thickness $\sim 1.3$) | $\text{nm}$ ($\mu\text{m}$) |
| **Coordinate Mapping Coverage** | Complete execution of 9/9 radial wafer sites | Points / Sites |

---

## 4. Context References & Literature Citations

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - *Automated 9-Point Wafer Mapping*: Tracks radial film non-uniformity across spin coating, furnace, and etching runs.
   - *Measurement Precision*: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measured with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$); photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) measured within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
2. **Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance**:
   - *Gauge Repeatability & Reproducibility (R&R)*: Must maintain measurement coefficient of variation $\text{CV} < 1.0\%$ across 9-point wafer mapping.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Context for the underlying 180nm unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architectures requiring tight step-height and dielectric layer planarization control.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance (ASTM Standard F84 & Semiconductor Material Characterization)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Trench Step-Height Extraction, Etch Depth Uniformity Analysis, and Standard Reference Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > BOE (6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning > Post-BOE Trench Stylus Profilometry Scan Recipe Configuration & Multi-Site Wafer Run > Trench Step-Height Extraction, Etch Depth Uniformity Analysis, and Standard Reference Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-DRAM180-PRF-002`

---

## 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Calibration       │
│   Verification: NIST   │
│  Step Height Standard  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Multi-Site       │
│   Profilometry Scan:   │
│    Top-Reference &     │
│      Trench Floor      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Step-Height       │
│  Extraction & Cursor   │
│       Levelling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Radial Etch       │
│     Non-Uniformity     │
│      Calculation:      │
│      49-Point Map      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Acceptance Gate &    │
│    SPC Disposition     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Scan Reference Standard Verification
1. Load certified calibration reference standard onto stylus profilometer vacuum chuck.
2. Execute calibration scan across certified step standard. Verify vertical displacement accuracy and linearity against standard limits prior to production wafer loading.
3. Clean profilometer diamond stylus tip with automated solvent brush cycle to eliminate organic particulates.

### Step 2: Multi-Site Wafer Loading & Recipe Execution
1. Load 180nm post-BOE etched wafer onto vacuum stage; confirm vacuum seal ($> 80\text{ kPa}$).
2. Load automated pattern recognition recipe targeting the 180nm isolation/dielectric test trenches adjacent to cell layout structures (cell access channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
3. Execute automated 49-point wafer map scan tracking radial distribution from center to edge. Stylus traverses across unetched hard mask reference planes ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard mask with nominal refractive index $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$) into the BOE-etched trench bottoms.

### Step 3: Raw Profile Baseline Levelling & Step-Height Extraction
1. Apply 2-point linear baseline subtraction across the hard mask shoulders on each side of the trench to correct stage tilt.
2. Place reference cursor band $R$ on unetched surface shoulder and measurement cursor band $M$ across the central 50% bottom plane of the etched trench floor.
3. Extract step height $H_i = \bar{Z}_R - \bar{Z}_M$ for each site $i \in [1, 49]$.

### Step 4: Radial Uniformity Computation & Outlier Screening
1. Compute mean etch trench depth ($\bar{H}$), standard deviation ($\sigma$), and percent radial non-uniformity across all 49 measurement sites:
   $$\text{Non-Uniformity (\%)} = \frac{H_{\max} - H_{\min}}{2 \times \bar{H}} \times 100\%$$
2. Cross-verify profilometry step-height profiles against post-etch spectroscopic reflectometry/ellipsometry thickness measurements for the remaining thermal oxide / pad oxide.

### Step 5: Disposition & Metrology Data Logging
1. Transfer extracted 49-point profile dataset into the Fab Statistical Process Control (SPC) database.
2. Flag any wafer exceeding within-wafer non-uniformity thresholds for review by the Etch Engineering module.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Lower / Upper Spec Limits | Engineering Units | Source Verification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Density** | 49 | 49 (fixed full-wafer automated grid) | Sites / Wafer | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry Context |
| **Nitride Hard Mask Reference Index ($n$)** | 2.00 | $1.98 \le n \le 2.02$ ($\pm 0.02$) | Unitless ($\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$) | LPCVD Silicon Nitride Hard Masks Context |
| **Ellipsometry Reference Precision** | 0.00 | $\le \pm 0.05$ | nm | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry Context |
| **Target Critical Feature Channel Length ($L$)** | 180 | $180 \pm 10$ | nm | 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology Context |

---

## 4. Cited Literature References
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$), folded bitline cell layout geometry, and dielectric layer integration.
- **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks:** Refractive index validation ($n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$) and high etch resistance against BOE (etch rate $< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$) enabling stable profilometric top-reference planes.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:** Automated 49-point wafer mapping methodology for tracking radial film non-uniformity and sub-Angstrom optical measurement precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Node Title:** Etch Depth Profile Extraction, Radial Non-Uniformity Mapping, and Cross-Metrology Correlation  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning > Post-Etch Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Profilometry Metrology Inspection > Stylus Profilometry Step-Height & Etch Trench Uniformity Characterization > Post-BOE Etch Trench Step-Height Profilometry Recipe Setup and Scan Execution > Etch Depth Profile Extraction, Radial Non-Uniformity Mapping, and Cross-Metrology Correlation  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Buy (Metrology Hardware COTS)

---

#### 1. Metrology Architecture & Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Pre-Etch SE       │
│      Measurement       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Post-BOE Etch &     │
│         Strip          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────╮
             ▼                             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────┐
│  Stylus Profilometry   │    │   Post-Etch SE Oxide   │
│      Step Height       │    │       Thickness        │
└───────────┬────────────┘    └────────────┬───────────┘
            │                              │
            │ ╭────────────────────────────╯
            ▼ ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Cross-Metrology     │
│      Correlation       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Non-Uniformity  │
│          Map           │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

##### Step 1: Pre-Etch Baseline Optical Data Extraction
1. Load the pre-etch Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) wafer map database.
2. Verify pre-etch film thickness data acquired via Cauchy dispersion modeling ($n(\lambda), k(\lambda)$) across the standard automated **9-point radial map** or **49-point wafer map**.
3. Ensure dry thermal oxide baseline measurement uncertainty meets precision specs ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).

##### Step 2: Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Profile Extraction
1. Mount the post-BOE etched and solvent-stripped wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the stylus profilometer.
2. Execute line scans across etched $\text{SiO}_2$ step edges at established radial coordinates ($r = 0\text{ mm}$ [center], $r = 25\text{ mm}$, $r = 50\text{ mm}$, and $r = 70\text{ mm}$ [edge]).
3. Apply standard two-point baseline leveling across the unetched oxide terrace and calculate physical trench depth $d_{\text{stylus}}(r)$ at each radial point.

##### Step 3: Post-Etch Optical Thickness & Etch Delta Calculation
1. Transfer wafer to the Spectroscopic Ellipsometry stage and align wafer notch/flat.
2. Measure remaining oxide thickness $t_{\text{post}}(r)$ across the identical coordinates ($r = 0, 25, 50, 70\text{ mm}$) using Fresnel reflection coefficient polarization ratios:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
3. Compute the optical etch depth delta:
   $$\Delta t_{\text{SE}}(r) = t_{\text{pre}}(r) - t_{\text{post}}(r)$$

##### Step 4: Cross-Metrology Correlation & Calibration
1. Compute the cross-metrology discrepancy at each site:
   $$\delta_{\text{metrology}}(r) = \left| d_{\text{stylus}}(r) - \Delta t_{\text{SE}}(r) \right|$$
2. Confirm correlation alignment against the nominal thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ BOE 6:1 etch rate ($80\text{ nm/min}$ to $100\text{ nm/min}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$).
3. If discrepancy exceeds acceptance threshold, recalibrate the optical Cauchy model refractive index parameters against the physical stylus step reference.

##### Step 5: Radial Non-Uniformity Mapping
1. Calculate the wafer-level radial non-uniformity percentage ($NU_{\%}$) using the min-max metric:
   $$NU_{\%} = \frac{d_{\max} - d_{\min}}{2 \times d_{\text{avg}}} \times 100\%$$
2. Log full 9-point/49-point depth profile and generate the radial trend plot.

---

#### 3. Exemplary Radial Etch Depth Profile

```text
                     Radial Etch Depth Profile (nm)     
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
     Edge (70mm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒ │
Outer Mid (50mm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒ │
Inner Mid (25mm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
    Center (0mm)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     25.1      50.1     75.2   100.2 
```

---

#### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Condition | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cross-Metrology Correlation Offset** ($\|d_{\text{stylus}} - \Delta t_{\text{SE}}\|$) | $\le 2.0$ | Max allowable delta between stylus physical step and SE optical thickness delta | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Wafer Radial Etch Non-Uniformity** ($NU_{\%}$) | $\le 3.5$ | Calculated across 9-point/49-point wafer mapping protocol | $\%$ |
| **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | Multi-point repeatability on thin dielectric oxide film ($\approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Thermally Grown $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate Baseline** | $80\text{ to }100$ | BOE 6:1 solution ($6\text{ parts } 40\%\text{ NH}_4\text{F} : 1\text{ part } 49\%\text{ HF}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{nm/min}$ |

---

#### 5. Local Literature Citations
* **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Polarization principle $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$, Cauchy dispersion parameterization $n(\lambda), k(\lambda)$, gate oxide measurement precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$), photoresist thickness tracking ($\pm 2\text{ nm}$), and automated 9-point/49-point wafer mapping.
* **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates**: $6:1$ ratio of $40\%\text{ NH}_4\text{F} : 49\%\text{ HF}$ maintaining $\text{pH} \approx 4.5$, thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate of $80\text{ nm/min}$ to $100\text{ nm/min}$ ($800\text{ to } 1000\text{ \AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$, and high selectivity ($> 100:1$ over Si).
* **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**: Nominal etch rate confirmation ($100\text{ nm/min}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$), bubble mitigation with wetting agents, and HF safety protocols.
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates (Williams, K. - Journal of Microelectromechanical Systems (JMEMS))

## Megasonic Bath & Solvent Degreasing Protocol for Etch Depth Profile Extraction, Radial Non-Uniformity Mapping, and Cross-Metrology Correlation

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Solvent Degreasing   │
│  Tank: Acetone / IPA  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Megasonic Acoustic   │
│       Agitation       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   DI Water Cascade    │
│    Overflow Rinse     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Surface Preparation  │
│    & Profilometry     │
│       Scanning        │
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Preparation**:
   - Verify secondary containment and exhaust airflow at the solvent clean bench.
   - Confirm safety readiness: Ensure hydrofluoric acid emergency protocols are intact following prior BOE handling (calcium gluconate gel must be present and verified on-site).

2. **Solvent Immersion & Megasonic Degreasing**:
   - Immerse post-etch wafer substrate into electronic-grade solvent tank (Acetone followed by Isopropanol) to strip organic residues, photoresist edge beads, and surfactant traces left from buffered etching (e.g., 0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad wetting agents).
   - Engage the megasonic acoustic transducer array to dislodge submicron particulate entrapment and particulate debris from etched micro-trenches without damaging fragile topography.

3. **DI Water Cascade Rinse & Spin Rinse Drying (SRD)**:
   - Transfer wafer carrier rapidly to the deionized (DI) water quick-dump/cascade overflow rinse tank until resistivity reaches > 18 MΩ·cm.
   - Execute filtered high-purity $N_2$ spin-rinse drying cycle to eliminate liquid water marks prior to mechanical contact.

4. **Metrology Alignment & Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Scan**:
   - Transfer the dry, degreased wafer to the stylus profilometer staging chuck.
   - Execute mechanical step-height profiling along etched oxide trench boundaries down to the underlying mask/substrate baseline (referencing BOE thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ nominal etch rate baseline of $\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$ / $1000\text{ \AA/min}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$).

5. **Wafer-Level Radial Non-Uniformity Mapping & Ellipsometry Correlation**:
   - Execute programmed 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping scan to quantify radial step-height variations from wafer center to edge.
   - Transfer wafer to spectroscopic ellipsometer to perform cross-metrology correlation (evaluating $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ across optical models such as Cauchy or Sellmeier parameterizations against physical stylus step-height values).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target & Tolerance | Context / Method Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Profilometry Step-Height Precision (Photoresist Reference Layer)** | $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ | Stylus scan correlated with spectroscopic ellipsometry photoresist thickness baseline ($1.3\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) |
| **Thin Dielectric Metrology Precision (Ellipsometry Correlation)** | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ | Optical measurement of ultra-thin dry oxide films ($3.5\text{ nm}$) |
| **Wet Bench Temperature Stability** | $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ | BOE 6:1 thermal oxide etch rate reference condition ($\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$) |
| **Radial Mapping Grid Coverage** | Standard 9-point or 49-point automated pattern | Radial distribution mapping across wafer diameter |

---

### Cited Literature References

1. **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
   - Established BOE 6:1 (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ : 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$) baseline thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate of $\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Addressed wetting agent residue cleanup ($0.1\%$ Triton X-100 or Fluorad) and required safety presence of calcium gluconate gel.
2. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Established cross-metrology correlation equations ($\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$), Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion modeling, precision targets ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ for $3.5\text{ nm}$ oxide; $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ for $1.3\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ photoresist), and automated 9-point or 49-point radial wafer mapping protocols.
3. **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:
   - Baseline selectivity verification for underlying or adjacent $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ stop/mask layers with index $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$ and high chemical resistance ($< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$ in BOE).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: Etch Rate Calibration & Endpoint Detection for Etch Depth Profile Extraction, Radial Non-Uniformity Mapping, and Cross-Metrology Correlation
- **Process Hierarchy**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning > Post-BOE Etch Trench Step-Height Profilometry Recipe Setup and Scan Execution > Metrology Correlation
- **Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Action Type**: Buy

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     BOE Etch Bath      │
│    Conditioning 25C    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Timed Pilot Etch and  │
│        Endpoint        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Ellipsometry Psi    │
│     Delta Mapping      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Stylus Profilometry   │
│      Step Height       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Cross Metrology     │
│      Correlation       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Etch Safety, Bath Conditioning & Surface Preparation
1. **Safety Readiness**: Verify that calcium gluconate gel is present, unexpired, and accessible adjacent to the wet bench prior to opening the chemical station.
2. **Bath Preparation**: Condition the standard Buffered Oxide Etch bath formulated at a 6:1 volumetric ratio (6 parts $40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F}$ to 1 part $49\%\ \text{HF}$). Add $0.1\%$ wetting agent (Triton X-100 or Fluorad) to ensure liquid penetration and prevent micro-bubble pinning in high-density trench microstructures.
3. **Temperature Stabilization**: Verify the recirculating bath temperature controller stabilizes at exactly $25^\circ\text{C}$.
4. **Photoresist Hardening Check**: Confirm patterned pilot and production wafers received HMDS (Hexamethyldisilazane) vapor prime at $120^\circ\text{C}$ prior to photoresist coating ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ nominal thickness) to prevent photoresist lift-off during immersion.

### Step 2: Etch Rate Calibration & Endpoint Detection
1. **Pilot Rate Calibration**: Submerge a thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ monitor coupon for an initial timed duration (e.g., $60\ \text{seconds}$).
2. **Endpoint Monitoring**:
   - For open-area clearing down to bare silicon or an underlying $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard mask, monitor surface wetting behavior upon removal: bare Si dewets rapidly (hydrophobic sheet break).
   - If stopping on LPCVD Silicon Nitride hard mask, rely on chemical etch selectivity (LPCVD $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ exhibits etch resistance with an etch rate $< 0.5\ \text{nm/min}$ in BOE 6:1 compared to $\sim 100\ \text{nm/min}$ for thermal oxide).
3. **Quench & Rinse**: Immediately transfer the wafer into a quick-dump rinser (QDR) with ultrapure DI water cascade, rinse to $> 15\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ resistivity, and spin-dry under filtered $\text{N}_2$.

### Step 3: Optical Metrology & Radial Non-Uniformity Mapping (Ellipsometry)
1. **Optical Recipe Alignment**: Load the wafer onto the automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometry stage.
2. **Model Parameterization**: Execute dispersion regression fitting using Cauchy/Sellmeier optical models over measured polarization angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ based on the Fresnel reflection ratio:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   For dielectric hard mask layers, verify standard reference refractive index ($n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\ \text{nm}$ for $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$).
3. **Wafer Map Execution**: Run automated 9-point or 49-point radial wafer mapping across the wafer radius to calculate mean film thickness and radial non-uniformity percentage ($\%NU = \frac{\text{Max} - \text{Min}}{2 \times \text{Mean}} \times 100$).

### Step 4: Stylus Profilometry Step-Height & Cross-Metrology Correlation
1. **Stylus Profiler Setup**: Position stylus tip on dedicated cross-wafer test dies across radial zones (center, middle, edge).
2. **Scan Execution**: Execute step-height profiling across the resist-to-etched-trench or etched-oxide-to-hard-mask step boundaries.
3. **Cross-Metrology Correlation**: Correlate physical trench depth $d_{\text{profilometry}}$ with optical remaining thickness $t_{\text{pre}} - t_{\text{post}}$ extracted from the ellipsometer 49-point map. Compute calibration factor and update bath run timer.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **BOE 6:1 Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | $100$ | $1000 \pm 50$ ($95\text{--}105$) | $\text{nm/min}$ ($\text{\AA/min}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / Stylus Profiler |
| **Etch Bath Temperature** | $25.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ ($24.5\text{--}25.5$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated RTD Thermal Sensor |
| **LPCVD $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ Etch Rate Selectivity Limit** | $< 0.5$ | $\le 0.50$ | $\text{nm/min}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Film Loss) |
| **Radial Wafer Map Sampling Density** | $49$ (or $9$) | Exact discrete grid | points / wafer | Automated Metrology Stage Controller |
| **Ellipsometry Gate Oxide Precision** | $3.5$ nominal | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer ($\Psi, \Delta$) |
| **Photoresist Film Thickness Precision** | $1.3$ nominal | $\pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ ($\mu\text{m}$ nominal) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / Profiler |

---

## 3. Literature Context & Source Citations

1. **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
   - *Chemical Formulation & Rate*: BOE 6:1 ($6\ \text{parts}\ 40\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{F} : 1\ \text{part}\ 49\%\ \text{HF}$) produces a thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate of $\approx 100\ \text{nm/min}$ ($1000\ \text{\AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
   - *Additives & Adhesion*: $0.1\%$ Triton X-100 or Fluorad wetting agent prevents bubble entrapment; HMDS vapor prime executed at $120^\circ\text{C}$ ensures resist adhesion.
   - *Safety*: Mandatory presence of calcium gluconate antidote gel for HF exposure.

2. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - *Physical Principle*: Quantifies phase and amplitude ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi)\exp(i\Delta)$ parameterized via Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion equations.
   - *Measurement Bounds*: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\ \text{nm}$) resolved to $\pm 0.05\ \text{nm}$; photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) measured within $\pm 2\ \text{nm}$.
   - *Radial Mapping*: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to quantify radial thickness variation.

3. **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:
   - *Etch Stop Selectivity*: LPCVD $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ acts as a selective stop layer against BOE with an etch rate $< 0.5\ \text{nm/min}$ and optical refractive index $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\ \text{nm}$.

Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Identification
- **Title:** Radial Multi-Point Trench Depth Uniformity Mapping and Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation Analysis
- **Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > BOE (6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning > Post-Etch Metrology Inspection > Stylus Profilometry & Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation
- **Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization

---

## 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Alignment &   │
│   9/49-Point Layout   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Ellipsometric     │
│     Polarization      │
│   Inspection: Psi &   │
│         Delta         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Cauchy/Sellmeier    │
│  Optical Dispersion   │
│          Fit          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Stylus Profilometry  │
│   Step-Height Scan    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Cross-Correlation &  │
│        Radial         │
│    Non-Uniformity     │
│     Verification      │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Loading & Multi-Point Coordinate Alignment**:
   - Secure the patterned 180nm DRAM wafer onto the automated optical inspection chuck.
   - Program the coordinate stage for automated **9-point** or **49-point wafer mapping** across concentric radial zones (center, mid-radius, edge-exclusion zones) to track radial non-uniformity across spin coating and etch runs.

2. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Data Acquisition ($\Psi$, $\Delta$)**:
   - Align the goniometer and optical beam spot over the unetched dielectric/photoresist monitor pads at each programmed radial coordinate.
   - Measure the phase shift ($\Delta$) and amplitude ratio ($\Psi$) of the reflected beam according to the fundamental ellipsometric ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients.

3. **Dispersion Modeling & Film Thickness Extraction**:
   - Parameterize the optical constants $n(\lambda)$ (refractive index) and $k(\lambda)$ (extinction coefficient) using a **Cauchy** or **Sellmeier** dispersion model.
   - Extract the residual $\text{SiO}_2$/dielectric and photoresist layer thicknesses at each radial coordinate.
   - Verify measurement precision against standard film baselines ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ sub-Ångstrom precision on dry gate oxide regimes; $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ on nominal $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ photoresist films).

4. **Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Profiling**:
   - Transfer the wafer to the high-resolution stylus profilometer station.
   - Execute transverse linear line scans across the etched trench boundaries adjacent to the 9/49 ellipsometry test sites to directly capture physical step-height trench profiles.

5. **Cross-Correlation & Radial Uniformity Analysis**:
   - Overlay physical trench step heights measured by stylus profilometry with the optical dielectric film step thicknesses extracted from the Cauchy/Sellmeier models.
   - Compute radial non-uniformity profiles across the 9-point/49-point grid to identify radial etch rate drift and edge-roll-off phenomena.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thin Oxide Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ (Sub-Ångstrom precision on $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Thick Film / Resist Precision** | $\pm 2$ (Measured on nominal $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ photoresist) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Resolution** | $9$ or $49$ discrete radial test sites | points / wafer | Automated Coordinate Stage |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target** | $< 1$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (ensuring refresh target for 180nm cells) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parametric Electrical Test |

---

## 4. Context Literature Citations

- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**:
  - Principles of polarization angle quantification ($\Psi$ and $\Delta$) and the fundamental relation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$.
  - Cauchy and Sellmeier optical dispersion modeling for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Sub-Ångstrom measurement precision baseline ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ for $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide; $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ for $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ photoresist).
  - Standardized automated 9-point and 49-point radial wafer mapping procedures.
- **[Ellipsometry Basics]**:
  - Measurement fundamentals defining the phase change $\Delta$ and amplitude ratio $\Psi$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - 180nm unit cell architecture ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor integration, and maximum leakage current threshold ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure: Radial 49-Point Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Scan Protocol Setup

**Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning > Post-Etch Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Profilometry Metrology Inspection > Stylus Profilometry Step-Height & Etch Trench Uniformity Characterization > Radial Multi-Point Trench Depth Uniformity Mapping and Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation Analysis  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Documentation:** [radial_49_point_stylus_profilometry_step_height_scan_protocol_setup.md](docs/knowledge/radial_49_point_stylus_profilometry_step_height_scan_protocol_setup.md)

---

### Process Architecture Workflow
```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Vacuum Load &  │
│    Notch Alignment    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Stylus Tip & Force   │
│      Calibration      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Radial 49-Point    │
│   Coordinate Recipe   │
│         Load          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Multi-Point      │
│      Step-Height      │
│   Profilometry Scan   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Trench Depth      │
│     Extraction &      │
│     Ellipsometry      │
│      Correlation      │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Tool Initialization and Vacuum Chucking**:
   - Verify acoustic isolation hood is secured and anti-vibration table pressure is stable.
   - Load the patterned 180nm DRAM wafer onto the automated motorized translation chuck; engage chuck vacuum hold-down ($\ge 70\text{ kPa}$).
   - Perform automated pattern recognition on the wafer notch/flat and peripheral alignment keys to establish global wafer coordinates $(X, Y, \theta)$.

2. **Stylus Tip Qualification & Force Baseline Calibration**:
   - Inspect the low-load diamond stylus tip (nominal radius $2.0\,\mu\text{m}$ to $2.5\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Calibrate transducer zero-point against an optical reference flat.
   - Set contact stylus tracking force between $0.05\text{ mN}$ and $0.10\text{ mN}$ ($5\text{ mg}$ to $10\text{ mg}$) to prevent plastic gouging of the $1.3\,\mu\text{m}$ photoresist mask layer during transverse traversal.

3. **Radial 49-Point Mapping Recipe Configuration**:
   - Load the automated radial polar mapping program containing exactly **49 measurement sites**:
     - **Center zone ($r = 0\text{ mm}$):** 1 measurement site.
     - **Ring 1:** 8 sites spaced at $45^\circ$ azimuth intervals.
     - **Ring 2:** 12 sites spaced at $30^\circ$ azimuth intervals.
     - **Ring 3:** 12 sites spaced at $30^\circ$ azimuth intervals.
     - **Ring 4 (Periphery):** 16 sites spaced at $22.5^\circ$ azimuth intervals ($3\text{ mm}$ edge-exclusion zone).

4. **Multi-Point Step-Height Profilometry Scan Execution**:
   - Step sequentially across all 49 coordinate sites.
   - Execute a transverse scan stroke of length $L = 200\,\mu\text{m}$ at scan speed $v = 10\,\mu\text{m/s}$ across the BOE 6:1 etched $\text{SiO}_2$ step transition.
   - Apply two-point linear tilt compensation to reference plane baselines; extract step height ($Z_{\text{step}}$) per ISO 5436-1 standard groove depth algorithms.

5. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation Analysis**:
   - Import the corresponding 49-point optical thickness map measured via spectroscopic ellipsometry ($\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi)\exp(i\Delta)$) parameterized with Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models ($n(\lambda), k(\lambda)$).
   - Cross-correlate physical stylus step-height values against optical dielectric thickness differentials to characterize radial non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                        │░░                            │
   PR Precision (+/- nm)┤░░                            │
Oxide Precision (x10 pm)┤▒▒▒▒                          │
                        │▒▒▒▒                          │
         Scan Grid Sites┤██████████████████████████████│
                        │██████████████████████████████│
                        └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                        0.0   12.2    24.5   36.8  49.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Density** | **49** | Points / wafer | Automated radial coordinate recipe execution log |
| **Photoresist Reference Metrology Precision** | **$\le \pm 2$** | nm | Profilometer/ellipsometry validation on $1.3\,\mu\text{m}$ photoresist |
| **Gate Oxide Optical Measurement Precision** | **$\le \pm 0.05$** | nm | Spectroscopic ellipsometry precision on $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide |
| **Radial Step-Height Profile Uniformity ($\sigma / \mu$)** | **$\le 2.5$** | % | Statistical 1-sigma standard deviation across 49 measurement sites |

---

### 3. Literature Citations
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Validates automated 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
  - Dictates fundamental polarization equation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$ and Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion modeling for $n(\lambda), k(\lambda)$.
  - Provides benchmark measurement precisions: $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide and $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ for $1.3\,\mu\text{m}$ photoresist.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Establishes unit cell geometry constraints ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) and dielectric stack integration topology for the 180nm node.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** Calibration Standard Step-Height Verification and Stylus Tip Radius Qualification
- **Hierarchy Level:** Gen 2 (µm) Leaf Metrology Task
- **Action Type:** Buy (Procurement & Tool Qualification / Standard Calibration Baseline)
- **Context Track:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) SiO2 Patterning > Post-Etch Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Profilometry Metrology Inspection > Stylus Profilometry Step-Height & Etch Trench Uniformity Characterization > Radial Multi-Point Trench Depth Uniformity Mapping and Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation Analysis > Radial 49-Point Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Scan Protocol Setup > Calibration Standard Step-Height Verification and Stylus Tip Radius Qualification

---

## 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the physical verification protocol for commercial certified step-height standards and stylus tip geometry qualification prior to initiating the automated radial 49-point wafer mapping scan protocol for etched dielectric steps on the 180nm DRAM process line.

---

## 2. Process Workflow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Inspection & Mounting: Clean standard in ISO 4 environment; mount on vacuum    |
|    chuck; align calibration trench axes parallel to stage X-drive scan direction. |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Stylus Radius Qualification: Run single-line scan across certified knife-edge  |
|    or calibration standard to calculate stylus tip radius & inspect for wear/chipping.|
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Step-Height Calibration Scan: Perform 5 repeated scans over certified step.    |
|    Apply baseline leveling algorithm (linear fit to upper and lower reference planes).|
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Linearity & Tool Release: Calculate mean step height and repeatability error.  |
|    Unlock the 49-point automated wafer profilometry routine if targets pass.      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### Detailed Steps:
1. **Calibration Sample Loading & Environmental Check**:
   - Inspect the certified physical calibration standard (NIST-traceable quartz/silicon step standard) for particulate contamination under cleanroom green light (ISO Class 4/5 environment).
   - Place the standard onto the profilometer motorized vacuum chuck and engage vacuum.
   - Adjust theta alignment to align the certified step perpendicular to the scan path (within $\pm 0.1^\circ$).
2. **Stylus Tip Inspection and Geometry Qualification**:
   - Set contact stylus tracking force to $0.05\text{ mg}$ to $0.5\text{ mg}$ (sub-milligram range to prevent standard scratching or tip chipping).
   - Perform a qualification sweep across the certified reference tip-check artifact / calibration ridge.
   - Extract the measured profile derivative to verify effective tip radius ($r_{\text{tip}}$) against the manufacturer nominal spec, ensuring no flattened facets or particulate accumulation.
3. **Multi-Run Step-Height Verification**:
   - Perform $N = 5$ repeated forward and backward linear scans across the certified step height.
   - Establish baseline reference regions: Select planar leveling zones of equal length on the upper terrace and bottom trench floor, excluding rounding edges from stylus flight or transition zones.
   - Calculate the step-height value using the standard dual-plane step height algorithm:
     $$h = \bar{Z}_{\text{upper}} - \bar{Z}_{\text{lower}}$$
4. **Data Acceptance & Cross-Correlation Sign-Off**:
   - Verify that the standard deviation of repeated scans meets tool repeatability criteria.
   - Update the tool calibration lookup table (gain factor / Z-LVDT sensor coefficient) if offset exceeds allowable tolerance.
   - Release tool for the 49-point radial step-height scan protocol and ellipsometry correlation runs.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Range | Action on Deviation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Step-Height Measurement Accuracy** | Nominal certified standard value | $\le \pm 1.0\text{ nm}$ (or $\le 0.5\%$ of step height) | Recalibrate Z-piezo/LVDT transducer gain |
| **Step-Height 1-$\sigma$ Repeatability ($N=5$)** | Precision baseline | $\le 0.5\text{ nm}$ (1-sigma) | Check environmental vibration isolation and acoustic enclosure |
| **Stylus Tip Radius ($r_{\text{tip}}$) Integrity** | $2.0\text{ \mu m}$ (nominal diamond tip) | $\pm 0.2\text{ \mu m}$ (wear limit $< 10\%$) | Clean stylus tip in ultrasonic solvent bath or replace stylus assembly |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Baseline** | 49-point radial pattern setup | Complete radial grid coverage without stage stalling | Re-home motorized X-Y stage axes and verify vacuum seal |

---

## 4. Source Citations & Technical Context
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Defines multi-point wafer uniformity measurement protocols (establishing automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity across fabrication runs) and sub-nanometer measurement repeatability requirements for thin dielectric step correlations.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Provides critical cell dimension constraints (180nm gate length $L$, 220nm width $W$, and vertical stacked capacitor architecture requirements) setting the baseline aspect ratio and trench/film step requirements.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms structural thin-film and step-height target baselines including gate dielectric thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$ thermal $\text{SiO}_2$) and stacked capacitor equivalent dielectric film steps.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: 49-Point Polar Coordinate Recipe Programming and Stage Motion Automation
**Hierarchy & Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Post-Etch Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Profilometry Metrology Inspection > Stylus Profilometry Step-Height & Etch Trench Uniformity Characterization > Radial 49-Point Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Scan Protocol Setup  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Process & Automation Flowchart

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Initialize NEMA 17 Stepper & Linear Magnetic Scale (1 µm Res)"] --> B["Homing & Coordinate Transformation: Polar (r, theta) to Cartesian (X, Y)"]
    B --> C["Execute 49-Point Trajectory (Concentric Rings: r=0, r1, r2, r3, r4)"]
    C --> D["Settle Stage Vibration (> 30 Hz Damping Isolation)"]
    D --> E["Stylus Profilometer Contact & Scan Execution"]
    E --> F["Log Step-Height & Cross-Correlate with Ellipsometry Map"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environmental & Motion Hardware Initialization:**
   - Verify stage vibration isolation pads (sorbothane / neoprene dampers) are engaged to attenuate environmental mechanical oscillations $> 30\text{ Hz}$.
   - Initialize precision linear stage drives configured with NEMA 17 stepper motors operating at $1/16$ microstepping on precision ground linear guide rails (MGN12H) and C7 rolled ball screws / anti-backlash lead screws.
   - Power on linear magnetic scales / optical encoders to establish closed-loop feedback at $1\ \mu\text{m}$ resolution.

2. **Stage Homing & Polar-to-Cartesian Mapping:**
   - Home stage axes $(X, Y)$ against mechanical datum stops and zero the closed-loop encoders.
   - Program the 49-point wafer inspection recipe defined in polar space $(r, \theta)$, distributing points concentrically across the wafer surface:
     - 1 center point $(r = 0)$
     - 4 concentric rings with angular increments ($\Delta \theta$) generating 48 radial perimeter points (totaling 49 points for radial uniformity mapping).
   - Convert polar scan targets $(r_i, \theta_i)$ into Cartesian coordinates $(X_i, Y_i)$ in the motion controller:
     $$X_i = r_i \cos(\theta_i), \quad Y_i = r_i \sin(\theta_i)$$

3. **Motion Trajectory Automation & Motion Execution:**
   - Sequence automated motion commands across all 49 coordinate nodes.
   - Maintain stage travel straightness within $< 5\ \mu\text{m} / 100\text{ mm}$ along each linear guide rail segment.
   - Enforce Gen 2 alignment positioning tolerance ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$) at each target coordinate.

4. **Metrology Trigger & Settle Time:**
   - At each target coordinate $(X_i, Y_i)$, dwell for stage settling to ensure mechanical resonances $> 30\text{ Hz}$ decay.
   - Trigger the stylus profilometer head to engage, execute step-height scan across the patterned BOE $6:1$ etched oxide step, and acquire the profile data.
   - Retract stylus to clearance height before executing the next Cartesian motion step.

5. **Data Export & Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation:**
   - Aggregate all 49 step-height profilometry measurements.
   - Map radial step height variations and cross-correlate against 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry thin film maps.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                  Stage Metrology & Motion Targets      
            ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
            │░░░░░░░░                                  │
  Gen 2 Tol.┤░░░░░░░░                                  │
            │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
 Stage Isol.┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  Resolution┤▓▓                                        │
            │▓▓                                        │
Straightness┤████████                                  │
            │████████                                  │
            └┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
            0.0       7.5       15.0      22.5     30.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Units | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Travel Straightness** | $< 5$ | $\mu\text{m} / 100\text{ mm}$ | MGN12H linear guide rail dial indicator / optical displacement |
| **Closed-Loop Positioning Resolution** | $1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Linear magnetic scale / optical encoder feedback |
| **Gen 2 Stage Alignment Tolerance** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical coordinate verification / microscope objective |
| **Vibration Isolation Cutoff** | $> 30$ | $\text{Hz}$ | Accelerometer on sorbothane / neoprene damping base |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **Precision Linear Stage Design & Vibration Damping:** Extruded aluminum 4040 frame with MGN12H guide rails provides straightness $< 5\ \mu\text{m} / 100\text{ mm}$; NEMA 17 stepper drive with $1/16$ microstepping; vibration isolation via neoprene/sorbothane pads for frequencies $> 30\text{ Hz}$; closed-loop positioning via linear magnetic scales at $1\ \mu\text{m}$ resolution.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:** Polar-to-radial multi-point mapping protocols utilizing automated 49-point wafer inspection grids to track radial film and etch non-uniformity across substrate surfaces.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title
**Stylus Profilometry Baseline Scan Execution and Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation Validation**

- **Module**: [Metrology & Chemical Processing](docs/)
- **Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type**: Make / Metrology Execution

---

## 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Pre-Scan Calibration  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    49-Point Stylus     │
│      Profilometry      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Ellipsometry      │
│   Cross-Correlation    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Uniformity & QA     │
│        Sign-off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Tool Initialization & Baseline Calibration
1. Power on the automated stylus profilometer stage and vacuum chuck.
2. Load certified reference step-height standards to verify stylus tip linearity and baseline z-resolution.
3. Verify spectroscopic ellipsometer optical alignment; calibrate polarizer-compensator angles for polarization measurement ($\Delta$ and $\Psi$).

### Step 2: Wafer Loading & 49-Point Recipe Configuration
1. Load the post-BOE 6:1 patterned $180\,\text{nm}$ DRAM wafer onto the motorized vacuum stage.
2. Align wafer notch/flat and establish global coordinate origin $(X_0, Y_0)$ at wafer center.
3. Load the automated **radial 49-point wafer mapping grid** covering concentric radial zones from wafer center to edge exclusion boundary.

### Step 3: Stylus Profilometry Baseline Scan Execution
1. Execute scan across etched $\text{SiO}_2$ step edges at each designated test site of the 49-point pattern.
2. Record physical step height $h_{\text{profilometry}}$ from unetched field oxide/photoresist down to the etched trench floor.
3. Apply standard leveling across baseline plateaus to filter out wafer bow/warp artifacts.

### Step 4: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Acquisition at Identical Sites
1. Transfer wafer or coordinate map to the spectroscopic ellipsometer.
2. At the identical 49 measurement coordinates, measure light polarization parameters:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
3. Apply Cauchy/Sellmeier optical dispersion models ($n(\lambda)$, $k(\lambda)$) to extract unetched film thickness and residual trench floor oxide thickness.
4. Calculate optical step height:
   $$h_{\text{ellipsometry}} = t_{\text{field}} - t_{\text{trench\_floor}}$$

### Step 5: Cross-Correlation & Discrepancy Analysis
1. Calculate delta per site:
   $$\delta_i = \left| h_{\text{profilometry}, i} - h_{\text{ellipsometry}, i} \right|$$
2. Compute radial non-uniformity across all 49 points.
3. Flag any measurement points exceeding allowable tolerance for local defect inspection.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Verification Method | Source Citation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Profilometry / Ellipsometry Step-Height Correlation** | Discrepancy $\le \pm 2\,\text{nm}$ (photoresist baseline level) | Delta comparison: $\lvert h_{\text{prof}} - h_{\text{ellip}}\rvert$ across mapped sites | *Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Thin Oxide Baseline Precision** | Sub-Angstrom precision: $\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$ | Thin gate/tunnel dielectric reference calibration run | *Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Wafer Sampling Density** | Exactly **49 points** per automated radial map | Automated stage scan recipe counter | *Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Critical Geometry Dimensions** | Channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$ reference features | Metrology site feature verification | *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |

---

## 4. Context & Literature Citations

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Fundamental optical relation: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$, modeling via Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion equations $n(\lambda), k(\lambda)$.
   - Precision standards: dry gate oxide ($3.5\,\text{nm}$) measured with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$); thick organic/photoresist layers ($1.3\,\mu\text{m}$) measured within $\pm 2\,\text{nm}$.
   - Mapping protocol: automated 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity across runs.
2. **Ellipsometry Basics**:
   - Confirms measurement of phase change $\Delta$ (delta) and amplitude ratio $\Psi$ (psi).
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Establishes baseline unit cell layout geometry constraints: access transistor channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, channel width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Site Cauchy Film Mapping

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Load Wafer & Align   │
│         Origin         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Execute Automated    │
│   Mapping (9/49-Pt)    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Fit Cauchy       │
│    Dispersion Model    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Evaluate Radial     │
│  Uniformity & Metrics  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the automated optical metrology workflow for mapping dielectric thin film thickness and refractive index across wafer surfaces following BOE 6:1 oxide patterning or lithography, supporting 180nm / Gen 2 architecture validation.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System Initialization & Reference Calibration**
   - Power on the spectroscopic ellipsometer light source and spectrometer detector.
   - Verify baseline calibration using a certified thermal oxide standard substrate.

2. **Substrate Loading & Physical Alignment**
   - Secure the wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the motorized macroscopic mapping stage.
   - Perform optical fiducial origin alignment to within Gen 2 mechanical alignment tolerances ($\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$).

3. **Multi-Point Automated Scan Routine Execution**
   - Configure the recipe for automated multi-site mapping using either a **9-point** or **49-point** radial grid distribution.
   - Measure spectroscopic reflection parameters across the designated spectrum: phase change ($\Delta$) and amplitude ratio angle ($\Psi$), governed by the complex Fresnel reflection coefficient ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$

4. **Cauchy Dispersion Model Regression & Extraction**
   - Parameterize transparent dielectric film optical constants across wavelength $\lambda$ using the Cauchy dispersion model:
     $$n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
   - Perform regression fit to solve simultaneously for local film thickness $t$ and dispersion coefficients.

5. **Cross-Correlation & Radial Non-Uniformity Verification**
   - Generate wafer contour maps showing radial thickness distribution.
   - Cross-correlate optical thickness values against stylus profilometry step-height profiles to verify etch trench depth and post-etch remaining oxide integrity.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Motorized Stage Optical Fiducial Alignment |
| **Thin Oxide Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Fit (Gate Oxide Baseline) |
| **Thick Film / Resist Thickness Target** | $1.3 \pm 0.002$ ($1300 \pm 2$) | $\mu\text{m}$ ($\text{nm}$) | Cauchy Dispersion Fit Measurement Precision |
| **Multi-Site Mapping Pattern** | Exactly $9$ or $49$ | points / wafer | Automated Radial Grid Recipe |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **[Ellipsometry Basics]**: Optical physical measurement principle determining phase shift $\Delta$ and amplitude ratio $\Psi$.
- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**:
  - Fundamental reflection equation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$.
  - Cauchy dispersion parameterization of $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Dry oxide measurement precision of sub-Ångström order ($\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$) and photoresist precision of $\pm 2\,\text{nm}$ at $1.3\,\mu\text{m}$.
  - Automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping to track radial non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**:
  - Gen 2 alignment tolerance limit of $\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$.
  - $1.3\,\mu\text{m}$ nominal film thickness reference for spin-coated organic/dielectric layers.
citations: Ellipsometry Basics (Optical Handbook)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Cross-Correlation & Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Statistical Analysis

### 1. Process Overview & Context
This SOP defines the mathematical modeling, cross-correlation, and within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) statistical qualification for post-etch patterned $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric trenches in the DRAM Foundation VN 180nm process flow. It establishes spatial correlation between non-destructive Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (polarization angles $\Psi, \Delta$) and physical Stylus Profilometry step-height measurements following Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Post-BOE 6:1 SiO2 Patterned Wafer"] --> B["Automated 49-Point Metrology Mapping"]
    B --> C["Spectroscopic Ellipsometry: Psi, Delta Modeling"]
    B --> D["Stylus Profilometry: Trench Step-Height Measurement"]
    C --> E["Cross-Correlation Regression Analysis"]
    D --> E
    E --> F["WIWNU Statistical Metric Computation"]
    F --> G["Quality Gate: Lot Acceptance / Disposition"]
```

```text
                                                        
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
Edge-Exclusion┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
    Mid-Radius┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
        Center┤████████████████████████████████████████│
              │████████████████████████████████████████│
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      24.9      49.7     74.6     99.4 
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Automated Multi-Point Coordinate Alignment & Recipe Setup
1. Load the 200 mm production wafer onto the automated vacuum stage of the combined metrology cluster.
2. Initialize an automated **49-point wafer mapping** grid across the wafer surface with a 3 mm edge exclusion zone.
3. Configure coordinate synchronization between the optical stage (Spectroscopic Ellipsometer) and the mechanical stage (Stylus Profilometer) to ensure identical measurement sites $(x_i, y_i)$ for all $i \in [1, 49]$.

#### Step 2: Optical Dielectric Film Acquisition & Dispersion Extraction
1. Measure the fundamental polarization state ratio at each site:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
2. Execute model fitting across the UV-visible wavelength spectrum using parameterized Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion relations for refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
3. Extract optical film thickness $t_{\text{ellipso}, i}$ across all 49 points, maintaining measurement precision tolerances ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ on thin oxide baseline regimes; within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ on mask/thick regimes).

#### Step 3: Mechanical Step-Height Profiling & Physical Trench Verification
1. Position the calibrated stylus profiler at the identical 49 die coordinates adjacent to test trench structures.
2. Perform scan profiles across the patterned $\text{SiO}_2$ step edges to record mechanical physical step-height $d_{\text{profilo}, i}$.
3. Verify that the baseline trench depth matches target etch specifications prior to executing correlation routines.

#### Step 4: Statistical Cross-Correlation Analysis
1. Align the paired data points $(t_{\text{ellipso}, i}, d_{\text{profilo}, i})$ for each coordinate $i \in [1, 49]$.
2. Compute the Pearson correlation coefficient ($r$):
   $$r = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{N} (t_i - \bar{t})(d_i - \bar{d})}{\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{N} (t_i - \bar{t})^2 \sum_{i=1}^{N} (d_i - \bar{d})^2}}$$
3. Perform linear regression $d_{\text{profilo}} = \alpha \cdot t_{\text{ellipso}} + \beta$ to evaluate goodness-of-fit coefficient of determination ($R^2$).

#### Step 5: Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Computation
1. Calculate the mean ($\mu$) and standard deviation ($\sigma$) across the 49 points:
   $$\mu = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} d_i, \quad \sigma = \sqrt{\frac{1}{N-1}\sum_{i=1}^{N}(d_i - \mu)^2}$$
2. Determine percent non-uniformity using both 1-sigma and min-max conventions:
   $$\text{WIWNU}_{1\sigma} (\%) = \left(\frac{\sigma}{\mu}\right) \times 100\%$$
   $$\text{WIWNU}_{\text{range}} (\%) = \left(\frac{d_{\max} - d_{\min}}{2\mu}\right) \times 100\%$$
3. Flag any radial degradation (center-to-edge profile deviations) for BOE bath circulation review.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cross-Correlation Goodness-of-Fit ($R^2$)** | $\ge 0.985$ | Unitless ($0 \text{ to } 1.0$) | Linear regression between $t_{\text{ellipso}}$ and $d_{\text{profilo}}$ |
| **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Precision** | $\le \pm 0.05$ (dry oxide) / $\le \pm 2.0$ (thick film) | $\text{nm}$ | Multi-site repeatability on reference targets |
| **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity ($\text{WIWNU}_{1\sigma}$)** | $\le 2.50\%$ | $\%$ | 49-point spatial thickness standard deviation |
| **Wafer Edge-to-Center Delta Range** | $\le 3.0\%$ | $\%$ | Normalized radial min-max variation $[(d_{\max}-d_{\min})/(2\mu)]$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - *Governing Principles:* Non-destructive optical polarization tracking quantified via $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ using Cauchy / Sellmeier dispersion models for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Spatial & Precision Standards:* Utilized the automated **49-point wafer mapping** schema and confirmed optical measurement precision benchmarks ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ sub-Angstrom dry oxide precision and $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ photoresist/dielectric precision limits).
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity (Schroder, D. - Semiconductor Material and Device Characterization)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
