nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Info
- **Title:** 9-Point Multi-Site Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Profilometry Data Ingestion Protocol
- **Process Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) $\text{SiO}_2$ Patterning > Post-Etch Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Profilometry Metrology Inspection > Stylus Profilometry Step-Height & Etch Trench Uniformity Characterization > Radial Multi-Point Trench Depth Uniformity Mapping and Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation Analysis > Cross-Correlation & Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Statistical Analysis > 9-Point Multi-Site Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Profilometry Data Ingestion Protocol
- **Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Action Type:** Buy / Ingestion Protocol

---

## 1. Objective & Scope
This SOP defines the ingestion, validation, and cross-correlation protocol for 9-point multi-site spectroscopic ellipsometry and stylus profilometry datasets. The protocol monitors film thickness, step height, and within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) across 180nm DRAM patterned and planar dielectric stacks (gate oxide, photoresist masks, and capacitor dielectric films).

---

## 2. Process Flow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
  +--------------------------------------------------------------+
  | 1. Wafer Alignment & Ingestion Configuration                 |
  |    - Load coordinate map: Center + 8 radial sites (9 points) |
  +------------------------------+-------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +--------------------------------------------------------------+
  | 2. Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Acquisition                    |
  |    - Measure Psi (Ψ) and Delta (Δ) over spectral range       |
  |    - Solve rho = r_p / r_s = tan(Psi) * exp(i * Delta)       |
  |    - Fit n(lambda), k(lambda) via Cauchy or Sellmeier models |
  +------------------------------+-------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +--------------------------------------------------------------+
  | 3. Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Extraction                |
  |    - Traverse etch trench boundary across identical 9 sites  |
  |    - Ingest physical step height data                        |
  +------------------------------+-------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +--------------------------------------------------------------+
  | 4. Cross-Correlation & Quality Screening                     |
  |    - Cross-reference optical thickness vs. stylus trench     |
  |    - Ingest into DRAM Foundation VN metrology database       |
  +--------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### Step 1: Recipe & Site Map Initialization
1. Ingest the automated 9-point wafer mapping grid layout: Site 1 at wafer center $(0, 0)$, and Sites 2–9 distributed symmetrically across radial zones to capture within-wafer non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
2. Initialize data ingestion channels for both the spectroscopic ellipsometer and stylus profilometer.

### Step 2: Optical Polarimetry Data Ingestion & Modeling
1. Collect the raw polarization angles $\Psi$ (amplitude ratio) and $\Delta$ (phase difference) from each of the 9 inspection sites.
2. Compute the fundamental reflection coefficient ratio:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
3. Apply Cauchy or Sellmeier optical dispersion parameterization for refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ to fit thin film thickness across the spectrum.

### Step 3: Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Correlation
1. Ingest stylus profilometer scan profiles aligned to the corresponding 9 etched trench sites.
2. Extract physical step heights and correlate against the optical thickness extracted via ellipsometry at adjacent dielectric boundaries.

### Step 4: Outlier Screening & Database Commitment
1. Check measurement residuals against precision limits ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ for ultra-thin gate oxides; $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ for thick photoresist films).
2. Format validated 9-point arrays into the central DRAM Foundation VN metrology pipeline.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Precision | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thin Oxide Measurement Precision** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ (Dry gate oxide) | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (Sub-Angstrom precision) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($n, k$ Cauchy/Sellmeier fit) |
| **Thick Mask/Resist Measurement Precision** | $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ (Photoresist) | $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Profilometer Cross-Correlation |
| **Grid Inspection Density** | $9\text{ points}$ (Multi-site radial map) | Exactly $9\text{ points}$ logged per wafer run | Automated Wafer Handler & Stage Coordinate Verification |

---

## 4. Context & Source Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:** Validated polarization ratio equation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$, Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion modeling, dry gate oxide measurement precision ($3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$), photoresist measurement precision ($1.3\ \mu\text{m} \pm 2\text{ nm}$), and automated 9-point wafer mapping protocol.
- **Ellipsometry Basics:** Definition of fundamental parameters: phase change $\Delta$ and amplitude ratio $\Psi$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Architectural integration context for dielectric and gate stacks in 180nm DRAM manufacturing.
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Ellipsometry Basics (Optical Handbook)

nodes.label: WIWNU Metric Computation & Radial Profilometry-to-Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation Engine
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-WIWNU-002`
**Title:** WIWNU Metric Computation & Radial Profilometry-to-Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation Engine  
**Project:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Step:** Post-Etch Metrology / Stylus Profilometry & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm / µm scale)  
**Action Type:** Buy / Tool Integration & Computation Engine  

---

### 1. Objective & Principle
Compute Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity ($\text{WIWNU}$) metrics and perform cross-correlation analysis between physical stylus profilometry step-height measurements ($z_{\text{prof}}$) and non-destructive spectroscopic ellipsometry optical thickness measurements ($t_{\text{ellip}}$) across a standard radial multi-point wafer map. This ensures consistent buffered oxide etch (BOE 6:1) profile verification on $\text{SiO}_2$ patterning layers before stacked capacitor module processing.

```
       [Wafer Chuck: Automated Radial Stage]
                        |
        +---------------+---------------+
        |                               |
        v                               v
[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry]   [Stylus Profilometry]
  - 49-point / 9-point map       - Physical trench step-height
  - Optical (Psi, Delta)         - Stylus vertical scan (z_prof)
  - Fit: Cauchy/Sellmeier        - Edge-exclusion zone filtered
        |                               |
        +---------------+---------------+
                        |
                        v
       [Statistical Cross-Correlation Engine]
        - WIWNU Computation: (Max - Min)/(2 * Mean) * 100%
        - Pearson Correlation Coefficient: r(prof, ellip)
        - Dispersion & Residual Calibration
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Optical Metrology Coordinate Alignment & Acquisition
1. Mount the etched $180\,\text{nm}$ DRAM wafer onto the automated optical chuck.
2. Configure the automated spectroscopic ellipsometer for a standard 49-point radial wafer map (or 9-point quick-screening map) tracking radial non-uniformity across concentric annular zones (center, mid-radius, wafer edge).
3. Record polarization amplitude ratio $\Psi$ and phase change $\Delta$ across the wavelength spectrum according to the Fresnel reflection ratio:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
4. Fit the experimental spectra using a Cauchy or Sellmeier optical dispersion model parameterized for the dielectric $\text{SiO}_2$ film over silicon substrate to extract film thickness $t_{\text{ellip}}(r_i, \theta_i)$.

#### Step 2: Mechanical Stylus Profilometry Step-Height Registration
1. Transfer wafer to the calibrated automated stylus profilometer stage with fiducial-guided die-level alignment.
2. Program the scan coordinates to sample identical $(r_i, \theta_i)$ test structures where oxide steps were patterned by BOE 6:1.
3. Perform vertical stylus traversals across isolation trenches with controlled force to avoid film gouging, recording step-height $z_{\text{prof}}(r_i, \theta_i)$.

#### Step 3: Radial Cross-Correlation & WIWNU Statistical Processing
1. Ingest both measurement vectors into the computation engine:
   $$\vec{T}_{\text{ellip}} = \{t_1, t_2, \dots, t_N\}, \quad \vec{Z}_{\text{prof}} = \{z_1, z_2, \dots, z_N\}$$
2. Compute the percent Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity ($\text{WIWNU}_{\%}$) for both datasets using the standard formula:
   $$\text{WIWNU}_{\%} = \frac{X_{\max} - X_{\min}}{2 \cdot \bar{X}} \times 100\%$$
   *(where $X$ is either $t_{\text{ellip}}$ or $z_{\text{prof}}$).*
3. Calculate the Pearson cross-correlation coefficient $r_{\text{corr}}$ between optical thickness and physical step-height across radial tracks:
   $$r_{\text{corr}} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^N (t_i - \bar{t})(z_i - \bar{z})}{\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^N (t_i - \bar{t})^2 \sum_{i=1}^N (z_i - \bar{z})^2}}$$
4. Evaluate residuals $\delta_i = z_{\text{prof}, i} - t_{\text{ellip}, i}$ across wafer radius to detect systematic edge-roll-off or radial etch-rate bias.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ellipsometric Measurement Precision (Thin Oxide)** | $\le \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ (sub-Angstrom) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Cauchy fit ($\Psi, \Delta$) |
| **Thick Film / Photoresist Measurement Tolerance** | $\le \pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Cauchy dispersion |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Resolution** | $9\text{ or } 49$ | points / wafer | Automated Radial Metrology Stage |
| **Profilometry-to-Ellipsometry Cross-Correlation ($r_{\text{corr}}$)** | $\ge 0.95$ | dimensionless coefficient | WIWNU Statistical Engine Engine Output |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - Optical polarization measurement principle: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$ using Fresnel coefficients $r_p, r_s$.
  - Cauchy and Sellmeier optical dispersion models for refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
  - Dry gate oxide ($3.5\,\text{nm}$) measurement precision of $\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$; photoresist ($1.3\,\mu\text{m}$) within $\pm 2\,\text{nm}$.
  - Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping for tracking radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
- **Source: Ellipsometry Basics**
  - Confirmed basic measurement angles: phase change $\Delta$ and amplitude ratio $\Psi$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - $180\,\text{nm}$ cell architecture context: channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$, supporting stacked capacitor over bitline integration.
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Ellipsometry Basics (Optical Handbook)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Metrology Gauge R&R Statistical Verification & SPC Report Generation

### 1. Process Overview & Visual Flow
This SOP governs automated Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility (Gauge R&R) statistical verification and Statistical Process Control (SPC) report generation across thin-film ellipsometry and surface profilometry metrology tools for 180nm DRAM fabrication (stacked capacitor / BOE oxide patterning line).

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Lot Metrology   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Automated 9-Pt     │
│   Multi-Run Sampling   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Variance        │
│     Decomposition      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Gauge R&R Evaluation  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Generate SPC Report   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Lot Ingestion & Calibration Check**:
   - Mount the designated test wafer lot post-etch and verify environmental parameters within the metrology cleanroom enclosure.
   - Execute baseline optical alignment using Fresnel reflection calibration standards ($\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$) for spectroscopic ellipsometry and reference optical flats for stylus profilometry.

2. **Automated Multi-Point Wafer Mapping**:
   - Initiate the automated 9-point radial wafer mapping recipe across designated coordinates covering center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zones.
   - Run three consecutive measurement trials across multiple operators/chucks to capture total measurement variation ($\sigma_{\text{Gauge}}^2 = \sigma_{\text{Repeatability}}^2 + \sigma_{\text{Reproducibility}}^2$).

3. **Ellipsometry & Profilometry Correlation**:
   - Measure thin dielectric film thickness (gate oxide and ONO capacitor dielectric stacks) using Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion modeling ($n(\lambda)$, $k(\lambda)$).
   - Ingest stylus step-height profilometry data corresponding to BOE trench depths and compute cross-correlation against optical film thickness measurements.

4. **Statistical Gauge R&R & WIWNU Decomposition**:
   - Execute the automated ANOVA variance decomposition script across the 9-point matrix.
   - Calculate Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) and the measurement coefficient of variation ($\text{CV} = \frac{\sigma}{\mu} \times 100\%$).

5. **Automated SPC Report Compilation & Gate Disposition**:
   - Aggregate $\bar{X}$ and $R$ control metrics into the automated fab SPC database.
   - If Gauge R&R metrics meet all acceptance thresholds, automatically flag the lot as PASSED and commit the SPC certificate; otherwise, generate an Out-of-Control (OOC) alarm and lock the metrology chuck for recalibration.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Coefficient of Variation (CV)** | **$< 1.0\%$** | $\%$ | Automated 9-point Gauge R&R ANOVA decomposition |
| **Thin Oxide Measurement Precision** | **$\pm 0.05$** (sub-Angstrom) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry ($\Psi, \Delta$ modeling) on 3.5 nm oxide |
| **Thick Film / Photoresist Measurement Tolerance** | **$\le \pm 2$** | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic reflectometry/ellipsometry on $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ film |
| **Capacitor Dielectric Target Value** | **$\kappa > 15$** (Min Capacitance: $\ge 28$) | dimensionless ($\text{fF/cell}$) | Optical ONO/high-$\kappa$ stack extraction & C-V correlation |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **[Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - *Repeatability Requirement*: Gauge R&R measurement coefficient of variation $\text{CV} < 1.0\%$ across automated 9-point wafer mapping.
- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - *Physical Principles & Dispersion*: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ utilizing Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion models $n(\lambda), k(\lambda)$.
  - *Precision Metrics*: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) precision target of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Angstrom precision); photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
  - *Sampling Protocol*: Automated 9-point radial wafer mapping for within-wafer non-uniformity tracking.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml)**:
  - *Dielectric & Capacitance Targets*: ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stacks yielding effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for $180\text{ nm}$ access transistor architectures.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line **Context Path:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > [Architecture & Integration] > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line [Chemical Processing]` **Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Make --- ### Process Flow Diagram ```text ┌────────────────────────┐ │ RCA-1 SC-1 Clean: │ │ 5:1:1 DI:NH4OH:H2O2 │ │ at 70°C-80°C (10-15m) │ └────────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ Intermediate DI Rinse │ │ 18.2 MΩ·cm (3 min) │ └────────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ Oxide Strip HF Dip: │ │ 1:50 HF:H2O (15-30s) │ └────────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ RCA-2 SC-2 Clean: │ │ 6:1:1 DI:HCl:H2O2 │ │ at 70°C-80°C (10m) │ └────────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ Final DI Water Rinse │ │ & High-Purity N2 Dry │ └────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ### Step-by-Step Procedure 1. **Bath Preparation & Pre-Heating (RCA-1 / SC-1)**: - Prepare Standard Clean-1 bath in a quartz immersion tank with volume ratio: $$\text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH (29\%)} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\text{ (30\%)} = 5 : 1 : 1$$ - Stabilize bath temperature to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**. 2. **SC-1 Organic & Particle Removal**: - Submerge wafer cassette into the RCA-1 bath for **$10 - 15\text{ minutes}$** to oxidize organic surface films and remove light trace metals and particulate contamination. 3. **Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)**: - Transfer cassette immediately to the intermediate dump rinse tank. - Cycle with deionized water of resistivity **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** for **$3\text{ minutes}$**. 4. **Native Oxide Stripping (Dilute HF Dip)**: - Immerse wafers into a dilute hydrofluoric acid bath ($1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) for **$15 - 30\text{ seconds}$** until the silicon surface transitions completely from hydrophilic to hydrophobic (confirming complete native oxide removal). - Perform a rapid DI water rinse cycle. 5. **RCA-2 (SC-2) Ionic & Heavy Metal Decontamination**: - Prepare Standard Clean-2 bath with volume ratio: $$\text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl (37\%)} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\text{ (30\%)} = 6 : 1 : 1$$ - Heat and maintain at **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**. - Submerge wafers for **$10\text{ minutes}$** to remove alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and transition heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$). 6. **Final Rinse & Dry**: - Perform a final dump and overflow rinse using **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** DI water. - Dry wafers using high-purity filtered gaseous Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry / spin-rinse dryer. --- ### Acceptance Criteria (Machine-Measurable Target Metrics) | Parameter | Target Specification | Inspection / Validation Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **RCA-1 Bath Temperature** | $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ thermocouple immersion sensor | | **RCA-2 Bath Temperature** | $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ thermocouple immersion sensor | | **DI Rinse Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Inline conductivity/resistivity probe | | **HF Dip Residence Time** | $15 - 30\text{ seconds}$ | Automated robotic wet bench immersion timer | | **RCA-1 & RCA-2 Duration** | RCA-1: $10 - 15\text{ min}$
RCA-2: $10\text{ min}$ | Automated recipe process timer | --- ### Literature Context Citations - **[Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure]**: - Chemical mixing ratios ($5:1:1$ for SC-1; $6:1:1$ for SC-2; $1:50$ for HF dip). - Bath operating temperatures ($70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for both RCA-1 and RCA-2). - Immersion times ($10-15\text{ min}$ RCA-1; $15-30\text{ s}$ HF dip; $10\text{ min}$ RCA-2; $3\text{ min}$ DI rinse). - Water purity requirement ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water) and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ drying. - **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench] & [Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: - Upstream substrate and dielectric interface integrity context for gate dielectric growth ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide) and low-leakage access transistors ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-WET-RCA-180NM-001`
**Title:** RCA Wet Bench Chemical Prep & PFA Bath Thermal Profiling  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Wet Chemistry  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure specifies the exact chemical preparation, sequencing, and Perfluoroalkoxy (PFA) tank thermal stabilization for standard RCA wafer cleans (SC-1 and SC-2) prior to critical gate oxidation (3.5 nm dry $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C) and stacked capacitor node processing in the 180nm DRAM fabrication line.

---

### 2. Equipment, PPE & Raw Materials
- **PPE:** Cleanroom gowning, chemical face shield, chemical-resistant apron, heavy-duty fluoropolymer sleeves, and neoprene/Viton over-gloves.
- **Baths/Wetted Hardware:** High-purity PFA immersion tanks with closed-loop PTFE-encapsulated immersion heaters and thermocouple feedback.
- **Process Chemicals:**
  - Deionized Water (Ultrapure DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$)
  - Ammonium Hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$, 29% semiconductor grade)
  - Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, 30% semiconductor grade)
  - Hydrofluoric Acid ($\text{HF}$, 49% semiconductor grade diluted to 1:50)
  - Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$, 37% semiconductor grade)
  - High-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$, filtered at $0.05\ \mu\text{m}$)

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|  1. SC-1 Prep (5:1:1 DIW:NH4OH:H2O2) -> Heat 70°C-80°C     |
|     Dip: 10-15 min (Removes organics & particles)         |
+-----------------------------+-----------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|  2. Intermediate Dump Rinse (18.2 MOhm-cm DIW) -> 3 min   |
+-----------------------------+-----------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|  3. HF Oxide Strip (1:50 HF:DIW) -> 15-30 sec             |
|     (Native oxide removal; Hydrophilic -> Hydrophobic)    |
+-----------------------------+-----------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|  4. SC-2 Prep (6:1:1 DIW:HCl:H2O2) -> Heat 70°C-80°C       |
|     Dip: 10 min (Removes alkali ions & heavy metals)      |
+-----------------------------+-----------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|  5. Final DIW Rinse & High-Purity N2 Blow-Dry             |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: RCA-1 (SC-1) Chemical Batching & Thermal Stabilization
1. Charge the primary PFA immersion tank with 5 parts ultrapure DI water.
2. Carefully add 1 part ammonium hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$, 29%).
3. Add 1 part hydrogen peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, 30%) to establish a volumetric ratio of **$5 : 1 : 1$ ($\text{DIW} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.
4. Activate the bath heater controller. Heat and thermally profile the PFA bath until the solution stabilizes within the target operating window of **70°C to 80°C**.
5. Immerse wafer carriers for **10 to 15 minutes** to dissolve organic surface films and dislodge particle contamination.

#### Step 2: Intermediate Dump Rinse
1. Transfer wafer cassettes into the quick-dump rinser (QDR).
2. Execute a continuous cascade dump rinse with ultra-pure deionized water ($18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) for **3 minutes**.

#### Step 3: Native Oxide Stripping (Dilute HF Dip)
1. Transfer wafers to the ambient fluoropolymer bath prepared with **1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$**.
2. Submerge wafers for **15 to 30 seconds** to strip native silicon dioxide.
3. Verify complete surface de-wetting behavior (transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic bare silicon).
4. Perform an intermediate DI water rinse for **2 to 3 minutes**.

#### Step 4: RCA-2 (SC-2) Chemical Batching & Thermal Stabilization
1. Charge the secondary PFA tank with 6 parts ultrapure DI water.
2. Add 1 part hydrochloric acid ($\text{HCl}$, 37%).
3. Add 1 part hydrogen peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, 30%) to establish a volumetric ratio of **$6 : 1 : 1$ ($\text{DIW} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.
4. Heat and profile the bath to steady-state temperature within **70°C to 80°C**.
5. Submerge wafers for **10 minutes** to extract alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and trace metallic impurities ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).

#### Step 5: Final Rinse & Drying
1. Cascade rinse with ultrapure DI water until effluent resistivity reaches $\ge 18.0\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
2. Transfer wafers immediately to the spin rinse dryer (SRD) or manual blow-off station and blow-dry completely with **high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$**.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Procedure & Exact Physical Parameters

### Step 1: RCA-1 / SC-1 Clean (Organic & Particle Removal)
- **Chemical Formulation:** `5 parts UPW / DI H2O : 1 part 29% NH4OH : 1 part 30% H2O2`
- **Bath Tank & Hardware:** Heated quartz or PTFE immersion tank equipped with **1 MHz megasonic agitation**.
- **Operating Temperature:** **70°C to 75°C** (process operating range: **70°C to 80°C**).
- **Immersion Duration:** **10 to 15 minutes** (standard cycle: **10 minutes**).
- **Mechanism:** Oxidative dissolution of organic surface films, micro-etching of silicon (~0.5 nm), and particle dislodgement via zeta potential repulsion.

### Step 2: Intermediate Cascade Dump Rinse (Post SC-1)
- **Rinse Medium:** Ultra-pure deionized water (**18.2 MΩ·cm** baseline resistivity).
- **Cycles / Duration:** **5 dump cycles** or minimum **3 minutes** dump rinse.
- **Cutoff Criterion:** Bath resistivity returns to **> 16 MΩ·cm**.

### Step 3: Native Oxide Strip (Dilute HF Dip)
- **Chemical Formulation:** `1:50 HF : UPW` (or `1:100 HF : UPW`, equivalent to **0.5% to 1.0% HF**).
- **Operating Temperature:** **22°C** ambient.
- **Immersion Duration:** **15 to 30 seconds**.
- **Surface Observation:** Visual verification of transition from hydrophilic to completely hydrophobic (water sheeting and rapid dewetting).

### Step 4: Post-DHF Cascade Dump Rinse
- **Rinse Medium:** Ultra-pure deionized water (**18.2 MΩ·cm**).
- **Duration / Cycles:** Quick dump rinse for **3 minutes** (until effluent reaches **> 16 MΩ·cm**) to neutralize residual fluoride ions.

### Step 5: RCA-2 / SC-2 Clean (Metallic Trace & Ionic Decontamination)
- **Chemical Formulation:** `6 parts UPW / DI H2O : 1 part 37% HCl : 1 part 30% H2O2`.
- **Operating Temperature:** **70°C to 80°C**.
- **Immersion Duration:** **10 minutes**.
- **Mechanism:** Solubilization and complexation of alkali ions ($Na^+$, $K^+$) and transition/heavy metals ($Fe$, $Cu$, $Ni$).

### Step 6: Final Cascade Rinse & Surface Drying
- **Final Rinse:** Multi-cycle UPW dump rinse with **18.2 MΩ·cm** deionized water until resistivity stabilizes at **> 16 MΩ·cm**.
- **Wafer Drying:** Spin-rinse dry or high-purity filtered **Nitrogen ($N_2$) blow-dry**.

---

| **DHF Exposure Window** | $15 - 30$ | $\text{s}$ | Automated wet bench robotic transfer timer |

```text
│  Rinse: 5 Cycles to   │
│     GT 16 MOhm-cm     │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Fill Inspection & UPW Base Charging**:
   - Inspect the quartz or PTFE immersion bath for particulate or residue contamination.
   - Charge the tank with baseline Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) exhibiting a resistivity of **18.2 MΩ·cm**.

2. **RCA-1 (SC-1) Chemical Dispense & Volumetric Ratio Verification**:
   - Dispense reagents according to the volumetric ratio: **5 parts UPW : 1 part 29% Ammonium Hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$) : 1 part 30% Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.
   - Ensure homogeneous dilution prior to energizing bath immersion heaters.

3. **Thermal Stabilization & Process Temperature Holding**:
   - Energize the quartz/PTFE bath immersion heater elements.
   - Ramp and stabilize bath operating temperature within **70°C to 75°C** (process control envelope allows up to **80°C** max).
   - Maintain process immersion setpoint for **10 minutes** (duration window: **10 to 15 minutes**).

4. **Megasonic Agitation Tank Qualification**:
   - Engage the immersion bath megasonic transducer array calibrated at a frequency of **1 MHz**.
   - Verify acoustic coupling across the bath volume to enable micro-bubble acoustic cavitation and zeta-potential particle detachment while controlling microscopic silicon etching at **~0.5 nm**.

5. **Post-Clean Cascade Dump Rinse Qualification**:
   - Transfer wafer carrier to the cascade dump rinse tank immediately after the cleaning cycle.
   - Execute exactly **5 dump rinse cycles** using **18.2 MΩ·cm** deionized water (nominal rinse time of **3 minutes**).
   - Qualify rinse completion when the effluent bath resistivity exceeds **16 MΩ·cm**.

---

| **SC-1 Chemical Bath Temperature** | `72.5` | $70.0 - 75.0$ | $\text{°C}$ | Quartz-sheathed Thermocouple / RTD |
| **Cascade Dump Rinse Resistivity Endpoint** | `> 16.0` | $\ge 16.0$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Effluent Resistivity Probe |
| **Silicon Surface Etch Amount** | `0.5` | Nominal reference | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer |

  - Bath temperature setpoint: $70\text{°C to } 75\text{°C}$ in quartz or PTFE immersion bath.
  - Megasonic agitation frequency: $1\text{ MHz}$.
  - Immersion duration: $10\text{ minutes}$, with microscopic silicon etch depth of $\sim 0.5\text{ nm}$.
  - Dump rinse parameters: $5\text{ cycles}$ with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW until effluent resistivity $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:

  - Thermal window verification: $70\text{°C} - 80\text{°C}$ for $10 - 15\text{ minutes}$; intermediate dump rinse duration of $3\text{ minutes}$.

## Title: RCA Chemical Bath Reagent Formulation & Temperature Loop Tuning
**Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > RCA Chemical Bath Preparation & Megasonic Tank Qualification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Citations:** *Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*; *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation*

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text

│ Pre-Formulation Prep & 18.2 MOhm-cm DI Water Delivery  │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘

                            ▼

│ RCA-1 (SC-1) Reagent Make-Up (5 H2O : 1 NH4OH : 1 H2O2)│
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ RCA-1 Closed-Loop Thermal Tuning & Stabilization       │
│ Setpoint: 70°C – 80°C | Target Duration: 10 – 15 min   │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ DHF Oxide Strip Bath Formulation (1 HF : 50 H2O)       │
│ Ambient Temperature | Process Duration: 15 – 30 s      │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ RCA-2 (SC-2) Reagent Make-Up (6 H2O : 1 HCl : 1 H2O2)  │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ RCA-2 Closed-Loop Thermal Tuning & Stabilization       │
│ Setpoint: 70°C – 80°C | Target Duration: 10 min        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Formulation Setup & Vessel Verification
1. Verify that the wet bench recirculation and heating loops are drained, rinsed, and dry.
2. Confirm DI water supply resistivity indicates **$\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.
3. Inspect quartz/PVDF bath tanks and encased immersion thermocouples for mechanical integrity.

#### Step 2: RCA-1 (SC-1) Reagent Formulation
1. Charge the RCA-1 tank with **5 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$**.
2. Add **1 part Ammonium Hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$, 29%)** under low agitation.
3. Slowly dispense **1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, 30%)** to achieve the verified volumetric ratio of **$5 : 1 : 1$** ($\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).

#### Step 3: RCA-1 Temperature Loop Tuning
1. Initialize the digital PID temperature loop on the RCA-1 heating vessel.
2. Ramp bath temperature to the target operating window of **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. Tune PID loop parameters (proportional gain, integral time, and derivative rate) to eliminate thermal overshoot and hold the solution stable for the **$10 - 15\text{ minute}$** process window.

#### Step 4: Intermediate Rinse & DHF Strip Bath Formulation
1. Ensure the intermediate dump rinse tank is charged and operating with **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** deionized water (rinse duration cycle calibrated to **$3\text{ minutes}$**).
2. Formulate the dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF) native oxide etch bath at a volumetric ratio of **$1 : 50\text{ HF} : \text{H}_2\text{O}$** at ambient temperature for a **$15 - 30\text{ second}$** strip window.

#### Step 5: RCA-2 (SC-2) Reagent Formulation
1. Charge the RCA-2 processing tank with **6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$**.
2. Introduce **1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$, 37%)** under continuous laminar exhaust.
3. Add **1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, 30%)** to complete the verified volumetric formulation of **$6 : 1 : 1$** ($\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).

#### Step 6: RCA-2 Temperature Loop Tuning
1. Engage the digital PID temperature controller on the RCA-2 vessel.
2. Elevate and stabilize the chemical bath to the specified target operating range of **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. Verify loop stability across the required **$10\text{ minute}$** cleaning duration.

---

### 3. Context Source Citations

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Megasonic Transducer Acoustic Power Density Calibration

**Task Title:** Megasonic Transducer Acoustic Power Density Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line [Chemical Processing] > RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Wet Sequence Execution [Wet Chemistry] > RCA Chemical Bath Preparation & Megasonic Tank Qualification [Wet Chemistry] > Megasonic Transducer Acoustic Power Density Calibration [Wet Chemistry]  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm / $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

In 180nm DRAM fabrication featuring high-aspect-ratio stacked capacitors (Crown/Cylinder topologies with sub-400 nm pitch), megasonic agitation provides acoustic microstreaming essential for removing sub-micron particulates during RCA-1/RCA-2 cleaning. Over-power acoustic transients induce mechanical cavitation damage that fractures delicate crown structures, while under-power yields incomplete particle removal. This calibration routine benchmarks and normalizes the piezoelectric transducer array power output across the entire active liquid immersion plane.

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Tank Inspection &   │
│     DIW Degas        │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Piezo Hydrophone   │
│   Grid Positioning   │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  RF Generator Power  │
│     Step Mapping     │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Uniformity Check &  │
│   Tool Certification │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Safety Interlock & Bath Degas Verification:**
   - Confirm bath overflow recirculation is active with fresh Ultra-Pure Deionized Water (UPW/DIW).
   - Ensure the integrated in-line degassing unit reduces dissolved oxygen ($O_2$) content below cavitation-nucleation saturation limits to prevent erratic bubble scattering.
   - Verify tank grounding and RF shielding integrity.

2. **Hydrophone Calibration Grid Setup:**
   - Mount a calibrated calibrated piezoelectric needle hydrophone (piezo-ceramic sensor) onto an automated 3-axis ($X$-$Y$-$Z$) immersion scanner stage.
   - Position the sensor tip at the wafer-plane active region (nominally $30 \pm 1\text{ mm}$ above the quartz/sapphire transducer window face).
   - Initialize scanning boundaries matching the wafer carrier immersion footprint.

3. **RF Generator Frequency & Tuning Matching:**
   - Power on the megasonic RF generator ($0.8 - 1.0\text{ MHz}$ nominal operational band).
   - Engage auto-tuning circuit and confirm reflected power ($P_{\text{refl}}$) is minimized relative to forward power ($P_{\text{fwd}}$) into the piezoelectric array.

4. **Multi-Point Acoustic Power Density Mapping:**
   - Execute a 25-point spatial raster across the horizontal wafer-exposure plane at low forward power setting ($20\%$).
   - Record root-mean-square acoustic pressure ($P_{\text{rms}}$) and calculate acoustic power density:
     $$I_{\text{ac}} = \frac{P_{\text{rms}}^2}{\rho c} \quad (\text{W/cm}^2)$$
     *(where $\rho$ is DIW fluid density and $c$ is the acoustic speed of sound in water).*
   - Increment RF power across operating steps ($40\%$, $60\%$, $80\%$, $100\%$) and document linearity curves.

5. **Uniformity Calculation & Drift Analysis:**
   - Calculate within-bath acoustic power density non-uniformity:
     $$\text{Non-Uniformity (\%)} = \left(\frac{I_{\text{max}} - I_{\text{min}}}{2 \times I_{\text{mean}}}\right) \times 100$$
   - Check for transducer element dead spots or focal hot spots exceeding safe thresholds.
   - Save calibration profiles to the wet-bench process controller and log qualification status.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance Band | Measurement Method / Tooling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Acoustic Power Density ($I_{\text{ac}}$)** | $1.20\text{ W/cm}^2$ | $\pm 0.10\text{ W/cm}^2$ | Calibrated Immersion Hydrophone Probe |
| **Planar Acoustic Power Non-Uniformity** | $\le 5.0\%$ | Upper specification limit | 25-Point Immersion Grid Raster Scan |
| **RF Generator Reflected Power Ratio ($P_{\text{refl}} / P_{\text{fwd}}$)** | $\le 2.0\%$ | Max allowable impedance mismatch | In-Line Directional RF Wattmeter / Generator Telemetry |
| **Acoustic Drift over 30-min Continuous Run** | $\le \pm 1.5\%$ | Peak-to-peak deviation | Continuous Stationary Center-Point Hydrophone Monitor |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:**
  - High-aspect-ratio stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) structures erected via tungsten plug (W-plug) require strictly calibrated megasonic acoustic density limits to eliminate particle contamination while preventing mechanical shear collapse or pattern peeling across dense memory arrays.
* **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:**
  - Highlights tight cell geometry with wordline and bitline pitch at approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ and ultra-thin gate dielectric (~$3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness), underscoring the requirement for uniform megasonic power distribution to prevent localized gate or dielectric fracture during RCA chemical bath processing.

Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation (Levinson - Principles of Lithography & Thermal Processing)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Bath Particle Clearance & Surface Cleanliness Metrology Qualification

**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-MET-180NM-002`  
**Classification:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture  
**Process Line:** Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line [Chemical Processing]  
**Sub-Process:** RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Wet Sequence Execution > Bath Particle Clearance & Surface Cleanliness Metrology Qualification  
**Action Type:** Buy (Procured Wet Bench / Metrology Tooling Verification)

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the step-by-step qualification protocol for liquid particle counts in RCA chemical baths, intermediate rinse tank water purity, and post-strip surface cleanliness metrology. This verification ensures that incoming substrate cleanliness conforms to the stringent interface integrity required for 180nm DRAM stacked-capacitor (COB) plug fabrication and thin gate/ONO dielectric layers.

---

### 2. Verified Literature & Context Citations
* **RCA Chemical Bath Conditions & Rinsing:** RCA-1 (`5:1:1` $\text{DI}:\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) maintained at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{--}15\text{ min}$; intermediate dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for $3\text{ minutes}$; dilute HF dip ($1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) for $15\text{--}30\text{ seconds}$; RCA-2 (`6:1:1` $\text{DI}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$; final high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry (*Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*).
* **Oxide Etch Rate Baseline:** Thermal oxide removal reference rate using buffered chemistries is approximately $100\text{ nm/minute}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$ (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
* **DRAM Cell Topology & Impact:** 180nm stacked capacitor node features access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, with capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ and target leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 1: Inline Liquid Particle Counter (LPC) Sampling       |
  |         (RCA-1 bath & 18.2 MOhm-cm Quick Dump Rinse tank)   |
  +------------------------------+------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 2: DHF Oxide Strip Hydrophobic Wetting Qualification   |
  |         (1:50 HF:H2O for 15-30 s, contact angle inspection) |
  +------------------------------+------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 3: Laser Surface Particle Scanning (LSPS) Run          |
  |         (Unpatterned monitor wafer post RCA-2 & N2 dry)     |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Inline Liquid Particle Counter (LPC) & Resistivity Check
1. Engage the chemical bath recirculating pump and continuous megasonic filtration module.
2. Verify that the intermediate and final rinse tank DI water supplies meet the online resistivity threshold of $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ before loading monitor wafers.
3. Draw an automated 100 mL sample using an inline LPC configured for chemical baths. Ensure background bath counts stabilize under continuous recirculation before introducing qualification wafers.

#### Step 2: Dilute HF (DHF) Oxide Strip & Surface Hydrophobicity Check
1. Immerse a test monitor wafer in the pre-cleaned RCA-1 tank at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{--}15\text{ minutes}$, followed by a $3\text{ minute}$ dump rinse in $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water.
2. Transfer monitor to the $1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ bath for $15\text{--}30\text{ seconds}$ to strip the chemical/native oxide film.
3. Confirm complete transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic behavior (sheeting water break / dewetting across the full active wafer face).
4. Rinse immediately in the dump rinse tank for $3\text{ minutes}$.

#### Step 3: RCA-2 Metallic Clearance & Final Dry Run
1. Transfer the hydrophobic monitor wafer into the RCA-2 bath (`6:1:1` $\text{DI}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) maintained at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$.
2. Perform final $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ cascade DI water rinse and complete high-purity dry nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry.

#### Step 4: Surface Cleanliness Metrology Scan
1. Transfer dry monitor wafer directly to the cleanroom Laser Surface Particle Scanner (LSPS).
2. Measure light point defect (LPD) additions across the surface (binning particles $\ge 180\text{ nm}$ corresponding to critical dimension $L = 180\text{ nm}$).
3. Log results into the Statistical Process Control (SPC) system to qualify the bath for production lot release.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method | Literature Source Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Intermediate Rinse DI Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Inline Conductivity/Resistivity Probe | Standard RCA Wafer Clean Procedure |
| **RCA-1 (SC-1) Bath Temperature Range** | $70\text{ -- }80$ | ${^\circ}\text{C}$ | Integrated Bath Resistance Temperature Detector (RTD) | Standard RCA Wafer Clean Procedure |
| **DHF Exposure Duration** | $15\text{ -- }30$ | $\text{seconds}$ | Automated Wet Bench Robotic Immersion Timer | Standard RCA Wafer Clean Procedure |
| **Critical Defect Size Metrology Threshold** | $\ge 180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Laser Surface Particle Scanner (Channel Binning) | 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) |

---

### 5. Safety & Spill Control
* Hydrofluoric acid ($1:50\text{ HF}$) poses critical safety hazards; calcium gluconate antidote gel must be verified at the bench inspection station before commencing any bath qualification.
* PPE requirements: Acid-rated neoprene apron, heavy-duty face shield, and chemical-resistant sleeves/gloves during bath sampling.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)

# Standard Operating Procedure: Sequential SC-1 / DHF 50:1 Strip / SC-2 Wet Clean & Marangoni Dry

**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-180NM-RCA-001`  
**Node Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Wet Chemistry  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SC-1 Alkaline Clean   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Dump Rinse UPW     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     DHF 50:1 Strip     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Dump Rinse UPW     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SC-2 Acid Desorption  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Overflow Rinse 18.2   │
│        MOhm-cm         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Marangoni Dry      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Station Inspection & Preparation**:
   - Verify all baths are filled with ultra-pure water (UPW) with resistivity at $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   - Ensure cleanroom exhaust and heated bath recirculators are functional.

2. **SC-1 (Standard Clean 1 / RCA-1) Alkaline Organic & Particle Strip**:
   - **Bath Formulation**: $5\text{ parts UPW/DI H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part } 29\%\text{ NH}_4\text{OH} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$.
   - **Bath Temperature**: Maintain at $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$.
   - **Immersion Time**: $10 - 15\text{ minutes}$.
   - **Mechanism**: Oxidizes trace organics, light metals, and continuously removes surface particulate contamination via silicon micro-etch/regrowth.

3. **Intermediate Dump Rinse 1**:
   - Transfer wafer carrier immediately into the quick-dump rinse (QDR) bath.
   - Rinse using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for $3\text{ minutes}$ to eliminate residual ammonium hydroxide.

4. **Dilute HF (DHF 50:1) Native Oxide Strip**:
   - **Bath Formulation**: $50\text{ parts UPW/H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part } 49\%\text{ HF}$ (or $1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$).
   - **Bath Temperature**: Ambient ($20^\circ\text{C} - 25^\circ\text{C}$).
   - **Immersion Time**: $15 - 30\text{ seconds}$.
   - **Surface Observation**: Strip native oxide until the wafer surface undergoes complete transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic (beading off bare silicon without wetting).

5. **Intermediate Dump Rinse 2**:
   - Perform quick dump rinse using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW for $3\text{ minutes}$ until cascade effluent resistivity recovers.

6. **SC-2 (Standard Clean 2 / RCA-2) Acid Desorption**:
   - **Bath Formulation**: $6\text{ parts UPW/DI H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part } 37\%\text{ HCl} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$.
   - **Bath Temperature**: Maintain at $75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ (operational window $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$).
   - **Immersion Time**: $10\text{ minutes}$.
   - **Mechanism**: Desorbs and complexes alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and transition/heavy metal impurities ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$, $\text{Au}$) into soluble metal-chloride compounds.

7. **Final Overflow Rinse & Marangoni Dry**:
   - Transfer wafers to overflow rinse tank charged with continuous $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW until bath reaches baseline resistivity.
   - Transfer to drying module: Apply filtered $\text{N}_2$ Marangoni drying (or high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry / IPA vapor dry) at controlled withdrawal velocity to ensure particle- and watermark-free hydrophobic/hydrophilic boundary drying.

---

### 2. Key Process Parameters

```text
                   Key Thermal & Temporal Parameters    
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │●                                      │
  DHF Immersion┤●                                      │
               │■■■■■■                                 │
 SC-2 Immersion┤■■■■■■                                 │
               │░░░░░░░                                │
 SC-1 Immersion┤░░░░░░░                                │
Dump Rinse Time┤▒▒▒                                    │
               │▒▒▒                                    │
 SC-2 Bath Temp┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 SC-1 Bath Temp┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0      18.8     37.5      56.2    75.0 
```

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **UPW Rinse Effluent Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\ge 18.0$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductivity/resistivity sensor |
| **SC-1 Bath Operating Temperature** | `75.0` | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated bath RTD / Thermocouple |
| **SC-2 Bath Operating Temperature** | `75.0` | $\pm 2.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated bath RTD / Thermocouple |
| **DHF 50:1 Immersion Duration** | `22.5` | $15.0 - 30.0$ | $\text{s}$ | Automated wet bench immersion timer |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **`RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering`**:
  - SC-2 chemistry formulation ($6:1:1\text{ UPW}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$), bath temperature ($75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$), immersion time ($10\text{ min}$), removal of alkali ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and transition metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}, \text{Au}$), and filtered $\text{N}_2$ Marangoni drying.
- **`Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure`**:
  - SC-1 chemistry formulation ($5:1:1\text{ DI H}_2\text{O}:\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$), thermal window ($70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$), immersion ($10 - 15\text{ min}$), intermediate dump rinse ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ for $3\text{ min}$), and 1:50 HF dip ($15 - 30\text{ s}$) inducing hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic surface transition.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Identification
- **Title**: Bath Chemistry Preparation & Bath Conditioning for SC-1, DHF 50:1, and SC-2
- **Subsystem**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Wet Chemistry
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)

---

## 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     PPE & Chemical     │
│  Safety Verification   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SC-1 Make-Up: 5:1:1   │
│     DIW:NH4OH:H2O2     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   DHF Make-Up: 50:1    │
│       DIW:HF 49%       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SC-2 Make-Up: 6:1:1   │
│      DIW:HCl:H2O2      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Thermal Conditioning  │
│    70-80C & In-line    │
│   Temp Verification    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Bath Ready for Wafer  │
│     Lot Execution      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Operational Safety & Station Check
1. Don acid/chemical personal protective equipment (PPE): chemical apron, heavy neoprene/nitrile sleeves and gloves, and full face shield.
2. Verify that **calcium gluconate gel** is present and unexpired within arm's reach of the wet bench.
3. Confirm operational exhaust face velocity and ensure the dump rinse tank supply has a minimum resistivity of $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

### Step 2: SC-1 (RCA-1) Bath Preparation
1. Dispense **5 parts** Ultra-Pure Deionized Water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$) into the quartz/PTFE bath tank.
2. Add **1 part** Ammonium Hydroxide ($29\%\text{ NH}_4\text{OH}$) slowly to the DI water.
3. Add **1 part** Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$) to complete the $5:1:1$ ratio.
4. Activate the bath immersion heater and set temperature controller to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
5. Allow thermal and chemical equilibrium to stabilize before immersion (target processing window: 10–15 minutes per batch).

### Step 3: DHF 50:1 Oxide Strip Bath Preparation
1. Ensure the ambient bath tank is constructed of HF-compatible fluoropolymer (PVDF/PTFE).
2. Measure and charge **50 parts** Ultra-Pure Deionized Water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$).
3. Carefully meter in **1 part** Hydrofluoric Acid ($49\%\text{ HF}$) under continuous laminar exhaust to produce the dilute $50:1$ ($\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HF}$) solution.
4. Maintain the DHF bath at ambient cleanroom temperature ($20^\circ\text{C} - 25^\circ\text{C}$); verify bath uniformity prior to running 15–30 second native oxide stripping dips.

### Step 4: SC-2 (RCA-2) Bath Preparation
1. Charge the designated SC-2 quartz tank with **6 parts** Ultra-Pure Deionized Water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$).
2. Add **1 part** Hydrochloric Acid ($37\%\text{ HCl}$) slowly into the DI water.
3. Add **1 part** Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$) to obtain the $6:1:1$ volumetric ratio.
4. Engage the immersion heater, ramping the solution to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
5. Maintain constant temperature conditioning for at least 10 minutes prior to wafer lot introduction.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░                         │
DI Rinse Resistivity┤░░░░░░░░░                         │
      SC-2 Bath Temp┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
      SC-1 Bath Temp┤██████████████████████████████████│
                    │██████████████████████████████████│
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                    0.0    18.8     37.5    56.2   75.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 Bath Operating Temperature** | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ PFA-sheathed RTD temperature sensor |
| **SC-2 Bath Operating Temperature** | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ PFA-sheathed RTD temperature sensor |
| **Intermediate Rinse Water Quality** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line resistivity cell sensor |
| **DHF Volumetric Mixing Ratio** | $50:1\ (\pm 1\%)$ | Ratio ($\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HF}$) | Automated flow injection metering dispense counter |

---

## 4. Context References & Source Citations
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - SC-1 volumetric formulation ($5\text{ DI H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ NH}_4\text{OH } [29\%] : 1\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2\ [30\%]$) and bath thermal setpoint ($70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$, 10–15 min).
  - DHF dilution ratio ($50:1\ \text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HF}$) and native oxide strip duration (15–30 s).
  - SC-2 volumetric formulation ($6\text{ DI H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ HCl } [37\%] : 1\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2\ [30\%]$) and operating thermal setpoint ($70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$, 10 min).
  - Rinse line resistivity requirement ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - Personal safety mandate: mandatory presence of topical calcium gluconate gel for all hydrofluoric acid handling and bath make-up.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Sequential Wet Bench Immersion Run & Marangoni Dry Execution
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-180NM-004`  
**Process Line:** Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line (180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Batch Load       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  SC-1 Megasonic Tank:  │
│   70-80 °C, 10-15 min  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  QDR / Dump Rinse 1:   │
│  18.2 MΩ·cm, 3 min     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   DHF 50:1 Strip:      │
│   25 °C, 15-30 sec     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  QDR / Dump Rinse 2:   │
│  18.2 MΩ·cm, 3 min     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    SC-2 Acid Tank:     │
│    70-80 °C, 10 min    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Final QDR / Overflow  │
│     Cascade Rinse      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Marangoni Vapor Dry   │
│    Chamber: IPA/N2     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Flight Safety & Bath Initialization**:
   - Verify safety station readiness: Confirm **Calcium Gluconate Gel** is present, unexpired, and accessible adjacent to the HF module.
   - Bath 1 (SC-1): Charge 5 parts DI H₂O, 1 part NH₄OH (29%), and 1 part H₂O₂ (30%). Set bath temperature controller to **70 °C – 80 °C**.
   - Bath 2 (DHF): Prepare 1:50 HF:H₂O solution at ambient cleanroom temperature (~25 °C).
   - Bath 3 (SC-2): Charge 6 parts DI H₂O, 1 part HCl (37%), and 1 part H₂O₂ (30%). Set bath temperature controller to **70 °C – 80 °C**.
   - Resistivity Sensor: Confirm ultra-pure DI water supply is at **18.2 MΩ·cm**.

2. **Automated Cassette Transfer to SC-1 (RCA-1 Clean)**:
   - Command the automated wet bench robotic end-effector to pick up the 180nm wafer boat and immerse it into the heated SC-1 tank.
   - Run immersion sequence for **10 to 15 minutes** at **70 °C – 80 °C** to strip gross organic contamination and light trace metals.

3. **Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR 1)**:
   - Transfer wafer boat automatically into QDR Tank 1.
   - Execute dump rinse cycles with 18.2 MΩ·cm DI water for **3 minutes** to completely clear alkaline residues.

4. **Automated DHF 50:1 Native Oxide Strip**:
   - Transfer wafer boat into the 1:50 HF tank.
   - Immersion dwell time: **15 to 30 seconds**.
   - Surface state transition: Confirm transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic state.

5. **Post-DHF Dump Rinse (QDR 2)**:
   - Rapidly transfer boat into QDR Tank 2 to prevent aerial re-oxidation and fluoride carryover.
   - Execute dump rinse cycles with 18.2 MΩ·cm DI water for **3 minutes**.

6. **Automated SC-2 Immersion (RCA-2 Clean)**:
   - Transfer boat into the heated SC-2 tank.
   - Dwell for **10 minutes** at **70 °C – 80 °C** to desorb ionic alkali (Na⁺, K⁺) and heavy metal contaminants (Fe, Cu, Ni).

7. **Final Cascade Rinse & Automated Marangoni Dry Execution**:
   - Transfer into the final cascade rinse tank until effluent resistivity recovers to **≥ 18.0 MΩ·cm**.
   - Robotically transfer the carrier into the Marangoni dry chamber.
   - Execute low-speed upward withdrawal through a saturated high-purity N₂/IPA vapor interface. The surface tension gradient (Marangoni effect) displaces the water film downwards into the liquid bulk, yielding zero watermark residue across active 180nm transistor channels ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) and high-aspect-ratio capacitor contacts.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 / SC-2 Bath Temperature** | **70 – 80** | **°C** | Inline calibrated PT100 thermocouple sensors |
| **DHF 50:1 Immersion Dwell Time** | **15 – 30** | **s** | Wet bench robotic PLC timer / recipe execution log |
| **QDR Rinse DI Water Resistivity** | **18.2** | **MΩ·cm** | Inline conductivity/resistivity cell at tank inlet |
| **Intermediate Rinse Cycle Duration** | **3** | **min** | Automated dump cycle counter / PLC dwell timer |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical formulation and operating conditions: SC-1 (5:1:1 DI:NH₄OH:H₂O₂ at 70°C–80°C for 10–15 min), 1:50 HF:H₂O dip for 15–30 s (hydrophilic to hydrophobic shift), SC-2 (6:1:1 DI:HCl:H₂O₂ at 70°C–80°C for 10 min), and 18.2 MΩ·cm DI water dump rinses (3 min).
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**
  - Personnel safety constraint: Hydrofluoric acid exposure mitigation requiring calcium gluconate gel on site.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Structural context: Protecting critical device dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) and high-density bitline/plug interfaces from particle and chemical watermark defects.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Post-Clean Defect Metrology, Particle Density Inspection & Contact Angle Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Wet Sequence Execution > Sequential SC-1 / DHF 50:1 Strip / SC-2 Wet Clean & Marangoni Dry > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Post Marangoni Dry   │
│      Wafer Infeed      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Automated Surface    │
│  Particle Inspection   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ellipsometry Native   │
│     Oxide Mapping      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sessile Drop Contact  │
│    Angle Metrology     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Criteria Disposition  │
│       & Release        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Transfer & Alignment Setup**:
   - Transfer the wafer directly from the Marangoni dry exit cassette into the metrology loadlock/handling station under Class 1 mini-environment airflow.
   - Clamp substrate onto the precision motorized stage and verify Gen 2 stage optical alignment within **±5 µm** tolerance using microscope pattern recognition prior to inspection coordinates engagement.

2. **Laser Surface Particle Scanning & Density Metrology**:
   - Perform automated darkfield laser surface scanning across the full wafer active area (excluding a 3 mm edge exclusion zone).
   - Log localized scattering defects and map particle distribution to verify removal of organic and metallic residues post SC-1/SC-2 clean.

3. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Reflectometry Film Mapping**:
   - Position the wafer under the spectroscopic ellipsometer light beam across the UV-visible spectrum.
   - Execute an automated **9-point or 49-point wafer mapping** routine measuring polarization change parameters $\Psi$ and $\Delta$, where the complex reflection ratio is:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   - Apply Cauchy/Sellmeier optical dispersion models parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ to quantify residual chemical/native oxide thickness targeting the baseline regime with **$\pm0.05\text{ nm}$** measurement precision.

4. **Sessile Drop Contact Angle Verification**:
   - Dispense a calibrated sessile droplet of Ultra-Pure Deionized (DI) Water (1.0–2.0 µL) onto designated perimeter and center test dice.
   - Measure static contact angle using automated goniometric side-view optics:
     - Post-DHF strip hydrophobic validation confirms removal of hydrophilic native oxide and complete hydrogen passivation of the bare silicon surface.
     - Post-SC-2 / chemical re-oxidation hydrophilic state confirms complete wetting and absence of hydrophobic organic hydrocarbon contamination.

5. **Lot Disposition & Clean Line Feedback**:
   - Collate particle counts, residual oxide uniformity across the 9/49-point map, and contact angle data into the line SPC dashboard.
   - If acceptance limits are met, release wafer to downstream gate dielectric oxidation / furnace processing; if out-of-spec, trigger re-clean cycle.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical Stage / Align Marks (Gen 2 standard) |
| **Ellipsometry Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi$, $\Delta$ dispersion) |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity Mapping** | $9\text{ or }49$ | $\text{points / wafer}$ | Automated Radial Polarized Reflectometry Grid |
| **Film Thickness Measurement Precision** | $\pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Reflectometry / Ellipsometry |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**:
  - Measurement principle based on Fresnel reflection ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ and Cauchy/Sellmeier parameterization of $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Sub-Angstrom precision requirement ($\pm0.05\text{ nm}$) on thin oxide films and reflectometry precision within $\pm2\text{ nm}$.
  - Wafer mapping protocol utilizing automated 9-point or 49-point grid to track radial film non-uniformity.
- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**:
  - Gen 2 alignment tolerance limit established at $\pm5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.
  - DI water rinse and surface cleanliness requirements preceding high-resolution lithography.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Transistor gate channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) requiring strict gate oxide interface cleanliness to prevent sub-threshold leakage exceeding $1\text{ fA/cell}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)
