# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-RCA-180NM-01
**Title:** Surface Particle & Native Oxide Ellipsometric/TXRF Metrology Inspection  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Wet Sequence Execution > Surface Particle & Native Oxide Ellipsometric/TXRF Metrology Inspection  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Equipment & Pre-Requisites
- **Metrology Systems:**
  - Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (polarized light source, automated motorized stage, Cauchy / Sellmeier dispersion modeling software).
  - Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Spectrometer / Laser Surface Particle Scanner.
- **Substrates:** 180nm DRAM wafers immediately post-RCA clean (RCA-1 $\rightarrow$ DHF native oxide strip $\rightarrow$ RCA-2 cascade dump rinse and spin-dry).
- **Environment:** ISO Class 3 (Class 1) or Class 4 mini-environment with HEPA filtration.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Wafer Loading & Vacuum Chuck Alignment          |
+----------------------------------------------------+
                          |
                          v
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Automated Multi-Point Ellipsometric Mapping     |
|    - 9-point or 49-point pattern                   |
|    - Measure Psi & Delta via Fresnel reflection   |
+----------------------------------------------------+
                          |
                          v
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Optical Modeling & Film Thickness Extraction    |
|    - Parameterize n(lambda), k(lambda) via Cauchy  |
|    - Verify sub-Angstrom precision (±0.05 nm)      |
+----------------------------------------------------+
                          |
                          v
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 4. TXRF & Surface Particle Inspection              |
|    - Check metallic trace limits & particle defects|
+----------------------------------------------------+
                          |
                          v
+----------------------------------------------------+
| 5. Disposition & Cassette Unload                   |
+----------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Wafer Loading and Alignment
1. Transfer post-RCA cleaned and dried wafers in sealed, ultra-clean FOUP/cassettes to the metrology load port.
2. Load wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the Spectroscopic Ellipsometer.
3. Perform optical notch/flat recognition and automated chuck leveling to establish coordinate origin $(X_0, Y_0)$.

#### Step 2: Multi-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Mapping
1. Initialize the automated wafer mapping routine: select either the standardized **9-point** or **49-point** radial pattern across the wafer diameter to assess cross-wafer non-uniformity.
2. Illuminate measurement sites with polarized incident light across the designated spectral wavelength range $\lambda$.
3. Measure the change in polarization upon reflection from the wafer surface, acquiring amplitude ratio $\Psi$ and phase difference $\Delta$ defined by:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   *(where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients).*

#### Step 3: Optical Dispersion Modeling & Thickness Extraction
1. Load the pre-calibrated optical stack model (`Si substrate / native chemical SiO2 / ambient`).
2. Parameterize refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ using the **Cauchy** or **Sellmeier** dispersion model.
3. Fit the measured $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra to extract native/chemical oxide thickness with sub-Angstrom precision target of $\pm0.05\text{ nm}$.
4. Compute mean thickness, standard deviation ($1\sigma$), and radial non-uniformity percentage across the mapped points.

#### Step 4: TXRF and Particle Verification
1. Transfer wafer to the surface inspection module / TXRF chamber.
2. Perform total reflection X-ray fluorescence excitation at glancing angle below critical angle $\theta_c$ to detect trace metal surface contamination (Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn).
3. Scan laser scattering channels to register surface particle count and spatial coordinate distribution post-megasonic clean.

#### Step 5: Lot Disposition
1. Compare ellipsometric thickness, radial non-uniformity, and defect density against established acceptance criteria.
2. If metrics pass, release the lot for gate oxidation / stacked capacitor dielectric formation (effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$). If failing, flag for rework or cleaning line abort.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method / Tool | Action Limit / Trigger |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ellipsometric Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Cauchy/Sellmeier model) | Recalibrate optical light path if residual $\chi^2 > 1.5$ |
| **Measurement Mapping Grid** | $9\text{-point}$ or $49\text{-point}$ mapped pattern | Automated Motorized Chuck Program | Abort if edge exclusion $< 3\text{ mm}$ triggers fault |
| **Megasonic Cleaning Rinse Quality** | $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water resistivity | In-line Cascade Dump Rinse Resistivity Sensor | Hold lot if resistivity $\le 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Target Compatibility** | $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (ensuring refresh interval target) | Automated Parametric / Cell Leakage Tester | Reject wafer lot if junction leakage $\ge 1\text{ fA/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Context References & Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Polarization change formulation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$; Cauchy and Sellmeier optical dispersion parameterization of $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$; measurement precision specification of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Angstrom level); automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping protocols.
- **RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**: Post-RCA cascade dump rinse requirements ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW rinsing until bath resistivity $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$); standard SC-1 megasonic agitation at $1\text{ MHz}$; hydrophobic dewetting transitions.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: 180nm integration targets including access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor dielectric stack requirements ($\kappa > 15$, $C \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$), and cell leakage ceiling ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Calibration & Optical Model Recipe Setup

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Wet Sequence Execution > Surface Particle & Native Oxide Ellipsometric/TXRF Metrology Inspection > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Calibration & Optical Model Recipe Setup  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   System Baseline &   │
│       Hardware        │
│    Initialization     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Standard Reference   │
│    Calibration: Si    │
│  substrate & Native   │
│         Oxide         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Optical Dispersion   │
│   Model Selection:    │
│  Cauchy / Sellmeier   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Target Film Recipe   │
│   Parameterization    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Multi-Point      │
│    Automated Wafer    │
│  Mapping: 9-point or  │
│       49-point        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Goodness-of-Fit &   │
│       Tolerance       │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **System Baseline & Hardware Initialization**:
   - Power up the spectroscopic ellipsometer light source (xenon or UV-visible broadband source). Allow a minimum 30-minute warm-up for lamp spectral stability.
   - Verify optical beam alignment, polarizer, compensator, and analyzer angles using the integrated self-test routine.

2. **Standard Reference Calibration (Straight-Through & Calibration Wafer)**:
   - Perform a straight-through (no-sample) calibration or load a certified calibration standard (e.g., bare Si substrate with known thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ film).
   - Acquire amplitude ratio ($\Psi$) and phase change ($\Delta$) raw spectra across the target spectral range.
   - Confirm baseline signal-to-noise ratio and detector linearity.

3. **Optical Model Definition & Recipe Selection**:
   - Define sample stack: Substrate layer (Silicon) + Interfacial/Native Oxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) + Dielectric/Target film.
   - Assign dispersion relationships to parameterize the refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$:
     - **Dielectrics (Oxide/Nitride)**: Apply the **Cauchy** or **Sellmeier** dispersion model.
     - **Photoresist Layer**: Select Cauchy dispersion parameterized for resist formulations (e.g., Shipley 1813).
   - Set the fundamental ellipsometric equation solver:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are complex Fresnel reflection coefficients.

4. **Measurement Recipe Parameterization**:
   - Configure angle of incidence (AOI) to near Brewster's angle for silicon (typically $70^\circ$ or $75^\circ$) to maximize sensitivity.
   - Set recipe acquisition bounds: Gate oxide mode (target $\approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) or Photoresist mode (target $\approx 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Configure automated stage coordinates for either a **9-point** or **49-point** automated wafer mapping pattern to track radial film non-uniformity across spin coating or furnace thermal processing.

5. **Sample Execution & Regression Fitting**:
   - Vacuum-chuck the post-RCA cleaned/processed wafer onto the motorized sample stage.
   - Execute the selected mapping recipe. Regress experimental $(\Psi, \Delta)$ curves against calculated model parameters to extract layer thickness $d$, $n(\lambda)$, and Mean Squared Error (MSE / goodness-of-fit).
   - Flag out-of-spec measurement points and inspect residual plots for non-uniformity or interfacial roughness anomalies.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Physical Tolerance | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thin Gate Oxide Measurement Precision** | $3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Ångström precision) | Static 10-run repeatability test on calibrated dry oxide standard |
| **Thick Film / Photoresist Thickness Accuracy** | $1.3\ \mu\text{m} \pm 2\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic regression fit on spun resist (e.g., Shipley 1813) |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Density** | **9-point** or **49-point** automated radial array | Automated stage map coordinate execution report |
| **Gen 2 Stage Alignment Tolerance** | $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ | Motorized stage positioning feedback against optical fiducials |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Source: Ellipsometry Basics**:
  - Principles of measuring differential phase change $\Delta$ and amplitude ratio $\Psi$.
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Non-destructive monitoring for oxide, nitride, and photoresist thickness.
  - Governing physical equation: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$ using complex Fresnel reflection coefficients.
  - Dispersion modeling via **Cauchy** and **Sellmeier** formulations for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Precision bounds: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measured to $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$; photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) measured to $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
  - Wafer mapping automation: Standard **9-point** or **49-point** patterns tracking radial non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
- **Source: Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - Resist layer benchmark: Shipley 1813 spun at 4000 RPM giving $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thickness.
  - Alignment tolerance progression: Gen 2 stage precision specified at $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.
citations: Ellipsometry Basics (Optical Handbook)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)

nodes.label: 49-Point Wafer Native Oxide Thickness & Refractive Index Mapping
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 49-Point Wafer Native Oxide Thickness & Refractive Index Mapping

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Load Wafer & Align  │
│        Notch         │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│    Spectroscopic     │
│     Calibration      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│    Execute 49-Pt     │
│   Polarimetric Map   │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│    Fresnel/Cauchy    │
│  Dispersion Fitting  │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│      Acceptance      │
│    Verification &    │
│      Pass/Fail       │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Purpose
This procedure defines the non-destructive spectroscopic ellipsometry metrology protocol to map wafer-scale native oxide thickness ($t_{ox}$) and refractive index ($n$) across 49 polar/Cartesian sampling sites following the standard RCA-1 / DHF oxide strip / RCA-2 wet clean sequence.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System Initialization & Reference Calibration**:
   - Verify optical metrology chamber environment ($21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, relative humidity $< 45\%$).
   - Load clean reference calibration standard wafer (bare Si standard with known oxide thickness).
   - Calibrate the rotating analyzer/polarizer optics across the UV-visible spectrum ($\lambda = 250\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$) to zero baseline phase offset.

2. **Wafer Loading & Pre-Alignment**:
   - Transfer the post-clean 200mm wafer onto the vacuum chuck via automated end-effector.
   - Engage vacuum chucking and run optical notch/flat pre-alignment to establish the wafer coordinate origin $(0, 0)$ at the center of the wafer.

3. **Recipe Selection & Model Definition**:
   - Load the standard `49PT_NATIVE_OXIDE_MAP` polar/Cartesian coordinate recipe.
   - Configure optical model parameters:
     - Substrate: Single-crystal Silicon ($\text{c-Si}$).
     - Ambient: Air ($n = 1.000$).
     - Overlayer: Native Silicon Dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) parameterized by the Cauchy dispersion model $n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2}$ with extinction coefficient $k(\lambda) = 0$.

4. **Polarimetric 49-Point Acquisition**:
   - Set incidence angle $\Phi = 70.0^\circ$ (Brewster angle regime for $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$ interface sensitivity).
   - Systematically step the wafer stage across all 49 radial and azimuthal coordinates.
   - At each site, measure the polarization amplitude ratio ($\Psi$) and phase difference ($\Delta$) according to the fundamental Fresnel reflectance ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$

5. **Dispersion Fitting & Wafer Map Generation**:
   - Execute non-linear regression (Levenberg-Marquardt) fitting to determine $t_{ox}$ and $n$ per coordinate.
   - Generate full-wafer contour maps displaying radial film uniformity, center-to-edge profile, and total thickness variation across the 49 points.

6. **Post-Inspection Unload**:
   - Verify mean thickness, standard deviation ($1\sigma$), and goodness-of-fit (MSE).
   - Release vacuum chuck and transfer wafer to FOUP/carrier for gate dielectric furnace processing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Precision | Context Citation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Precision (Dry Oxide / Thin Oxide Regime)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal baseline | Sub-Angstrom precision: $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ | *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Grid Mapping Point Density** | Automated grid array | Exactly $49\text{ points}$ | *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Dispersion Parameterization Model** | Optical fitting model | Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion [$n(\lambda)$, $k(\lambda)$] | *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* |
| **Gate Dielectric Baseline Target (Post-Oxidation Reference)** | $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation | Physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Principles: Polarization ratio $\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Optical modeling via Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Precision: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
  - Grid inspection: Automated 49-point wafer mapping for radial film non-uniformity tracking.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation target physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Trace Metal & Surface Particle Qualification

**Module:** Metrology / Wet Chemistry Clean Qualification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Node)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Benchtop / Automated TXRF Metrology Tool)  
**Parent Process:** Surface Particle & Native Oxide Ellipsometric/TXRF Metrology Inspection after RCA-1 / DHF Oxide Strip / RCA-2 Sequence  

---

### 1. Principle & Operational Workflow

Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) inspects silicon wafer surfaces for critical transition metal contamination (such as Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn) down to trace levels ($< 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$) along with complementary optical/ellipsometric thickness checks. Incident X-rays strike the surface below the critical angle of total external reflection ($\Phi_c \approx 0.1^\circ$), preventing penetration into the silicon bulk and exciting only surface-layer impurities to safeguard DRAM capacitor junctions and gate oxide integrity against leakage.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Step 1: Automated Load & Pre-Alignment"] --> B["Step 2: Total Reflection Angle Calibration (Φ < Φc)"]
    B --> C["Step 3: Multi-Point TXRF Spectrum Acquisition"]
    C --> D["Step 4: Complementary Ellipsometric Confirmation"]
    D --> E["Step 5: Wafer Pass/Fail Dispo & Recipe Handshake"]
```

#### Step-by-Step Procedure:
1. **Wafer Transfer & Pre-Alignment:**
   - Transfer the cleaned test wafer from the RCA-1/DHF/RCA-2 wet bench output cassette to the TXRF tool loadlock using automated edge-handling end-effectors under cleanroom ISO Class 1 conditions.
   - Run notch/flat pre-alignment to lock wafer orientation (0° reference).

2. **Angle Calibration & Critical Angle Tuning:**
   - Adjust the incident X-ray beam angle ($\Phi$) below the total reflection critical threshold ($\Phi \approx 0.05^\circ - 0.10^\circ$) via automated goniometer fine-pitch rocking curve alignment.
   - Verify minimal silicon substrate background scatter ($I_{\text{Si-K}\alpha}$) to ensure true surface sensitivity.

3. **Multi-Point TXRF Trace Metal Acquisition:**
   - Execute an automated radial scan (e.g., center, half-radius, and edge-exclusion boundary at 3 mm) using Mo-$K\alpha$ or W-target excitation.
   - Collect fluorescent X-ray photons via Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) for a calibrated live time (typically 300–600 s/point).
   - Integrate peak areas for transition metals (Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn) that act as deep-level recombination-generation traps detrimental to retention time.

4. **Correlated Native Oxide/Dielectric Ellipsometric Check:**
   - For wafers processed through DHF oxide strip prior to clean finish, measure residual chemical or native oxide via Spectroscopic Ellipsometry on an automated 9-point or 49-point wafer map tracking parameter angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$.

5. **Data Logging & Clean Bench Feedback:**
   - Extract areal elemental density ($\text{atoms/cm}^2$) per point against verified reference calibration standards.
   - Log data to the fab metrology database and release the lot for gate oxide growth or stacked capacitor processing.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Leakage Current Budget Baseline** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell (at } 85^\circ\text{C)}$ | Parametric electrical test / junction leakage qualification |
| **Cell Capacitance Target** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Metrology C-V qualification on stacked capacitor monitor |
| **Gate / Native Dielectric Thickness Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ (sub-Ångstrom precision on thin oxide target of $3.5\text{ nm}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi$, $\Delta$ dispersion mapping) |
| **Radial Wafer Mapping Density** | $9\text{-point or } 49\text{-point}$ | Points / Wafer | Automated wafer map tracking radial non-uniformity |

---

### 3. Citations & Literature Context

- **Capacitance & Leakage Limits:**
  - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
    *"Capacitance Budget: Minimum 28 fF per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance. Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval..."* (Trace metal qualification directly safeguards this junction leakage budget).
- **Ellipsometric Precision & Wafer Map Tracking:**
  - *Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*  
    *"Measurement Precision: Dry gate oxide (3.5 nm) measured with sub-Angstrom precision (±0.05 nm)... Wafer Mapping: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs."*
- **Interconnect Baseline Context:**
  - *Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*  
    *(Referenced for cleanroom baseline compatibility and post-clean metallization constraints).*
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects (Vossen & Kern - Thin Film Processes)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology
**Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line [Chemical Processing] > Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology [Metrology]  
**Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage Post-Clean Wafer (Post-RCA1 / RCA2)  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Laser Surface Scanner / Dark-Field Metrology │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   DI Water Micro-Droplet Sessile Dispense   │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Optical Goniometric Contact Angle Inspection │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   Quality Acceptance & Disposition to Dry    │
│      Oxidation (850°C-900°C SiO2 Growth)     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Loading**:
   - Following standard RCA-1/RCA-2 cleans and rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse, transfer wafer under laminar flow using vacuum tweezers or edge-grip handling.
   - Stage wafer onto the macroscopic optical/laser metrology stage with positional alignment fixture calibrated to Gen 1 macro-placement tolerance ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ / $0.1\ \text{mm}$).

2. **Optical Dark-Field Defect & Particle Metrology**:
   - Align the inspection optical head equipped with a $10\times$ Plan Achromat microscope objective ($\text{NA} = 0.25$).
   - Scan the active wafer field to detect light scattering from residual particulate contamination.
   - Flag any particulate defect exceeding the macro lithography defect ceiling ($\ge 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$, scaled against photoresist thickness).

3. **Sessile Drop DI Water Dispense (Contact Angle)**:
   - Position a calibrated micro-syringe with high-purity DI water normal to the silicon surface.
   - Dispense a sessile micro-droplet ($2.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.5\ \mu\text{L}$) at 5 representative wafer points (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right).
   - Ensure dispense velocity does not induce mechanical droplet bouncing or spreading momentum.

4. **Goniometric Contact Angle Metrology**:
   - Acquire droplet tangent profiles via side-view optical camera and baseline fitting.
   - For post-HF/RCA native oxide-stripped Si surfaces, measure water contact angle $\theta_c$ to verify hydrophobic hydrogen termination.
   - For post-RCA-2 chemical oxide / hydrophilic rinse surfaces prior to thermal gate oxide growth ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$ target thickness $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$), confirm complete surface wetting ($\theta_c < 10^\circ$).

5. **Dry & Cleared Disposition**:
   - Dry inspection drop residues with ultra-pure filtered $\text{N}_2$ gun.
   - Transfer cleared wafers immediately to the furnace staging rack to prevent uncontrolled ambient re-oxidation and airborne particle deposition.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Stage Alignment Margin** | $0.0$ | $\le \pm 100$ ($\pm 0.1$) | $\mu\text{m}$ ($\text{mm}$) | Optical projection stage micrometers |
| **Critical Defect Particle Size Threshold** | $< 1.3$ | Max $< 1.3$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | $10\times$ Plan Achromat ($\text{NA}=0.25$) dark-field scatter |
| **Hydrophilic Passivation Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** *(Pre-Gate Ox)* | $< 10$ | $[0, 10]$ | $\text{deg}\ (^\circ)$ | Automated optical goniometer |
| **Hydrophobic H-Terminated Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** *(Post-dHF)* | $> 70$ | $[70, 85]$ | $\text{deg}\ (^\circ)$ | Automated optical goniometer |

---

### 3. Citations & Context Alignment

- **Alignment & Inspection Optics**:
  - *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: Stable macroscopic stage, $10\times$ Plan Achromat ($\text{NA}=0.25$) objective for optical inspection, DI water rinse standard, and Gen 1 alignment tolerance of $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ ($0.1\ \text{mm}$).
  - *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: Photoresist layer reference thickness $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ utilized as defect filtration baseline.
- **Surface Clean & Subsequent Growth Integration**:
  - *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*: Pre-clean state required directly upstream of thermally grown gate $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ physical thickness.
  - *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*: Substrate interface control targeting minimum channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ and width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$ transistor gates to prevent leakage exceeding $1\ \text{fA/cell}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Calibration of Laser Surface Particle Scanner & Baseline Drift Check

**Module:** Metrology / Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Start Baseline Drift  │
│     & Calibration      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Standard PSL      │
│   Calibration Wafer    │
│          Load          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Radial & XY Scan    │
│       Alignment        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Baseline Background   │
│      Noise Check       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Acceptance       │
│   Verification & Log   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Calibration Setup & Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Power on the laser surface particle scanner optical source and stage controllers.
   - Verify that the optical projection/objective enclosure and scan stage have thermally stabilized to ambient cleanroom/operating conditions.

2. **Calibration Standard Loading**:
   - Load a clean reference calibration standard wafer (silicon wafer deposited with NIST-traceable Polystyrene Latex [PSL] calibration spheres) onto the vacuum chuck.
   - Align the wafer notch/flat using the Gen 2 precision mechanical and optical aligner system.

3. **Stage Alignment & Baseline Drift Verification**:
   - Engage automated XY scanning across the wafer plane.
   - Calibrate stage position repeatability to maintain coordinate fidelity across successive sweeps within Gen 2 tolerances (maximum allowable offset $\le \pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$).

4. **Background Noise & Dark Signal Drift Scan**:
   - Execute a blank dark sweep (laser shuttered/idle detector run) across a standard automated multi-point coordinate pattern (e.g., 9-point or 49-point grid) to determine detector electronic noise and background drift.
   - Confirm baseline dark count drift remains stable across the scanning field.

5. **Surface Particle Measurement & Calibration Fit**:
   - Unshutter the laser source and conduct the automated particle sizing scan over the 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping grid.
   - Map scattered intensity peaks to the known reference particle size, verifying calibration curve linearity and sensitivity before clearing the scanner for post-RCA wafer lots.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gen 2 Stage Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical stage encoder calibration check |
| **Scan Grid Configuration** | $9\text{-point or } 49\text{-point}$ | points / wafer | Automated wafer mapping trajectory log |
| **Stage Baseline Repeatability (Gen 1 baseline reference)** | $\le \pm 100$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Maximum drift envelope before fine Gen 2 lock-in |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - *Context applied*: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping protocol for radial scan tracking and uniform surface coordinate monitoring.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - *Context applied*: Microscopic optical stage alignment tolerances: Gen 1 baseline tolerance ($\pm 100\,\mu\text{m}$ / $0.1\,\text{mm}$) improving to Gen 2 precision ($\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$) for macroscopic motion control and scanner positioning.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Recipe Qualification

- **Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-WCA-001`
- **Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Post-Clean Metrology
- **Action Type:** Make / Recipe Qualification
- **Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)
- **Target Substrate:** 180nm / SKY130-compatible 150mm/200mm p-type/n-type bare and patterned silicon test wafers

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Start: RCA Cleaned   │
│         Wafer          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Goniometer Auto-Load  │
│     & Vacuum Chuck     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Micro-Sessile Drop   │
│  Dispensing: 1.0-2.0   │
│  uL UPW 18.2 MOhm-cm   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    High-Speed Video    │
│    Edge Detection:     │
│     Young-Laplace      │
│        Fitting         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│     WCA Evaluation     │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├───────────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────╮
             │ Hydrophilic Oxide (< 5°)          │ Hydrophobic H-Terminated (> 75°)    │ Out of Spec
             ▼                                   ▼                                     ▼
┌────────────────────────┐          ┌────────────────────────┐            ┌────────────────────────┐
│    SC-1 / SC-2 Pass    │          │      HF Dip Pass       │            │    Trigger Rework /    │
│   (Hydrated Surface)   │          │ (Complete Dewetting)   │            │  Bath Excursion Alarm  │
└────────────────────────┘          └────────────────────────┘            └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the automated execution and recipe qualification for Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) metrology across the wet clean line. It quantifies surface wettability, chemical oxide formation, and hydrogen termination following RCA-1 (SC-1), dilute HF native oxide strip, and RCA-2 (SC-2) cleaning steps prior to high-temperature furnace diffusion/oxidation.

---

### 2. Equipment, Chemistry & Metrology Setup
1. **Automated Contact Angle Goniometer**:
   - Motorized automated $X$-$Y$-$\theta$ stage with sub-micron positioning.
   - Micro-syringe dispenser with PTFE needle tip (gauge 30–32).
   - High-resolution telecentric zoom lens and CMOS camera ($\ge 60\text{ fps}$).
   - Image analysis software supporting Young-Laplace baseline fitting and tangent polynomial algorithms.
2. **Dispense Fluid**: Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) with in-line resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Environmental Enclosure**: Class 1 mini-environment, continuous filtered clean dry air (CDA) or $\text{N}_2$ purge to prevent airborne organic hydrocarbon adsorption.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Operational Checks & UPW Line Verification
1. Verify the goniometer fluid delivery circuit is purged: dispense 10 sacrificial droplets to remove any trapped micro-bubbles.
2. Verify UPW source resistivity displays $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at point-of-use (POU).
3. Execute calibration using a certified optical calibration target (stainless steel sphere or calibration glass slide with known angle certified within $\pm 0.2^\circ$).

#### Step 2: Recipe Parameter Setup & Multi-Site Programming
1. Load recipe `WCA_180NM_RCA_QUAL`:
   - **Droplet Volume:** $1.5\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\ \mu\text{L}$ (ensures gravitational sagging is negligible and Young-Laplace regime holds).
   - **Dosing Rate:** $1.0\ \mu\text{L/s}$ via automated micro-syringe.
   - **Deposition Method:** Bottom-up touch-off (stage approaches droplet to touch substrate, then retracts needle smoothly at $2.0\text{ mm/s}$ without kinetic vibration).
   - **Image Acquisition Window:** $t = 500\text{ ms}$ to $1000\text{ ms}$ post-deposition (records stable equilibrium sessile contact angle prior to evaporation effects).
2. Configure 5-point wafer map (Center, North, South, East, West with $10\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).

#### Step 3: Wafer Loading & Automated Measurement Execution
1. Transfer wafer from the clean line cassette (transferred immediately within $\le 15\text{ minutes}$ post-Marangoni/IPA dry) onto the goniometer vacuum chuck.
2. Engage vacuum chuck ($P \le -70\text{ kPa}$).
3. Initiate auto-measurement:
   - Tool moves stage to coordinate $(X_i, Y_i)$.
   - Needle dispenses $1.5\ \mu\text{L}$ UPW droplet.
   - Camera captures the baseline and droplet profile.
   - Automated edge-detection algorithm fits the droplet contour via the Young-Laplace equation and computes left/right contact angles ($\theta_L$, $\theta_R$).
4. System automatically indexes to the next site, repeating the 5-point measurement.

#### Step 4: Post-Measurement Handling & Pass/Fail Classification
1. Record average contact angle $\overline{\theta} = \frac{1}{2N}\sum_{i=1}^N (\theta_{L,i} + \theta_{R,i})$ and across-wafer standard deviation ($1\sigma$).
2. Evaluate based on process stage:
   - **Post-SC-1 / Post-SC-2:** Confirm complete hydrophilic wetting indicating uniform chemical oxide growth.
   - **Post-Dilute HF Strip:** Confirm hydrophobic dewetting indicating complete removal of native oxide and full H-termination of bare silicon.
3. If measurement falls out of bounds, automatically flag the cleaning batch, quarantine the wafer boat, and trigger bath chemistry replenishment.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Post-Dilute HF Strip Hydrophobic Contact Angle | **$\ge 75.0^\circ$** (Uniform Dewetting across 5 sites) | Degrees ($^\circ$) | Young-Laplace fitted contact angle at 5-point map |
| **AC-02** | Post-RCA-1 / RCA-2 Hydrophilic Contact Angle | **$< 5.0^\circ$** (Complete wetting / spreading) | Degrees ($^\circ$) | Goniometer edge-tangent fit at 5-point map |
| **AC-03** | Dispense Liquid Point-of-Use Resistivity | **$\ge 18.2$** | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductivity/resistivity sensor at $22^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **AC-04** | Sessile Droplet Dosing Volume Precision | **$1.5 \pm 0.2$** | Microliters ($\mu\text{L}$) | Optical telecentric droplet volume integration |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Traceability
- **RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**:
  - *Dilute HF (1:50 to 1:100 HF:UPW, 15–30 s at 22°C)*: Establishes the hydrophobic dewetting transition endpoint where water sheets off bare silicon without wetting (yielding contact angles $\ge 75^\circ$).
  - *RCA-1 (SC-1, 5:1:1 UPW:NH4OH:H2O2 at 70°C–75°C)*: Establishes base-catalyzed micro-etching and re-oxidation yielding a uniform hydrophilic chemical oxide surface ($\theta < 5^\circ$).
  - *RCA-2 (SC-2, 6:1:1 UPW:HCl:H2O2 at 75°C $\pm$ 2°C)*: Removes trace ionic/metal contaminants and finalizes cascade dump rinse/overflow rinse to $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - Sets wafer architecture context (150nm poly gate length / 180nm technology node), requiring defect-free surface preparation prior to gate oxidation to preserve critical dimensions and gate dielectric breakdown integrity.
citations: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)
RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-GONIOMETER-OPT-DISPENSER-001`
**Title:** Goniometer Optical Calibration & Automated Microliter Syringe Dispenser Integration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology > Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Recipe Qualification > Goniometer Optical Calibration & Automated Microliter Syringe Dispenser Integration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Integration  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
Establish optical magnification calibration and integrate an automated microliter syringe dispenser for sessile-drop contact angle goniometry. This procedure ensures reproducible droplet formation, precise optical edge-detection, and reliable measurement of post-RCA surface wettability for 180nm DRAM wafer processing.

---

### 2. Workflow & Execution Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["1. Mechanical Stage & Optic Alignment"] --> B["2. Optical Scale Calibration (Grid Target)"]
    B --> C["3. Syringe Dispenser Actuator Integration"]
    C --> D["4. Automated Sessile Droplet Dispense & Edge Verification"]
    D --> E["5. Metrology Acceptance Qualification"]
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Mechanical Stage & Optical Alignment
1. Mount the goniometer assembly onto a vibration-damped optical breadboard.
2. Align the optical imaging path using a fixed-focal/microscope objective assembly (such as a 10× Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) normal to the wafer sample stage.
3. Level the substrate vacuum chuck using the three-point precision kinematic mounting screws to eliminate tilt relative to the optical horizon.

#### Step 2: Optical Calibration (Pixel-to-Micron Scaling)
1. Place a certified glass calibration reticle (grid target / certified micro-scale) flat on the wafer chuck.
2. Illuminate via a telecentric or diffused LED backlight to eliminate optical diffraction and shadow blooming.
3. Acquire the calibration reticle image via the machine-vision camera.
4. Set the optical calibration factor ($\mu\text{m/pixel}$) using digital edge-detection across known fiducials, verifying that stage positioning and alignment repeatability meet Gen 2 tolerances (within $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).

#### Step 3: Automated Microliter Syringe Dispenser Integration
1. Mount a gastight microliter syringe equipped with a PTFE/passivated blunt dispensing needle onto the motorized vertical Z-drive.
2. Connect the closed-loop micro-stepper or piezo-driven syringe plunger actuator.
3. Set the needle-to-substrate standoff height using closed-loop positioning with micrometer sensitivity (down to $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity).
4. Fill the fluid path with high-purity deionized (DI) water; purge all microbubbles from the barrel and needle tip.

#### Step 4: Dispensing & Sessile Drop Analysis Qualification
1. Place a clean test wafer (or wafer coupon) on the stage.
2. Command the automated dispenser to execute a controlled sessile drop delivery:
   - Lower the needle to the calibrated pre-dispense gap.
   - Dispense a calibrated microliter droplet into contact with the substrate.
   - Retract the needle at a controlled velocity without rupturing or distorting the liquid-air interface.
3. Trigger frame capture to acquire droplet silhouette and fit baseline/tangent angles via polynomial/Young-Laplace fitting.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Validation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage & Optic Alignment Tolerance** | $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (Gen 2 standard) | Digital reticle translation check across visual field |
| **Z-Axis Actuator Sensitivity / Gap Setting** | $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ | Closed-loop encoder / micrometer readback |
| **Microscope Objective Resolution Standard** | 10× Plan Achromat, $\text{NA} = 0.25$ | Optical verification of target line-pair resolution |
| **Post-Dispense DI Water Rinse Purity** | Zero bubble inclusions / complete rinse | In-line fluidic optical transmission inspection |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations

1. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
   - *Optical configuration:* Utilization of a 10× Plan Achromat (NA 0.25) objective for feature resolution.
   - *Alignment tolerances:* Gen 1 alignment tolerance standard ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$) transitioning to Gen 2 precision ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - *Fluidics:* Rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse protocols.
2. **Optical Mask Aligner Mechanics: Gap Control and UV Exposure Dose:**
   - *Gap & Height Control:* Gap and mechanical displacement control utilizing precision micrometers or closed-loop piezo actuators with $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.
   - *Alignment Fiducials:* Crosshair alignment mark referencing for precision metrology and translation stability.

**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### Process Workflow

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│  Stage Alignment &  │

│    Young-Laplace    │
│   Baseline & WCA    │
│       Fitting       │
│                     │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Conditioning & Stage Registration**:
   - Verify 100mm silicon wafer completed standard RCA-1/RCA-2 cleaning, followed by wafer dehydration baked at **150°C to 200°C for 30 minutes** and subsequent HMDS vapor priming (converting hydrophilic `-Si-OH` groups into hydrophobic `-Si-O-Si(CH3)3` bonds).
   - Load wafer onto the motorized goniometer vacuum chuck. Align wafer notch/flat to the home sensor, ensuring stage coordinate alignment tolerance satisfies **±5 µm** (Gen 2 standard).

2. **Automated Dispense Needle Calibration**:
   - Prime the automated micro-syringe line with HPLC-grade Deionized (DI) water. Purge air bubbles to maintain consistent micro-droplet meniscus formation.
   - Set the automated Z-axis clearance of the dosing needle to 1.0 mm above the wafer plane.

3. **Multi-Point Sessile Drop Dosing Routine**:
   - Execute a 5-point coordinate recipe across the 100mm substrate (Center, North, South, East, West with 10 mm edge exclusion).
   - At each site, dispense a controlled DI water sessile droplet at a steady dosing rate; lower the stage gently to touch off the droplet onto the wafer surface without mechanical vibration.

4. **Synchronized Telecentric Image Acquisition**:
   - Trigger side-view high-resolution optical capture (aligned back-illuminated collimated LED source paired with optical objective).
   - Capture baseline profile within 2 to 5 seconds post-dispense to eliminate evaporation distortion before measuring contact angle.

5. **Profile Fitting & Recipe Qualification**:
   - Run automated baseline detection and Young-Laplace contour fitting algorithm on each droplet profile.
   - Check surface hydrophobicity uniformity across the 100mm wafer. Ensure post-HMDS hydrophobicity is verified prior to applying downstream Shipley 1813 spin coating (targeting **1.30 µm ± 15 nm** film uniformity across the 100mm wafer).

---

Dehyd Bake┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│

1. **Stage Alignment Tolerance**: **±5 µm** (Gen 2 macro/micro positioning limit).
2. **Dehydration Bake Temperature**: **150°C to 200°C** for **30 minutes**.
3. **Subsequent Film Uniformity Baseline Target**: **1.30 µm ± 15 nm** across a 100mm wafer (Shipley 1813 spun at 4,000 RPM).
4. **Soft Bake Temperature Baseline**: **115°C** for **60 seconds** on a flat aluminum hot plate.

---

### 3. Literature Citations

- **Source: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming**:
  - *Wafer Dehydration*: Silicon wafers must be baked at 150°C–200°C for 30 minutes to desorb physisorbed water molecules.
  - *HMDS Priming*: Reactive silylation of hydrophilic silanol (`-Si-OH`) groups into hydrophobic methyl-siloxane (`-Si-O-Si(CH3)3`) bonds to increase resist adhesion.
  - *Film Uniformity*: Shipley 1813 spin recipe produces 1.30 µm ± 15 nm film across 100mm wafers.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-HF Hydrophobic/Hydrophilic Baseline Statistical Qualification & Gage R&R Analysis

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│         Pre-Clean: RCA-1 (SC-1) Line         │
│          70°C - 80°C (10 - 15 min)           │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Intermediate Rinse: 18.2 MOhm-cm DI      │
│               Dump Rinse 3 min               │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│             1:50 Dilute HF Dip               │
│      15 - 30 s (Oxide Strip Transition)      │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│          High-Purity N2 Blow-Dry             │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Automated Sessile Drop WCA Metrology     │
│   Baseline Hydrophobic Measurement (5 pts)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│         Statistical Gage R&R Analysis        │
│       Repeatability & Reproducibility        │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Clean & Oxide Preparation**:
   - Clean the 180nm DRAM test silicon substrates using the Standard RCA-1 (SC-1) bath (`5 H2O : 1 NH4OH [29%] : 1 H2O2 [30%]`) maintained at **70°C – 80°C** for **10 – 15 minutes** to solubilize organic surface residues and produce a uniform hydrophilic chemical oxide.
   - Execute an intermediate dump rinse using **18.2 MΩ·cm** deionized (DI) water for **3 minutes**.
2. **Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip**:
   - Transfer the wafers into a **1:50 HF:H2O** bath for **15 – 30 seconds** at ambient temperature (~25°C) to fully strip the native oxide layer and passivate the silicon surface with hydrogen bonds (transitioning from hydrophilic to hydrophobic).
   - Ensure emergency Calcium Gluconate gel is verified accessible at the wet bench prior to immersion.
3. **Quench & High-Purity Dry**:
   - Perform a quick dump rinse with **18.2 MΩ·cm** DI water to remove residual acid traces.
   - Blow-dry the wafer thoroughly using pressurized, filtered high-purity **Nitrogen (N2)** gas.
4. **Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Measurement**:
   - Transfer the dry wafer immediately to the automated optical contact angle goniometer.
   - Dispense a calibrated sessile droplet of 18.2 MΩ·cm DI water across standard 5-point layout locations (Center, North, South, East, West).
   - Capture droplet profile images and calculate baseline water contact angles using Young-Laplace edge-fitting.
5. **Gage R&R Statistical Qualification**:
   - Conduct evaluation using multiple runs/operators on calibrated standard wafers across successive cycles to evaluate repeatability (equipment variation, EV) and reproducibility (appraiser variation, AV).
   - Confirm baseline contact angle stability prior to re-oxidation or downstream unit processing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **RCA-1 Bath Temperature** | `70.0 - 80.0` | `°C` | In-situ Bath Thermocouple / RTD |
| **Intermediate Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | `MΩ·cm` | In-line Resistivity Sensor |
| **HF Strip Immersion Duration** | `15 - 30` | `s` | Wet-bench Automated Immersion Timer |
| **Intermediate Dump Rinse Time** | `3` | `min` | Dump Rinse Process Controller |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - *RCA-1 (SC-1) Chemistry & Temperature*: `5 H2O : 1 NH4OH (29%) : 1 H2O2 (30%)` at `70°C-80°C for 10-15 minutes`.
  - *Intermediate DI Rinse*: `18.2 MOhm-cm deionized water for 3 minutes`.
  - *HF Dip*: `1:50 HF:H2O dip for 15-30 seconds to strip native oxide; surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic`.
  - *Drying Method*: `Nitrogen (N2) blow-dry with high-purity`.
* **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - *HF Safety & Handling*: `Caution: Hydrofluoric acid penetrates skin and binds calcium; calcium gluconate gel must be present at all times`.
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-RCA Surface Defect Density & Hydrophobic Passivation Mapping
**Module**: Cleanroom Chemical Processing & Metrology | **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (1T1C Folded Bitline)  
**Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Buy / Metrology Service Gate  
**Reference Document**: [docs/context.yaml](docs/context.yaml)

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Wafer Cassette     │
│        Transfer        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Laser Surface      │
│  Particle Inspection   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Automated Goniometer  │
│     Contact Angle      │
│        Mapping         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Ellipsometry Thin    │
│   Oxide Verification   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Acceptance Lot     │
│         Gating         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Post-Clean Transfer & Environmental Conditioning**:
   - Transfer wafer lot directly from the RCA-1 (organic/particle strip) / RCA-2 (metallic clean) and final HF-dip/DI-water spin rinse-dry station to the automated metrology cassette load lock within $< 15\text{ minutes}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth and airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
   - Maintain the FOUP/SMIF mini-environment at $21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and relative humidity at $40 \pm 2\%$.

2. **Automated Laser Surface Particle / Defect Density Scanning**:
   - Load wafer onto the laser surface defect scanner (unpatterned/macro defect metrology tool).
   - Set defect inspection optical sensitivity bin threshold to $\ge 180\text{ nm}$ (matching channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and critical dimension limits; resolving down to killer defect thresholds below bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform full-wafer spiral laser scatter scanning with a $3\text{ mm}$ edge-exclusion zone. Compute total defect count and area defect density ($D_0$).

3. **Multi-Point Hydrophobic Passivation & Contact Angle Mapping**:
   - Transfer wafer to the automated micro-goniometer platform.
   - Dispense sessile deionized water droplets ($1.0 \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$) at a 9-point radial map (Center, Mid-radius 4 points, Outer-radius 4 points at $R - 10\text{ mm}$).
   - Measure static contact angle ($\theta_c$) within $2.0\text{ seconds}$ of droplet contact to evaluate hydrogen-passivated (Si-H) hydrophobic surface coverage versus oxide/chemical-passivated surface state.

4. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Interfacial Oxide Profiling**:
   - Measure residual chemical or native oxide thickness across a 13-point diametric line scan to verify complete removal prior to thermal gate oxide growth ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical target) and stacked capacitor storage node contact formation.
   - Record spatial uniformity ($\sigma$) across the wafer surface.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                             ┌─────────────────────────┐
                             │░░░                      │
    Min Capacitor Charge (fF)┤░░░                      │
                             │▒                        │
Gate Ox Thickness Target (nm)┤▒                        │
  Bitline/Wordline Pitch (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   Defect Threshold Size (nm)┤█████████████            │
                             │█████████████            │
                             └┬─────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬┘
                              0    90    180   270  360 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Value & Unit | Measurement Tool / Method | Failure Mode Preempted |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Critical Defect Density ($D_0$)** | **$< 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$** at size $\ge 180\text{ nm}$ | Darkfield Laser Scattering Metrology | Bridging across Bitline/Wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ - $400\text{ nm}$), access channel shorts ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$). |
| **Surface Hydrophobic Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** | **$\ge 75^\circ$** (Uniformity $\sigma < 3.0^\circ$ across 9 points) | Automated Optical Sessile Drop Goniometer | Non-uniform Si-H termination, premature chemical re-oxidation, wet chemical staining. |
| **Residual Interfacial Oxide Thickness** | **$< 0.4\text{ nm}$** (Prior to $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxidation) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\lambda = 190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$) | Gate dielectric thickness deviation, premature breakdown of $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$. |
| **Macro Defect Clustered Fall-off** | **$0\text{ clusters}$** (Zero clustered defects $\ge 360\text{ nm}$) | Defect Spatial Pattern Recognition Engine | W-plug stacked capacitor contact opens and bitline coupling leakage degradation ($> 1\text{ fA/cell}$). |

---

### 4. Context Source Citations

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
   - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Minimum cell storage capacitance: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ to preserve noise immunity against soft errors.
   - Leakage current budget: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (governed by pre-clean surface defect mitigation).
2. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
   - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate dielectric target: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$ maintaining retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **[1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets]**:
   - $8F^2$ folded bitline cell footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Storage node capacitance budget: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ ($28\text{ fF}$ nominal).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Laser Surface Particle Scanner Calibration & Defect Map Baseline Setup

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Standard RCA-1 & RCA-2 Wafer Cleaning Line > Post-Clean Particle & Hydrophobic Contact Angle Metrology > Post-RCA Surface Defect Density & Hydrophobic Passivation Mapping > Laser Surface Particle Scanner Calibration & Defect Map Baseline Setup  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Stage Kinematic     │
│  Leveling & Indexing   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Optical Calibration   │
│   with 365nm Source    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Radial Wafer      │
│    Mapping: 9-pt &     │
│       49-pt Grid       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Surface Scattering &  │
│     Defect Density     │
│        Baseline        │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Stage Kinematic Alignment & Leveling**:
   - Mount the calibration standard wafer onto the macroscopic vacuum stage.
   - Verify stage planar leveling and zero-reference positioning. Ensure the translation stage motion tracks within the Gen 2 positional alignment tolerance of **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.

2. **Optical Sensor & Source Alignment**:
   - Power up the scanner's high-power optical detection path configured with a **$365\text{ nm}$** optical source and objective optics (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25).
   - Calibrate the optical sensor baseline against known dark and bare silicon reference surfaces to zero out ambient photo-detector dark current and background Rayleigh scattering.

3. **Multi-Point Grid Calibration (9-Point & 49-Point)**:
   - Program the automated wafer scanner coordinate system for radial inspection using standard **9-point** and **49-point** wafer mapping grids.
   - Execute spatial scanning along the concentric radial test sites to ensure uniform sweep velocity and surface focus repeatability across the entire wafer active radius.

4. **Baseline Defect Density Map Generation**:
   - Load a pristine, post-RCA cleaned test substrate.
   - Scan the substrate over the 49-point grid, recording scatter events to establish the post-clean baseline defect and particle density signature prior to stacked capacitor cell array or thin dielectric film processing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Reference Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Post-RCA Surface Defect Density Inspection & Darkfield Haze Mapping

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-042`  
**Classification:** Metrology / Inspection Line  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Step:** Post-RCA Surface Defect Density Inspection & Darkfield Haze Mapping  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Laser Surface Particle Counter / Darkfield Inspection Metrology System)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure specifies the automated laser surface darkfield inspection and haze mapping for wafers exiting the RCA-1 / RCA-2 wafer cleaning line prior to critical high-temperature thermal steps (e.g., dry gate oxidation, polysilicon/high-k deposition). It qualifies surface cleanliness, particle defect count/density, and micro-roughness (haze) across 150mm/200mm silicon substrates.

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-----------------------+     +------------------------+     +------------------------+
| 1. Wafer Loading &    | --> | 2. Recipe & Laser      | --> | 3. High-Gain Darkfield |
|    Cassette Placement |     |    Alignment (P/S-Pol) |     |    Surface Scanning    |
+-----------------------+     +------------------------+     +------------------------+
                                                                          |
                                                                          v
+-----------------------+     +------------------------+     +------------------------+
| 6. Clean Unload &     | <-- | 5. Pass/Fail Decision  | <-- | 4. Micro-Roughness     |
|    FOUP Routing       |     |    & Map Classification|     |    (Haze) Integration  |
+-----------------------+     +------------------------+     +------------------------+
```

### Step 1: Substrate Reception & Pre-Check
- Transfer the wafer cassette directly from the RCA final high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry / spin-rinse-dry station into the automated wafer-loader SMIF/cassette stage.
- Ensure the wafer surface is protected from airborne particulate contamination (ISO Class 1 mini-environment, laminar flow velocity $0.45 \pm 0.05\text{ m/s}$).

### Step 2: Recipe Selection & Optics Configuration
- Load recipe `REC-180DRAM-POSTRCA-HAZE`.
- Set laser beam incidence to grazing angle with darkfield collection optics configured for bare silicon / chemical native oxide surfaces.
- Select dual optical channels:
  - **Narrow Darkfield (NDF):** High sensitivity for isolated point defects and small particulate scattering.
  - **Wide Darkfield (WDF):** Optimized for low-frequency surface scatter and background darkfield haze.

### Step 3: Darkfield Particle & Surface Defect Scanning
- Clamp substrate electrostatically or via backside vacuum chuck with peripheral edge exclusion $\le 3.0\text{ mm}$.
- Initiate spiral/helical surface raster scan using solid-state laser source ($\lambda \sim 488\text{ nm}$ or $355\text{ nm}$ UV).
- Map coordinates $(X, Y)$ and cross-sectional scattering intensities for all detected surface anomalies down to threshold bin ($\ge 180\text{ nm}$ localized light scatterers - LLS).

### Step 4: Darkfield Haze Extraction & Surface Uniformity Mapping
- Integrate wide-angle darkfield scatter signals across wafer sub-apertures to extract average background haze in parts per million ($\text{ppm}$) relative to incident beam intensity.
- Detect localized haze anomalies indicating micro-roughness, chemical residue stains, or non-uniform native oxide regrowth following the HF dip/SC-2 clean.

### Step 5: Disposition & Pass/Fail Classification
- Correlate coordinates against DRAM unit cell critical pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline pitch limits) to identify killer defects.
- Classify wafer disposition based on defect density limits and haze bounds. 
- Flag flagged wafers for rework (repeat SC-1/SC-2) if organic residue or particle clustering is identified.

### Step 6: Wafer Unload & Logging
- Return qualified wafers to clean transfer pods/cassettes and route to next process module (Gate Oxidation Furnace).
- Export wafer inspection defect map file (`.001` / KLARF standard) to the fab defect tracking database.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Defect Particle Threshold Size** | $\ge 180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Equivalent Polystyrene Latex (PSL) sphere diameter | Darkfield Laser Scatter Channel |
| **Surface Defect Density ($D_0$)** | $\le 0.05$ | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Max threshold ($\ge 180\text{ nm}$ particle bin) | Automated Defect Coordinate Map |
| **Wafer Edge Exclusion Margin** | $3.0$ | $\text{mm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ mm}$ edge zone | Optical Chuck Edge Sensor |
| **Average Darkfield Background Haze** | $\le 0.15$ | $\text{ppm}$ | Maximum scatter over incident beam | Wide Darkfield Photodetector Array |

---

## 4. Context References & Literature Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical sequence: RCA-1 ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$), intermediate $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI rinse, 1:50 $\text{HF}$ dip ($15\text{--}30\text{ s}$), RCA-2 ($\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$), and final high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry. 
  - Justifies post-clean metrology to verify the complete removal of organic surface films, particulate contaminants, and metallic ionic traces.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Constrains the minimum optical inspection defect sensitivity limit to $\le 180\text{ nm}$ to detect killer particles before channel lithography and capacitor formation.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Critical bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$. Emphasizes that surface micro-roughness and darkfield haze must remain tightly bounded to avoid gate oxide breakdown and dielectric degradation.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Goniometric Sessile Drop Contact Angle Passivation Profiling

### 1. Scope & Objective
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the protocol for automated goniometric sessile drop contact angle metrology on 180nm DRAM fabrication silicon substrates. The primary objective is to verify surface passivation uniformity, native oxide stripping completion, and transition between hydrophilic and hydrophobic states following the Standard RCA-1, intermediate HF dip (1:50 $\text{HF:H}_2\text{O}$), and RCA-2 cleaning sequences.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Pre-Clean / Post-HF   │
│        Surface         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Automated Dispense:   │
│    18.2 MOhm-cm DI     │
│   Water Sessile Drop   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Side-View High-Speed  │
│    Optical Capture     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Baseline &       │
│     Young-Laplace      │
│        Fitting         │
│└───────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Multi-Point       │
│  Passivation Mapping   │
│    & Outlier Check     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Chamber Conditioning**:
   - Transfer wafer from the cleaning line under high-purity $\text{N}_2$ environment directly to the automated goniometer stage to prevent airborne organic hydrocarbon adsorption or uncontrolled native oxide re-growth.
   - Maintain metrology chamber ambient at $21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and relative humidity at $45 \pm 3\%$.

2. **Liquid Delivery System Priming**:
   - Purge automated micro-syringe line with ultra-pure deionized (DI) water exhibiting an electrical resistivity of $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   - Ensure the dispensing tip is free of micro-bubbles and external wetting.

3. **Automated Wafer Mapping & Motion Setup**:
   - Load wafer recipe configured with standard radial tracking coordinates (utilizing standard automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping grid across center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zones).
   - Align chuck zero coordinates to wafer notch/flat.

4. **Sessile Droplet Deposition**:
   - At each programmed inspection site, dispense a calibrated sessile micro-droplet ($2.0 \pm 0.2\ \mu\text{L}$) of $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water at a controlled dosing rate ($1.0\ \mu\text{L/s}$).
   - Retract dosing needle vertically with zero vibration to avoid droplet sloshing or baseline distortion.

5. **Image Acquisition & Drop Profile Extraction**:
   - Capture side-view telecentric images within $2.0\text{ seconds}$ post-deposition using high-resolution digital optics with diffuse backlighting.
   - Automatically determine the substrate baseline and fit droplet tangent angles via Young-Laplace / polynomial circle fitting algorithms on both left ($\theta_L$) and right ($\theta_R$) contact contact interfaces.

6. **Passivation Profiling & Automated Run Validation**:
   - Average both angles: $\theta = \frac{\theta_L + \theta_R}{2}$.
   - Classify surface state: Hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated passivated surface ($>70^\circ$, typical for post-1:50 HF etch) vs. Hydrophilic chemical oxide / clean surface ($<10^\circ$, post-RCA-1 / RCA-2).
   - If contact angle deviation indicates incomplete native oxide strip or organic patch contamination, trigger an automated hold flag for engineering review.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Requirement |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Probe Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Minimum absolute resistivity threshold |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Resolution** | $9\text{ or }49$ | points / wafer | Automated multi-point radial mapping |
| **HF Strip Contact Angle (Hydrophobic)** | $> 70$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Minimum post-1:50 HF oxide strip passivation angle |
| **Post-RCA Surface Wetting (Hydrophilic)**| $< 10$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Maximum post-SC-1 / SC-2 residual oxide contact angle |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - *Intermediate Rinse*: Dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for 3 minutes.
  - *Hydrofluoric Dip*: 1:50 $\text{HF:H}_2\text{O}$ dip for 15–30 seconds to strip native oxide; surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.
  - *RCA-1 & RCA-2 Chemistry*: RCA-1 (5:1:1 $\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{–}80^\circ\text{C}$) and RCA-2 (6:1:1 $\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{–}80^\circ\text{C}$) generating ultra-clean hydrophilic chemical oxide interfaces.
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - *Wafer Mapping*: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Substrate Criticality*: Gate and capacitor stack interfaces require stringent contamination control at $L = 180\text{ nm}$ transistor and dielectric integration nodes.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
